+"""One admission authority for fixed GPU lanes, export, and paired grading."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from fit_stage import _validate_fit_receipt
+from journal import Journal, write_json_fsync
+from policy import sha256_file
+from postprocess_common import _runtime_paths
+from postprocess_export_run import _export_one
+from postprocess_fit import _fit_binding
+from postprocess_grade import _grade_pair
+from process_start import Running, start_owned, terminate_owned
+from profiles import actor_environment
+from runtime_gates import cgroup_snapshot, require_gpus
+
+from runtime import MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT, _monitor
+
+
+def run_rolling(
+    panel: dict, root: Path, state: Path, journal: Journal, deadline: float
+) -> dict:
+    """Keep at most one actor per frozen GPU, retaining all source-bound endpoints."""
+    jobs = panel["jobs"]
+    by_id = {j["id"]: j for j in jobs}
+    paths = _runtime_paths(root, jobs)
+    # Heterogeneous controller receipts are JSON dictionaries from fixed adapters.
+    progress: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "pending": list(jobs),
+        "handled": set(),
+        "records": {},
+        "fits": {},
+        "exports": {},
+        "grades": {},
+        "stop": False,
+        "first_export_passed": False,
+    }
+    running: list[Running] = []
+    baseline = cgroup_snapshot()["memory_events"]
+
+    def save_progress() -> None:
+        write_json_fsync(
+            state / "PROGRESS.json",
+            {
+                "fits": list(progress["records"].values()),
+                "pending": len(progress["pending"]),
+                "grades": list(progress["grades"].values()),
+                "new_admissions_stopped": progress["stop"],
+            },
+        )
+
+    def finish_one(name: str, result: dict) -> None:
+        job = by_id[name]
+        record = {"job_id": name, "process": result, "status": result["status"]}
+        progress["records"][name] = record
+        if result["status"] != "completed" or result["returncode"] != 0:
+            progress["stop"] = True
+            journal.record("fit_failed", job_id=name, process=result)
+            return
+        _validate_fit_receipt(job)
+        record.update(
+            status="fixed_epoch5_receipt_verified",
+            fit_receipt_sha256=sha256_file(
+                Path(job["run_dir"]) / "producer_receipt.json"
+            ),
+        )
+        fit = _fit_binding(root, job)
+        progress["fits"][name] = fit
+        journal.record("fit_receipt_verified", job_id=name)
+        if progress["stop"] and not progress["first_export_passed"]:
+            record["export_status"] = "awaiting_first_export_resource_repair"
+            return
+        journal.record("export_start", job_id=name)
+        limit = time.time() + min(1800, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+        exported = _export_one(root, paths, fit, limit)
+        admitted = bool(exported.pop("resource_admitted", False))
+        record["export_status"] = exported.get("status")
+        if not admitted:
+            progress["stop"] = True
+            journal.record(
+                "export_not_admitted", job_id=name, status=exported.get("status")
+            )
+            return
+        progress["first_export_passed"] = True
+        progress["exports"][name] = exported
+        journal.record("export_verified", job_id=name)
+        key = (job["fold"], job["seed"])
+        pair_jobs = [j for j in jobs if (j["fold"], j["seed"]) == key]
+        if key in progress["grades"] or not all(
+            j["id"] in progress["exports"] for j in pair_jobs
+        ):
+            return
+        fits = {j["arm"]: progress["fits"][j["id"]] for j in pair_jobs}
+        exports = {j["arm"]: progress["exports"][j["id"]] for j in pair_jobs}
+        journal.record("grade_start", fold=key[0], seed=key[1])
+        limit = time.time() + min(1800, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+        grade = _grade_pair(root, paths, key[0], fits, exports, limit)
+        progress["grades"][key] = grade
+        if grade["status"] != "graded":
+            progress["stop"] = True
+        journal.record(
+            "grade_finished", fold=key[0], seed=key[1], status=grade["status"]
+        )
+
+    def advance(active: list[Running], results: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
+        for name, result in results.items():
+            if name in progress["handled"]:
+                continue
+            progress["handled"].add(name)
+            try:
+                finish_one(name, result)
+            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, RuntimeError) as error:
+                progress["stop"] = True
+                progress["records"].setdefault(name, {"job_id": name}).update(
+                    delivery_error_type=type(error).__name__, delivery_error=str(error)
+                )
+                journal.record(
+                    "delivery_failed",
+                    job_id=name,
+                    error_type=type(error).__name__,
+                    error=str(error),
+                )
+            save_progress()
+        if progress["stop"]:
+            return
+        busy = {task.gpu_uuid for task in active if task.status == "running"}
+        for job in list(progress["pending"]):
+            if job["gpu_uuid"] in busy:
+                continue
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                raise TimeoutError("Campaign admission deadline expired")
+            if cgroup_snapshot()["memory_current"] >= MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT:
+                raise RuntimeError("Unit memory admission ceiling reached")
+            require_gpus([job], job["gpu_uuid"])
+            run = Path(job["run_dir"])
+            if run.exists() or run.is_symlink():
+                raise FileExistsError(run)
+            run.mkdir(parents=True)
+            env = actor_environment(root, run, job["gpu_uuid"])
+            active.append(
+                start_owned(
+                    name=job["id"],
+                    argv=job["argv"],
+                    environment={**env, "WNN_CWD": str(root)},
+                    cpus=tuple(job["cpu_ids_initial"]),
+                    log_path=state / "logs" / f"{job['id']}.log",
+                    timeout_seconds=min(
+                        panel["max_fit_seconds"], max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())
+                    ),
+                )
+            )
+            progress["pending"].remove(job)
+            busy.add(job["gpu_uuid"])
+            journal.record(
+                "fit_started",
+                job_id=job["id"],
+                gpu_uuid=job["gpu_uuid"],
+                fold=job["fold"],
+                seed=job["seed"],
+                arm=job["arm"],
+                pid=active[-1].process.pid,
+            )
+        save_progress()
+
+    try:
+        advance(running, {})
+        _monitor(
+            running,
+            journal,
+            root,
+            deadline,
+            baseline,
+            [root / "runs", root / "exports", root / "grades", root / "scratch", state],
+            advance=advance,
+        )
+    except BaseException:
+        for task in running:
+            if task.status == "running":
+                terminate_owned(task.process)
+            if not task.log.closed:
+                task.log.close()
+        raise
+    records = [
+        progress["records"].get(j["id"], {"job_id": j["id"], "status": "not_admitted"})
+        for j in jobs
+    ]
+    grades = list(progress["grades"].values())
+    complete = (
+        len(grades) == 30
+        and all(g["status"] == "graded" for g in grades)
+        and all(
+            r["status"] == "fixed_epoch5_receipt_verified" and "delivery_error" not in r
+            for r in records
+        )
+    )
+    return {
+        "status": "complete" if complete else "partial",
+        "fits": records,
+        "grades": grades,
+        "remaining_not_admitted": len(progress["pending"]),
+        "no_implicit_refits": True,
+    }

+"""Bounded supervision for controller-owned preparation, profiles, and fits."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import shutil
+import stat
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from policy import DISK_FREE_MIN, JOB_RSS_LIMIT
+from process_start import Running, start_owned, terminate_owned
+from runtime_gates import (
+    _gpu_process_memory,
+    cgroup_snapshot,
+    require_gpus,
+)
+
+HEARTBEAT_SECONDS = 30
+OWNED_DISK_LIMIT = 128 * 1024**3
+MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT = 180 * 1024**3
+
+
+def process_group_rss_bytes(pgid: int) -> int:
+    """Sum RSS for processes still in one owned process group."""
+    total_kib = 0
+    for proc in Path("/proc").iterdir():
+        if not proc.name.isdigit():
+            continue
+        try:
+            stat = (proc / "stat").read_text(encoding="ascii")
+            fields = stat[stat.rfind(")") + 2 :].split()
+            if int(fields[2]) != pgid:
+                continue
+            for line in (proc / "status").read_text(encoding="ascii").splitlines():
+                if line.startswith("VmRSS:"):
+                    total_kib += int(line.split()[1])
+                    break
+        except (
+            FileNotFoundError,
+            PermissionError,
+            ProcessLookupError,
+            ValueError,
+            IndexError,
+        ):
+            continue
+    return total_kib * 1024
+
+
+def owned_tree_bytes(paths: list[Path]) -> int:
+    """Count regular files in controller-owned trees without following symlinks."""
+    total = 0
+    for root in paths:
+        if not root.exists():
+            continue
+        for directory, subdirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
+            subdirs[:] = [
+                name for name in subdirs if not (Path(directory) / name).is_symlink()
+            ]
+            for name in files:
+                path = Path(directory) / name
+                try:
+                    mode = path.lstat().st_mode
+                    if stat.S_ISREG(mode):
+                        total += path.lstat().st_size
+                except FileNotFoundError:
+                    continue
+    return total
+
+
+def run_single(
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    argv: list[str],
+    environment: dict[str, str],
+    cpus: tuple[int, ...],
+    log_path: Path,
+    timeout_seconds: float,
+    journal: Any,
+    root: Path,
+    global_deadline: float,
+    owned_paths: list[Path] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run one bounded preparation/profile process with disk and RSS gates."""
+    if time.monotonic() >= global_deadline:
+        raise TimeoutError(f"global wall deadline passed before starting {name}")
+    baseline_events = cgroup_snapshot()["memory_events"]
+    task = start_owned(
+        name=name,
+        argv=argv,
+        environment=environment,
+        cpus=cpus,
+        log_path=log_path,
+        timeout_seconds=min(
+            timeout_seconds, max(0, global_deadline - time.monotonic())
+        ),
+    )
+    try:
+        return _monitor(
+            [task], journal, root, global_deadline, baseline_events, owned_paths
+        )[name]
+    except BaseException:
+        terminate_owned(task.process)
+        task.log.close()
+        raise
+
+
+def run_cohort(
+    jobs: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    launch: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Running],
+    *,
+    journal: Any,
+    root: Path,
+    global_deadline: float,
+    owned_paths: list[Path] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Launch exactly the supplied cohort and supervise each owned group independently."""
+    baseline_events = cgroup_snapshot()["memory_events"]
+    running: list[Running] = []
+    results: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    try:
+        for job in jobs:
+            try:
+                snapshot = cgroup_snapshot()
+                if snapshot["memory_current"] >= MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "cgroup memory.current reached the 180-GiB admission ceiling"
+                    )
+                if time.monotonic() >= global_deadline:
+                    raise TimeoutError("global wall deadline passed before fit launch")
+                require_gpus(jobs, job["gpu_uuid"])
+                running.append(launch(job))
+            except Exception as error:
+                results[job["id"]] = {
+                    "returncode": None,
+                    "status": "admission_failed",
+                    "error": str(error),
+                }
+                journal.record(
+                    "fit_admission_failed", job_id=job["id"], error=str(error)
+                )
+        results.update(
+            _monitor(
+                running, journal, root, global_deadline, baseline_events, owned_paths
+            )
+        )
+    except BaseException as original_error:
+        for task in running:
+            try:
+                if task.status == "running":
+                    terminate_owned(task.process)
+                    task.status = "stopped_after_controller_exception"
+            except BaseException as cleanup_error:
+                original_error.add_note(
+                    f"failed to terminate owned process group {task.name}: {cleanup_error}"
+                )
+            finally:
+                if not task.log.closed:
+                    try:
+                        task.log.flush()
+                        os.fsync(task.log.fileno())
+                    except OSError as log_error:
+                        original_error.add_note(
+                            f"failed to fsync log for {task.name}: {log_error}"
+                        )
+                    task.log.close()
+        raise
+    return results
+
+
+def _monitor(
+    running: list[Running],
+    journal: Any,
+    root: Path,
+    global_deadline: float,
+    baseline_events: dict[str, int],
+    owned_paths: list[Path] | None,
+    advance: Callable[[list[Running], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]], None] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Poll active owned groups, applying per-job RSS and global safety limits."""
+    results: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    last_heartbeat = 0.0
+    last_gpu_sample = 0.0
+    while any(task.status == "running" for task in running):
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        global_reason = None
+        if now >= global_deadline:
+            global_reason = "global wall deadline reached"
+        if shutil.disk_usage(root).free < DISK_FREE_MIN:
+            global_reason = "filesystem free-space floor fell below 8 GiB"
+        owned_bytes = owned_tree_bytes(owned_paths or [])
+        if owned_bytes > OWNED_DISK_LIMIT:
+            global_reason = "controller-owned artifacts exceeded the 45-GiB budget"
+        snapshot = cgroup_snapshot()
+        if snapshot["memory_current"] >= MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT:
+            global_reason = (
+                "container memory.current reached the 180-GiB soft safety ceiling"
+            )
+        if any(
+            snapshot["memory_events"].get(key, 0) > baseline_events.get(key, 0)
+            for key in ("oom", "oom_kill")
+        ):
+            global_reason = "container cgroup reported a new OOM event"
+        if global_reason:
+            for task in running:
+                if task.status == "running":
+                    terminate_owned(task.process)
+                    task.status = "stopped_by_global_gate"
+                    results[task.name] = {
+                        "returncode": task.process.returncode,
+                        "status": task.status,
+                    }
+                    task.log.close()
+                    journal.record(
+                        "process_stopped", process=task.name, reason=global_reason
+                    )
+            break
+        if now - last_gpu_sample >= 5 and any(
+            task.status == "running" and task.gpu_uuid is not None for task in running
+        ):
+            gpu_usage = _gpu_process_memory()
+            for task in running:
+                if task.status == "running" and task.gpu_uuid is not None:
+                    observed = gpu_usage.get((task.gpu_uuid, task.process.pid))
+                    if observed is not None:
+                        task.gpu_peak_mib = max(task.gpu_peak_mib or 0, observed)
+            last_gpu_sample = now
+        for task in running:
+            if task.status != "running":
+                continue
+            task.rss_peak = max(
+                task.rss_peak, process_group_rss_bytes(task.process.pid)
+            )
+            reason = None
+            if now >= task.deadline:
+                reason = "process deadline reached"
+            elif task.rss_peak > JOB_RSS_LIMIT:
+                reason = "owned process-group RSS exceeded 24 GiB"
+            code = task.process.poll()
+            if reason:
+                terminate_owned(task.process)
+                code = task.process.returncode
+                task.status = "stopped_by_process_gate"
+                journal.record("process_stopped", process=task.name, reason=reason)
+            elif code is not None:
+                task.status = "completed" if code == 0 else "failed"
+            if task.status != "running":
+                task.log.flush()
+                os.fsync(task.log.fileno())
+                task.log.close()
+                results[task.name] = {
+                    "returncode": code,
+                    "status": task.status,
+                    "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - task.started,
+                    "peak_rss_bytes": task.rss_peak,
+                    "peak_gpu_process_memory_mib": task.gpu_peak_mib,
+                    "gpu_process_memory_attribution": (
+                        "matched_container_pid"
+                        if task.gpu_peak_mib is not None
+                        else "unknown_host_pid_namespace_reconciliation_required"
+                    ),
+                }
+                journal.record(
+                    "process_finished", process=task.name, **results[task.name]
+                )
+        if advance is not None:
+            advance(running, results)
+        if now - last_heartbeat >= HEARTBEAT_SECONDS or not any(
+            task.status == "running" for task in running
+        ):
+            journal.heartbeat(
+                active=[task.name for task in running if task.status == "running"],
+                cgroup_memory_current=snapshot["memory_current"],
+                cgroup_memory_peak=snapshot["memory_peak"],
+                memory_events=snapshot["memory_events"],
+                disk_free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(root).free,
+                owned_bytes=owned_bytes,
+            )
+            last_heartbeat = now
+        if any(task.status == "running" for task in running):
+            time.sleep(min(5, max(0, global_deadline - time.monotonic())))
+    return results

+"""CPU tests for exclusive rolling admission, draining, and real callback supervision."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import io
+import json
+import sys
+import time

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import rolling
+from journal import Journal
+from process_start import Running, start_owned
+

+
+
+def exercise_queue(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path, *, fail_first: bool
+) -> tuple:
+    panel = json.loads((Path(__file__).parents[1] / "PANEL.json").read_text())
+    for job in panel["jobs"]:
+        job["run_dir"] = str(tmp_path / "runs" / job["id"])
+    lanes = {}
+    starts = []
+    grades = []
+    clock = [0.0]
+    results = {}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "_runtime_paths", lambda *a: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "_validate_fit_receipt", lambda job: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "sha256_file", lambda path: "test-hash")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "_fit_binding", lambda root, job: {"job": job})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rolling,
+        "_export_one",
+        lambda root, paths, fit, deadline: {
+            "resource_admitted": True,
+            "status": "completed_validated",
+            "output_root": tmp_path,
+        },
+    )
+
+    def grade(root, paths, fold, fits, exports, deadline):
+        key = (fold, fits["wide"]["job"]["seed"])
+        assert key not in grades
+        grades.append(key)
+        return {"status": "graded", "fold": fold, "seed": key[1]}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "_grade_pair", grade)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rolling, "cgroup_snapshot", lambda: {"memory_events": {}, "memory_current": 0}
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "require_gpus", lambda *a: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rolling,
+        "actor_environment",
+        lambda root, run, uuid: {"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": uuid},
+    )
+
+    def launch(**kwargs):
+        uuid = kwargs["environment"]["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"]
+        assert uuid not in lanes, "Two active fits admitted to same GPU"
+        duration = 1.0 if "_wide_" in kwargs["name"] else 2.0
+        task = Running(
+            kwargs["name"],
+            SimpleNamespace(pid=500 + len(starts), returncode=0),
+            io.BytesIO(),
+            clock[0],
+            clock[0] + 100,
+            gpu_uuid=uuid,
+        )
+        lanes[uuid] = (clock[0] + duration, task)
+        starts.append((task.name, clock[0]))
+        return task
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "start_owned", launch)
+
+    def monitor(active, journal, root, deadline, baseline, paths, *, advance):
+        while lanes:
+            uuid, (end, task) = min(lanes.items(), key=lambda item: item[1][0])
+            clock[0] = end
+            del lanes[uuid]
+            failed = fail_first and not results
+            task.status = "failed" if failed else "completed"
+            task.log.close()
+            results[task.name] = {
+                "status": task.status,
+                "returncode": 1 if failed else 0,
+            }
+            advance(active, results)
+            assert len(lanes) <= 8
+        return results
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rolling, "_monitor", monitor)
+    result = rolling.run_rolling(
+        panel,
+        tmp_path,
+        tmp_path / "state",
+        Journal(tmp_path / "events.jsonl"),
+        time.monotonic() + 100,
+    )
+    return result, starts, grades
+
+
+def test_queue_fills_free_gpu_before_slower_initial_jobs_finish(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path
+) -> None:
+    result, starts, grades = exercise_queue(monkeypatch, tmp_path, fail_first=False)
+    assert result["status"] == "complete"
+    assert len(starts) == len({name for name, _ in starts}) == 60
+    assert len(grades) == 30
+    assert starts[8][1] == 1.0  # Deep initial fits are still running until time2.
+    assert result["remaining_not_admitted"] == 0
+
+
+def test_failure_stops_new_admission_and_drains_healthy_initial_fits(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path
+) -> None:
+    result, starts, _ = exercise_queue(monkeypatch, tmp_path, fail_first=True)
+    assert result["status"] == "partial"
+    assert len(starts) == 8
+    assert result["remaining_not_admitted"] == 52
+    assert (
+        sum(r["status"] == "fixed_epoch5_receipt_verified" for r in result["fits"]) == 7
+    )
+
+
+def test_real_process_monitor_replenishes_on_completion(monkeypatch, tmp_path) -> None:
+    snapshot = {"memory_events": {}, "memory_current": 0, "memory_peak": 0}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "cgroup_snapshot", lambda: snapshot)
+    cpu = min(__import__("os").sched_getaffinity(0))
+    active = []
+
+    def launch(name):
+        return start_owned(
+            name=name,
+            argv=[sys.executable, "-c", "print('owned process completed')"],
+            environment={"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin"},
+            cpus=(cpu,),
+            log_path=tmp_path / f"{name}.log",
+            timeout_seconds=20,
+        )
+
+    active.append(launch("first"))
+
+    def advance(tasks, results):
+        if "first" in results and len(tasks) == 1:
+            tasks.append(launch("second"))
+
+    result = runtime._monitor(
+        active,
+        Journal(tmp_path / "events.jsonl"),
+        tmp_path,
+        time.monotonic() + 30,
+        {},
+        [tmp_path],
+        advance=advance,
+    )
+    assert set(result) == {"first", "second"}
+    assert all(r["returncode"] == 0 for r in result.values())

+"""Execute the preregistered B300 R01 panel with verified inputs and grading."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+STATE = ROOT / "state/r01-execution-v3"
+sys.path[:0] = [str(PACKET / "control"), str(PACKET / "code")]
+from adapter_common import adapter_bundle_identity
+from journal import Journal, write_json_fsync
+from policy import sha256_file, validate_memory_budget
+from profiles import _validate_profile
+from rolling import run_rolling
+from runtime_gates import cgroup_snapshot, require_gpus, validate_python_runtime
+
+
+def verify_frozen() -> dict:
+    """Bind this invocation to the complete frozen controller and actor."""
+    manifest = json.loads((PACKET / "EXECUTION_MANIFEST.json").read_text())
+    for relative, expected in manifest["files"].items():
+        if sha256_file(PACKET / relative) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"Execution source changed: {relative}")
+    panel = json.loads((PACKET / "PANEL.json").read_text())
+    if adapter_bundle_identity() != panel["actor_bundle_identity"]:
+        raise ValueError("Actor bundle differs from preregistered panel")
+    return panel
+
+
+def await_preparation(journal: Journal, deadline: float) -> dict:
+    """Wait only for the existing bounded exact-data preparation attempt."""
+    prep = ROOT / "state/prep-v2"
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        if (prep / "FAILED.json").exists():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Input preparation failed: {(prep / 'FAILED.json').read_text()}"
+            )
+        if (prep / "COMPLETE.json").is_file():
+            result = json.loads((prep / "COMPLETE.json").read_text())
+            if result["status"] != "verified_all_frozen_memberships":
+                raise ValueError("Input membership gate did not pass")
+            return result
+        journal.heartbeat(phase="waiting_input_preparation")
+        time.sleep(15)
+    raise TimeoutError("Two-hour input preparation deadline expired")
+
+
+def profile_shapes(panel: dict, journal: Journal, deadline: float) -> list[dict]:
+    """Revalidate and reuse all four successful profiles; never refit for unit repair."""
+    gates = []
+    previous = ROOT / "state/r01-execution-v2"
+    initial = panel["jobs"][:8]
+    for sharing, gpu_by_arm in (
+        ("shared", {"wide": 0, "deep": 2}),
+        ("free", {"wide": 1, "deep": 3}),
+    ):
+        for arm, gpu in gpu_by_arm.items():
+            original = next(j for j in initial if j["fold"] == 0 and j["arm"] == arm)
+            location = next(j for j in initial if j["gpu_index"] == gpu)
+            job = {
+                **original,
+                "gpu_index": gpu,
+                "gpu_uuid": location["gpu_uuid"],
+                "cpu_ids_initial": location["cpu_ids_initial"],
+            }
+            base = previous / f"profile-{sharing}"
+            old = json.loads((base / "receipts" / f"profile-{arm}.json").read_text())
+            run = base / "profiles" / arm
+            log = base / "logs" / f"profile-{arm}.log"
+            if sha256_file(log) != old["log_sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError("Profile log changed after original admission")
+            producer = json.loads((run / "producer_receipt.json").read_text())
+            if producer["adapter_bundle_identity"] != panel["actor_bundle_identity"]:
+                raise ValueError("Profile used a different source/adapter")
+            gated = _validate_profile(job, old["process_result"], run, log)
+            if gated["producer_receipt_sha256"] != old["producer_receipt_sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError("Profile producer changed after admission")
+            gated["reused_from"] = str(base)
+            gates.append(gated)
+            journal.record("profile_revalidated_reused", arm=arm, sharing=sharing)
+    peaks = {
+        arm: max(
+            g["process_result"]["peak_rss_bytes"] for g in gates if g["arm"] == arm
+        )
+        for arm in ("wide", "deep")
+    }
+    snapshot = cgroup_snapshot()
+    projected = validate_memory_budget(
+        snapshot["memory_max"],
+        snapshot["memory_current"],
+        peaks["wide"],
+        peaks["deep"],
+        headroom=16 * 1024**3,
+    )
+    write_json_fsync(
+        STATE / "receipts/profile-admission.json",
+        {"gates": gates, "projected_memory_bytes": projected, "snapshot": snapshot},
+    )
+    return gates
+
+
+def forecast_panel(
+    panel: dict, gates: list[dict], journal: Journal, deadline: float
+) -> None:
+    """Convert profiler milliseconds and forecast fixed per-GPU lane workloads."""
+    import math
+
+    seconds = {}
+    for arm in ("wide", "deep"):
+        values = []
+        for gate in (g for g in gates if g["arm"] == arm):
+            timing = gate["timings"]
+            value = timing["step_wall"] / 1000
+            if not math.isclose(value, 8 / timing["seq_per_s"], rel_tol=0.02):
+                raise ValueError("Profile milliseconds disagree with sequences/second")
+            values.append(value)
+        seconds[arm] = max(values)
+    lanes = {job["gpu_uuid"]: 0.0 for job in panel["jobs"]}
+    individual = []
+    for job in panel["jobs"]:
+        split = json.loads((ROOT / "splits" / f"fold{job['fold']}.json").read_text())
+        count = sum(len(split["fit"][name]) for name in ("train", "valid"))
+        estimate = 1.25 * 6 * math.ceil(count / 8) * seconds[job["arm"]] + 300
+        lanes[job["gpu_uuid"]] += estimate
+        individual.append(estimate)
+    projected = max(lanes.values()) + 8 * 1800
+    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
+    result = {
+        "is_estimate": True,
+        "profile_timing_unit": "milliseconds",
+        "measured_batch_seconds": seconds,
+        "slowdown_multiplier": 1.25,
+        "per_gpu_lane_seconds": lanes,
+        "longest_fit_seconds": max(individual),
+        "postprocess_reserve_seconds": 8 * 1800,
+        "projected_panel_seconds": projected,
+        "remaining_seconds": remaining,
+        "queue_policy": "fixed GPU lanes, no global wave barrier",
+    }
+    write_json_fsync(STATE / "receipts/wall-forecast.json", result)
+    journal.record("panel_wall_forecast", **result)
+    if projected > remaining or max(individual) > panel["max_fit_seconds"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("Measured queue projection exceeds the frozen time envelope")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run all cells without outcome-based stopping, preserving every attempt."""
+    os.sched_setaffinity(0, set(range(16)))
+    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    journal = Journal(STATE / "events.jsonl")
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    panel = verify_frozen()
+    deadline = start + panel["max_campaign_seconds"]
+    try:
+        snapshot = cgroup_snapshot()
+        if (
+            snapshot["memory_max"] != panel["memory_max_bytes"]
+            or snapshot["swap_max"] != 0
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("Own unit memory/swap limits differ from frozen panel")
+        if snapshot["pids_max"] != 512 or snapshot["cpu_affinity"] != list(range(16)):
+            raise RuntimeError("Own unit process/CPU limits differ from frozen panel")
+        runtime = validate_python_runtime()
+        require_gpus(panel["jobs"][:8])
+        write_json_fsync(
+            STATE / "receipts/start.json",
+            {
+                "runtime": runtime,
+                "cgroup": snapshot,
+                "panel_sha256": sha256_file(PACKET / "PANEL.json"),
+            },
+        )
+        await_preparation(journal, min(deadline, start + 7200))
+        gates = profile_shapes(panel, journal, deadline)
+        forecast_panel(panel, gates, journal, deadline)
+        journal.record("all_shape_profiles_passed", science_fits_started=False)
+        result = run_rolling(panel, ROOT, STATE, journal, deadline)
+        write_json_fsync(STATE / "RESULT.json", result)
+        if result["status"] != "complete":
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Panel delivery partial; completed weights retained, failed attempts need diagnosis"
+            )
+        write_json_fsync(STATE / "COMPLETE.json", result)
+        journal.record("panel_complete", cells=60)
+    except BaseException as error:
+        write_json_fsync(
+            STATE / "FAILED.json",
+            {
+                "error_type": type(error).__name__,
+                "error": str(error),
+                "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - start,
+            },
+        )
+        journal.record(
+            "execution_failed", error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)
+        )
+        raise
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Thin tabdata L4 trainer bridge
+
+## Canonical L4 input reconstruction
+
+The original main-branch split manifests are tracked at `research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold{0,1,2,3}.json`; there is no tracked `chains.npz`, `chain_folds.npz`, or target-cache payload. `validate_l4_targets.py` checks target row-group order, every target row's sequence ID and values against the Parquets, valid-mask alignment against both mask sources, and each target index against the sequence IDs in all four exact-hash canonical manifests. Its preflight receipt records whole-file train/valid/valid-mask hashes. Manifest generation is blocked unless the raw train and valid Parquets match the frozen R4 SHA-256 identities.
+
+The graph is regenerated only from the pinned a266 `scripts/sequence_chains.py` and `src/wnn/data.py`. `derive_l4_folds.py` checks the normalized script/data source hashes, the staged executable script hash, the preflight receipt and exact canonical graph size/SHA before deriving folds. A graph hash mismatch is a hard error; matching component labels alone cannot override it. The helper then checks all four original manifests' graph-node components and derives fold membership, rejecting incomplete folds or validation components split across folds. `canonical_manifest_checks.py` is the final gate after fresh manifests are built: it requires exact equality for the full `sequences`, `fit`, `evaluation`, and `excluded` objects in every fold, while allowing attempt-local source metadata and manifest hashes to differ.
+
+From the pinned a266 checkout and a fresh prep root (substitute controller-owned paths), stage the raw Parquets under `<prep>/datasets/`, and create `<prep>/cache/` and `<prep>/scripts/`. Extract the four canonical manifests from the frozen repository revision into `<prep>/canonical/`. Then run:
+
+```bash
+mkdir -p <prep>/canonical <prep>/cache <prep>/scripts <prep>/receipts
+for fold in 0 1 2 3; do
+  git -C <frozen-repo> show main:research/campaign_2026-09-29/artifacts/splits/fold${fold}.json \
+    > <prep>/canonical/fold${fold}.json
+done
+cp <a266-source>/scripts/cache_targets.py <prep>/scripts/cache_targets.py
+cp <a266-source>/scripts/sequence_chains.py <prep>/scripts/sequence_chains.py
+PYTHONPATH=<a266-source>/src python <prep>/scripts/cache_targets.py train
+PYTHONPATH=<a266-source>/src python <prep>/scripts/cache_targets.py valid
+python <packet>/validate_l4_targets.py \
+  --train-targets <prep>/cache/train_targets.npz --train-parquet <prep>/datasets/train.parquet \
+  --valid-targets <prep>/cache/valid_targets.npz --valid-parquet <prep>/datasets/valid.parquet \
+  --valid-mask-parquet <prep>/datasets/valid_mask.parquet \
+  --canonical-dir <prep>/canonical --receipt <prep>/receipts/input-preflight.json
+PYTHONPATH=<a266-source>/src WNN_THREADS=2 python <prep>/scripts/sequence_chains.py
+python <packet>/derive_l4_folds.py --graph <prep>/cache/chains.npz \
+  --canonical-dir <prep>/canonical --source-root <a266-source> \
+  --executed-script <prep>/scripts/sequence_chains.py \
+  --input-preflight <prep>/receipts/input-preflight.json \
+  --output <prep>/cache/chain_folds.npz --receipt <prep>/receipts/folds.json
+PYTHONPATH=<a266-source>/src python <a266-source>/scripts/build_campaign_splits.py \
+  --root <prep> --output-dir <attempt>/splits
+python <packet>/canonical_manifest_checks.py \
+  --canonical-dir <prep>/canonical --fresh-dir <attempt>/splits
+```
+
+The canonical graph gate expects 650,142 bytes and SHA-256 `39aba46fad7b717830e90687e1c4a6991794864cd2cf621b0bbf341f2d9a7766`. The fold output may have new NPZ container bytes; the receipt labels this as `new_attempt_local_reencoded` with a reason. Keep fresh manifests as a separate attempt identity and do not label them with the old R4 manifest hashes. Because manifests are generated against the actual L4 data root and preserve its current metadata, use that root directly; do not add a portable full-file registry pass that would rescan the 35 GB Parquets for each fit. The preflight receipt and membership comparison are required before any profile or fit. The focused CPU tests cover graph-hash rejection, cross-fold component rejection, row-group ordering and canonical sequence-index disagreement; they do not claim that an L4 fit or profile ran.
+
+`train_cell.py` invokes the canonical `a266b036b02e8e012c6eb31072291dad618a169d` trainer through its existing `TrainingEnvironment` and `run_training` API. It does not copy the trainer or alter its fit loop. `command_builder.json` pins the R4 rank-1 recipe hash, the separate canonical 61-file trainer identity, the complete deployed source-tree manifest, wide/deep shapes, training settings, output contract and profile/fit/resume argv additions.
+
+The controller must create `WNN_RUN_DIR` as a fresh empty per-attempt directory before invoking the GPU wrapper. The bridge receives distinct `--source-root`, `--data-root` and `--split-manifest` paths. It sets `TrainingEnvironment.source_root` to the frozen source checkout and `.root` to `WNN_RUN_DIR`; this keeps `artifacts/runs/<name>` and grade outputs local to the attempt. `datasets/` is a directory symlink to the supplied data tree. `cache/` is a local writable overlay with symlinks for `chains.npz`, `chain_folds.npz`, `train_targets.npz` and `valid_targets.npz`, so the grader can write predictions without mutating the shared input cache. Both target indexes are required by the canonical split loader's complete source-identity checks. No parquet or cache payload is copied.
+
+Example argv template for a profile (the host paths and `WNN_RUN_DIR` are supplied by the controller):
+
+```text
+WNN_RUN_DIR=<fresh-fit-attempt> python gpu_entrypoint.py train_cell.py \
+  --source-root <frozen-a266-source> --data-root <verified-data-root> \
+  --split-manifest <verified-split>/fold0.json --arm wide --fold 0 --seed 1002 \
+  --mode profile
+```
+
+`--prepare-only` builds symlinks and writes `command.json` plus `adapter_preflight.json` without importing PyTorch or fitting. Profile mode adds three finite profile steps and emits `PROFILE` / `PROFILE_UPDATE_EVIDENCE` to the controller log; the producer receipt deliberately says `profile_completed_check_controller_log`, so the controller must validate those records before admitting a fit. Fit mode runs the full six-epoch schedule, fixed epoch 5, strict FP32, batch 8, chunk 2000, seeded ordering, and no fit-time evaluation. It saves `training_state.pt` at each epoch boundary. Resume mode requires the existing state file and the same per-run workspace; the trainer validates the continuation contract.
+
+Before training and export, the bridge checks every regular file under deployed `src/`, `scripts/` and `configs/` against `a266_deployed_tree_manifest.json`, generated from the frozen a266 archive (533 files, archive SHA256 `420395e9fd1206ec0466c8304b80dc095e9d416b97752ebfe39ac53a78e5b2b1`). This catches changes in imported behavior-bearing modules such as `wnn.nn`, `features`, `data`, `optim`, `splits` and `resources`, plus added or missing files. The separate canonical 61-file manifest remains unchanged for exact `training_source_identity` provenance. Both identities and manifest pins are carried through preflight, commands and receipts. The check works without `.git`. Bytecode generation is disabled so importing the frozen source does not create unmanifested `__pycache__` files.
+
+`gpu_entrypoint.py` is the fit/export process wrapper: invoke it around each actor with `WNN_RUN_DIR` set to that actor's unique output root. It requires exactly one visible L4, sets strict FP32, caps the process allocator at 6 GiB, records peak GPU allocation, and sets `WNN_THREADS`, OMP, MKL, OpenBLAS and NumExpr pools to two before importing the actor. The actor also records these environment caps. The export predictor's frozen defaults are batch 16 and 4,000 steps per chunk, so the first completed-fit export is the exact-path resource admission run; inspect its successful `export_cell_resource_receipt.json` and peak allocation before authorizing further exports. Its allocator cap is a per-process limit, not a device reservation.
+
+The bridge also checks the split fold, required input files, data-root separation and exact symlink targets. It pins loader workers to zero, sets a 1 GiB loader budget and TF32-off environment flags, and records any controller-supplied `WNN_GPU_MEMORY_BYTES`.
+
+After a completed fit, `producer_receipt.json` binds the command and adapter hashes, verified trainer source manifest and the matching runtime trainer provenance identity, split/data ancestry, fit membership, epoch update counts, and SHA-256 plus byte size for all six `model_ep*.pt` snapshots, selected `model.pt`, `history.json`, `provenance.json` and `training_state.pt`. It rejects a run whose saved args differ from the frozen shape, fold, seed, optimizer budget or fixed checkpoint.
+
+## Feature-only export after a completed fit
+
+The trainer writes checkpoints and fit-only history. `export_cell.py` invokes the pinned a266 `scripts/predict_run.py` entrypoint, selecting only `evaluation.valid`, `--epoch 5` and `--inference-precision fp32`. That predictor's `FeatureOnlySequences` reads each sequence with `targets=False, mask=False`, and the checkpoint-bound campaign split determines exact output order. The wrapper checks the fixed-epoch fit receipt and checkpoint hash before export, then calls the unmodified R4 grader's `validate_prediction()` / `validate_export_manifest()` against the produced `.npy` and sidecar. It writes `export_receipt.json` with exact code, split, membership, prediction, sidecar and checkpoint hashes.
+
+Example command for one completed fit (paths are supplied by the controller):
+
+```text
+WNN_RUN_DIR=<fresh-export-root> python gpu_entrypoint.py export_cell.py \
+  --source-root <frozen-a266-source> --run-dir <completed-fit-root> \
+  --export-dir <fresh-export-root> \
+  --split-manifest <verified-split>/fold0.json --run-name tabdata_l4_r1_wide_f0_s1002 \
+  --fold 0 --seed 1002 --grader-script <repo>/research/campaign_2026-10-18/priority25_execution_r4/code/grade_endpoint.py
+```
+
+The separate export workspace has a local writable prediction cache and links to the fit's immutable artifacts, datasets and frozen cache inputs. If an export fails, preserve that failed export attempt and retry with a new `--export-dir` linked to the same completed `--run-dir`; do not rerun a valid fit just to regenerate predictions. The first resource-admission export may write a full prediction artifact, but only one actor is admitted until its process receipt is inspected.
+
+This wrapper validates an export but does not score labels; the separate R4 grade command remains downstream. The trainer, predictor, R4 grader and all adapter helper files are content-hashed into command and producer receipts. The bridge packet has only been checked locally; it records no L4 profile, fit, export or score.
+
+This local packet contains bridge design and static checks only. It records no L4 profile, fit, export, score or remote action.

+"""Shared hashes, source pins and safe JSON/symlink helpers for the tabdata bridge."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+_NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\Z")
+_CACHE_INPUTS = (
+    "chains.npz",
+    "chain_folds.npz",
+    "train_targets.npz",
+    "valid_targets.npz",
+)
+_CODE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+_RECIPE = _CODE_DIR / "command_builder.json"
+_SOURCE_MANIFEST = _CODE_DIR / "a266_source_manifest.json"
+_TREE_MANIFEST = _CODE_DIR / "source_package_manifest.json"
+THREAD_ENVIRONMENT = {
+    "WNN_THREADS": "2",
+    "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+    "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+    "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+    "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+}
+_ADAPTER_BUNDLE_FILES = (
+    "adapter_common.py",
+    "source_package_verify.py",
+    "fit_recipe.py",
+    "fit_workspace.py",
+    "fit_receipt.py",
+    "train_cell.py",
+    "export_contract.py",
+    "export_cell.py",
+    "gpu_entrypoint.py",
+    "command_builder.json",
+    "a266_source_manifest.json",
+    "source_package_manifest.json",
+)
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise TypeError(f"expected a JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    temporary = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.{os.getpid()}.tmp")
+    with temporary.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def verify_source_manifest(
+    source_root: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify the portable a266 file set without requiring a Git checkout."""
+    if manifest.get("schema") != "tabdata-l4-source-manifest.v1":
+        raise ValueError("unsupported frozen trainer source manifest")
+    expected_files = manifest.get("files")
+    if not isinstance(expected_files, dict) or not expected_files:
+        raise ValueError("frozen trainer source manifest has no file hashes")
+    actual_paths = {
+        "scripts/train_rnn.py",
+        "src/wnn/training/README.md",
+        "pyproject.toml",
+        "uv.lock",
+    }
+    actual_paths.update(
+        path.relative_to(source_root).as_posix()
+        for path in (source_root / "src/wnn/training").glob("*.py")
+    )
+    actual_files: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for relative in sorted(actual_paths):
+        path = source_root / relative
+        if not path.is_file():
+            if relative in expected_files:
+                raise ValueError(f"frozen trainer source file is missing: {relative}")
+            continue
+        actual_files[relative] = _sha256(path)
+    if actual_files != expected_files:
+        missing = sorted(set(expected_files) - set(actual_files))
+        extra = sorted(set(actual_files) - set(expected_files))
+        changed = sorted(
+            path
+            for path in set(actual_files) & set(expected_files)
+            if actual_files[path] != expected_files[path]
+        )
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"trainer source differs from frozen manifest (missing={missing}, "
+            f"extra={extra}, changed={changed})"
+        )
+    encoded = json.dumps(actual_files, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode(
+        "utf-8"
+    )
+    identity = hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+    if identity != manifest.get("source_identity_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "trainer source aggregate identity does not match its file manifest"
+        )
+    return {
+        "schema": manifest["schema"],
+        "source_revision_expected": manifest.get("source_revision"),
+        "source_identity_sha256": identity,
+        "file_count": len(actual_files),
+        "files": actual_files,
+    }
+
+
+def apply_thread_environment() -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Bound CPU-side PyTorch and math-library pools before importing Torch."""
+    os.environ.update(THREAD_ENVIRONMENT)
+    return dict(THREAD_ENVIRONMENT)
+
+
+def verify_deployed_tree_manifest(
+    source_root: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any], *, manifest_sha256: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify the declared normalized subset; retain the upstream archive lineage."""
+    from source_package_verify import verify_source_package
+
+    return verify_source_package(source_root, manifest, manifest_sha256=manifest_sha256)
+
+
+def _link(link: Path, target: Path, *, directory: bool) -> None:
+    target = target.resolve(strict=True)
+    if link.is_symlink():
+        if link.resolve(strict=True) != target:
+            raise ValueError(f"workspace input link points elsewhere: {link}")
+        return
+    if link.exists():
+        raise ValueError(f"refusing to replace a pre-existing workspace path: {link}")
+    link.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=directory)
+
+
+def adapter_bundle_identity() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Hash the complete producer/export adapter set and its frozen input pins."""
+    files = {name: _sha256(_CODE_DIR / name) for name in sorted(_ADAPTER_BUNDLE_FILES)}
+    encoded = json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    recipe = _json(_RECIPE)
+    tree_manifest = _json(_TREE_MANIFEST)
+    tree_manifest_sha256 = _sha256(_TREE_MANIFEST)
+    if recipe.get("source_tree_manifest_sha256") != tree_manifest_sha256 or recipe.get(
+        "expected_source_tree_identity_sha256"
+    ) != tree_manifest.get("deployed_tree_identity_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "adapter bundle and deployed source-tree manifest pins disagree"
+        )
+    return {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-adapter-bundle.v1",
+        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),
+        "files": files,
+        "source_tree_manifest_sha256": tree_manifest_sha256,
+        "source_tree_identity_sha256": tree_manifest["deployed_tree_identity_sha256"],
+        "source_tree_archive_sha256": tree_manifest["archive_sha256"],
+    }

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Validate canonical sequence identities and compare fresh split memberships."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from derive_l4_folds import MANIFEST_SHA256
+
+MEMBERSHIP_FIELDS = ("fit", "evaluation", "excluded", "sequences")
+
+
+def load_canonical_manifests(directory: Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+    """Load the four pinned manifests after checking their exact content hashes."""
+    manifests = []
+    for fold, expected_sha in MANIFEST_SHA256.items():
+        path = directory / f"fold{fold}.json"
+        payload = path.read_bytes()
+        if len(payload) > 2_000_000 or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != expected_sha:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical manifest fold{fold} identity mismatch")
+        manifest = json.loads(payload)
+        if manifest.get("fold") != fold or manifest.get("n_folds") != 4:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical manifest fold{fold} metadata mismatch")
+        manifests.append(manifest)
+    return manifests
+
+
+def validate_manifest_sequence_ids(
+    manifests: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
+    split: str,
+    row_groups: Sequence[int],
+    sequence_ids: Sequence[int],
+) -> None:
+    """Require every canonical fold's sequence map to match the target cache index."""
+    if split not in {"train", "valid"}:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported source split: {split}")
+    if len(row_groups) != len(sequence_ids):
+        raise ValueError("target row groups and sequence IDs differ in length")
+    expected: dict[int, int] | None = None
+    for fold, manifest in enumerate(manifests):
+        sequences = manifest.get("sequences")
+        if not isinstance(sequences, Mapping) or split not in sequences:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical fold{fold} lacks {split} sequence identities")
+        rows = sequences[split]
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical fold{fold} {split} sequence rows are malformed")
+        current: dict[int, int] = {}
+        for row in rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
+                raise ValueError(f"canonical fold{fold} {split} row is malformed")
+            group, sequence_id = int(row["row_group"]), int(row["seq_ix"])
+            if group in current:
+                raise ValueError(f"canonical fold{fold} repeats {split} row group {group}")
+            current[group] = sequence_id
+        if expected is None:
+            expected = current
+        elif expected != current:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical fold{fold} {split} sequence IDs differ across folds")
+    if expected is None:
+        raise ValueError("no canonical manifests were provided")
+    actual = dict(zip(map(int, row_groups), map(int, sequence_ids), strict=True))
+    if actual != expected:
+        groups = sorted(set(expected) | set(actual))
+        mismatch = next(
+            (group for group in groups if expected.get(group) != actual.get(group)), None
+        )
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{split} target index disagrees with canonical seq_ix at row group {mismatch}"
+        )
+
+
+def compare_fold_memberships(canonical_dir: Path, fresh_dir: Path) -> list[dict[str, int]]:
+    """Require new manifests to preserve every original fit/evaluation/exclusion membership."""
+    canonical = load_canonical_manifests(canonical_dir)
+    comparisons = []
+    for fold, original in enumerate(canonical):
+        fresh_path = fresh_dir / f"fold{fold}.json"
+        fresh = json.loads(fresh_path.read_bytes())
+        if fresh.get("fold") != fold or fresh.get("n_folds") != 4:
+            raise ValueError(f"fresh manifest fold{fold} metadata mismatch")
+        assert_memberships_equal(original, fresh, fold)
+        comparisons.append({"fold": fold, "membership_fields_checked": len(MEMBERSHIP_FIELDS)})
+    return comparisons
+
+
+def assert_memberships_equal(
+    canonical: Mapping[str, object], fresh: Mapping[str, object], fold: int
+) -> None:
+    """Reject any changed fit, evaluation, exclusion, or source sequence membership."""
+    for field in MEMBERSHIP_FIELDS:
+        if canonical.get(field) != fresh.get(field):
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} {field} membership differs from canonical")
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Compare all four regenerated folds with the immutable canonical memberships."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--canonical-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--fresh-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    result = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-l4-membership-comparison.v1",
+        "status": "exact_membership_match",
+        "folds": compare_fold_memberships(args.canonical_dir, args.fresh_dir),
+    }
+    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Derive fold assignments from the pinned graph and canonical manifests."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from l4_source_preflight import validate_graph_source, validate_input_preflight
+
+GRAPH_SHA256 = "39aba46fad7b717830e90687e1c4a6991794864cd2cf621b0bbf341f2d9a7766"
+GRAPH_BYTES = 650142
+ORIGINAL_FOLD_SHA256 = "a2cfe843a7ce3085d383524a9d1438154fba4f2e0af6df48ee1e1b015e5c942f"
+DERIVED_FOLD_SHA256 = "a112f809259f631c2ee7c12480e4ec1d4eef197a980e7ce23c707d842d092567"
+MANIFEST_SHA256 = {
+    0: "09263ad4fe2b18e2b2f3b79f4562678dce801b067b868134ddc79279f9316a3d",
+    1: "31b9dc040761dcc81e99bfe69e0bc446f1522b21ab629b2a9c5a03d94bb006ae",
+    2: "a9973e5798d3109362571c299b2d08eca71d01e92008da39b0d0ddde54c93aa9",
+    3: "78157b3347b9e9ba6d2c075d0c53df612e67af9ecd5ee8af7fd7957e406b8343",
+}
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a file incrementally."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def graph_components(successors: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return deterministic undirected component IDs for successor edges."""
+    edges = np.asarray(successors)
+    if edges.ndim != 1 or edges.dtype.kind not in "iu":
+        raise ValueError("graph next array must be a one-dimensional integer array")
+    if np.any(edges < -1) or np.any(edges >= len(edges)):
+        raise ValueError("graph has an out-of-range successor")
+    parents = np.arange(len(edges))
+
+    def root(index: int) -> int:
+        while parents[index] != index:
+            parents[index] = parents[parents[index]]
+            index = int(parents[index])
+        return index
+
+    for index, successor in enumerate(edges):
+        if successor >= 0:
+            left, right = root(index), root(int(successor))
+            parents[max(left, right)] = min(left, right)
+    roots = np.array([root(index) for index in range(len(edges))])
+    return np.unique(roots, return_inverse=True)[1]
+
+
+def validate_graph_identity(digest: str, byte_count: int) -> None:
+    """Reject graph bytes that are not the frozen canonical graph."""
+    if digest != GRAPH_SHA256 or byte_count != GRAPH_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "graph identity mismatch; regenerate with pinned a266 sequence_chains.py "
+            "and exact train/valid parquet hashes before deriving folds"
+        )
+
+
+def fold_partition(
+    component_by_node: dict[tuple[str, int], int],
+    evaluation_by_fold: dict[int, set[int]],
+    valid_groups: set[int],
+) -> dict[int, int]:
+    """Map components to one fold after enforcing a complete disjoint partition."""
+    assigned = [group for groups in evaluation_by_fold.values() for group in groups]
+    if len(assigned) != len(set(assigned)) or set(assigned) != valid_groups:
+        raise ValueError("canonical folds are not a disjoint complete valid partition")
+    if set(evaluation_by_fold) != set(range(4)):
+        raise ValueError("canonical folds must contain exactly folds 0 through 3")
+    fold_by_group = {group: fold for fold, groups in evaluation_by_fold.items() for group in groups}
+    component_folds: dict[int, set[int]] = {}
+    for (split, group), component in component_by_node.items():
+        if split == "valid":
+            component_folds.setdefault(component, set()).add(fold_by_group[group])
+    if any(len(folds) != 1 for folds in component_folds.values()):
+        raise ValueError("a canonical validation component crosses folds")
+    return {component: next(iter(folds)) for component, folds in component_folds.items()}
+
+
+def derive_folds(
+    graph_path: Path,
+    manifest_dir: Path,
+    output: Path,
+    receipt_path: Path,
+    source_root: Path,
+    executed_script: Path,
+    preflight_path: Path,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Derive the canonical fold cache without requiring an unavailable prior cache."""
+    if output.exists() or receipt_path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError("choose new fold-cache and receipt paths")
+    source_identity = validate_graph_source(source_root, executed_script)
+    preflight_identity = validate_input_preflight(preflight_path)
+    graph_sha, graph_bytes = sha256_file(graph_path), graph_path.stat().st_size
+    validate_graph_identity(graph_sha, graph_bytes)
+    with np.load(graph_path, allow_pickle=False) as loaded:
+        graph = {key: loaded[key] for key in loaded.files}
+    required = {"split", "row_group", "next"}
+    if not required <= graph.keys():
+        raise ValueError(f"graph lacks fields: {sorted(required - graph.keys())}")
+    splits = graph["split"]
+    if splits.dtype.kind == "S":
+        splits = np.char.decode(splits, "utf-8")
+    groups = np.asarray(graph["row_group"])
+    if (
+        splits.ndim != 1
+        or splits.dtype.kind != "U"
+        or groups.ndim != 1
+        or groups.dtype.kind not in "iu"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("graph source identities have invalid dtype or shape")
+    keys = list(zip(splits.tolist(), groups.astype(np.int64).tolist(), strict=True))
+    if len(keys) != len(set(keys)) or any(s not in {"train", "valid"} or g < 0 for s, g in keys):
+        raise ValueError("graph source-qualified identities are invalid or duplicated")
+    components = graph_components(graph["next"])
+    if len(components) != len(keys):
+        raise ValueError("graph successor list is not aligned with source identities")
+    graph_component = dict(zip(keys, components.tolist(), strict=True))
+    expected_nodes = set(keys)
+    canonical_nodes: dict[tuple[str, int], int] | None = None
+    eval_by_fold: dict[int, set[int]] = {}
+    manifest_records = []
+    for fold, expected_hash in MANIFEST_SHA256.items():
+        path = manifest_dir / f"fold{fold}.json"
+        payload = path.read_bytes()
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+        if digest != expected_hash or len(payload) > 2_000_000:
+            raise ValueError(f"canonical manifest fold{fold} identity mismatch")
+        manifest = json.loads(payload)
+        sources = manifest.get("sources", {})
+        graph_source = sources.get("cache/chains.npz", {})
+        folds_source = sources.get("cache/chain_folds.npz", {})
+        if graph_source.get("sha256") != GRAPH_SHA256 or graph_source.get("bytes") != GRAPH_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} does not bind canonical graph identity")
+        if folds_source.get("sha256") != ORIGINAL_FOLD_SHA256:
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} does not bind canonical original fold cache")
+        if (
+            manifest.get("version") != 1
+            or manifest.get("fold") != fold
+            or manifest.get("n_folds") != 4
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} manifest identity is malformed")
+        nodes: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
+        seqs = manifest.get("sequences", {})
+        if set(seqs) != {"train", "valid"}:
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} source-qualified nodes are incomplete")
+        for split in ("train", "valid"):
+            for row in seqs[split]:
+                key = (split, int(row["row_group"]))
+                if key in nodes:
+                    raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} duplicates graph node {key}")
+                nodes[key] = int(row["component"])
+        if set(nodes) != expected_nodes:
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} graph-node coverage differs")
+        for key, component in nodes.items():
+            if graph_component[key] != component:
+                raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} component differs at source-qualified node {key}")
+        if canonical_nodes is None:
+            canonical_nodes = nodes
+        elif canonical_nodes != nodes:
+            raise ValueError("canonical fold manifests disagree on graph nodes")
+        evaluation = manifest.get("evaluation", {}).get("valid")
+        if not isinstance(evaluation, list) or len(evaluation) != len(set(evaluation)):
+            raise ValueError(f"fold{fold} validation membership is malformed")
+        eval_by_fold[fold] = set(map(int, evaluation))
+        manifest_records.append({"fold": fold, "sha256": digest, "bytes": len(payload)})
+    valid_groups = {group for split, group in expected_nodes if split == "valid"}
+    fold_by_component = fold_partition(graph_component, eval_by_fold, valid_groups)
+    fold_values = np.asarray(
+        [fold_by_component.get(graph_component[key], 0) for key in keys], dtype=np.int8
+    )
+    arrays = {
+        "split": splits,
+        "row_group": groups.astype(np.int64),
+        "fold": fold_values,
+        "chain": components.astype(np.int64),
+    }
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with output.open("xb") as stream:
+        np.savez(stream, **arrays)
+        stream.flush()
+    result: dict[str, object] = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-l4-derived-fold-cache.v1",
+        "status": "verified_from_canonical_main_manifests",
+        "prior_fold_cache_used": False,
+        "graph": {"path": str(graph_path.resolve()), "bytes": graph_bytes, "sha256": graph_sha},
+        "graph_generation_source": source_identity,
+        "input_preflight": preflight_identity,
+        "canonical_manifests": manifest_records,
+        "identity_scope": "graph_and_derived_fold_cache_artifacts_only",
+        "derived_fields": list(arrays),
+        "derived_fold_array_sha256": hashlib.sha256(fold_values.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+        "output": {
+            "path": str(output.resolve()),
+            "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
+            "sha256": sha256_file(output),
+        },
+        "r4_expected_sha256": DERIVED_FOLD_SHA256,
+        "identity_class": "r4_exact"
+        if graph_sha == GRAPH_SHA256 and sha256_file(output) == DERIVED_FOLD_SHA256
+        else "new_attempt_local_reencoded",
+        "identity_mismatch_reasons": []
+        if sha256_file(output) == DERIVED_FOLD_SHA256
+        else ["derived fold cache archive encoding differs from the frozen R4 receipt"],
+        "required_next_step_if_reencoded": "build fresh source-bound campaign split manifests and compare all memberships; do not claim R4 manifest identity",
+    }
+    receipt_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return result
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Derive a new cache and write its source-identity receipt."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--graph", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--canonical-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--executed-script", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--input-preflight", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    result = derive_folds(
+        args.graph,
+        args.canonical_dir,
+        args.output,
+        args.receipt,
+        args.source_root,
+        args.executed_script,
+        args.input_preflight,
+    )
+    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+_SOURCE_MANIFEST = _CODE_DIR / "a266_source_manifest.json"

+"""Frozen predictor command and fit/split binding checks for feature-only export."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from adapter_common import _NAME, _json, _sha256
+
+
+def predictor_argv(script: Path, run_name: str, split_manifest: Path) -> list[str]:
+    """Select only the frozen fixed-epoch evaluation groups, using strict FP32."""
+    return [
+        str(script),
+        run_name,
+        "valid",
+        "--epoch",
+        "5",
+        "--campaign-split-manifest",
+        str(split_manifest),
+        "--campaign-evaluation-only",
+        "--device",
+        "cuda",
+        "--inference-precision",
+        "fp32",
+    ]
+
+
+def _load_grader(path: Path) -> Any:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tabdata_r4_grade_endpoint", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"cannot load the pinned R4 endpoint grader: {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _check_fit_binding(
+    run_dir: Path,
+    split_manifest: Path,
+    run_name: str,
+    fold: int,
+    seed: int,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    fit_receipt = _json(run_dir / "producer_receipt.json")
+    command = _json(run_dir / "command.json")
+    preflight = _json(run_dir / "adapter_preflight.json")
+    if (
+        fit_receipt.get("schema") != "tabdata-l4-fit-producer.v1"
+        or fit_receipt.get("status") != "completed_fixed_epoch5"
+        or fit_receipt.get("run_name") != run_name
+        or fit_receipt.get("fold") != fold
+        or fit_receipt.get("seed") != seed
+        or fit_receipt.get("selected_epoch") != 5
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("export requires the matching completed fixed-epoch-5 fit receipt")
+    if (
+        command.get("mode") not in {"fit", "resume"}
+        or command.get("run_name") != run_name
+        or command.get("fold") != fold
+        or command.get("seed") != seed
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("training command receipt does not identify this fit cell")
+    if not _NAME.fullmatch(run_name):
+        raise ValueError("invalid run name")
+    split_sha = _sha256(split_manifest)
+    ancestry = fit_receipt.get("input_ancestry", {})
+    if (
+        split_sha != preflight.get("split_manifest_sha256")
+        or split_sha != ancestry.get("split_manifest_sha256")
+        or preflight.get("fold") != fold
+        or ancestry.get("fold") != fold
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("export split manifest differs from the fitted workspace ancestry")
+    split = _json(split_manifest)
+    groups = split.get("evaluation", {}).get("valid")
+    if (
+        split.get("fold") != fold
+        or split.get("n_folds") != 4
+        or not isinstance(groups, list)
+        or any(type(group) is not int or group < 0 for group in groups)
+        or not groups
+        or len(set(groups)) != len(groups)
+        or groups != ancestry.get("evaluation_groups")
+        or groups != preflight.get("evaluation_groups")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("evaluation row groups differ from the exact frozen split order")
+    checkpoint_relative = f"artifacts/runs/{run_name}/model_ep5.pt"
+    recorded = fit_receipt.get("outputs", {}).get(checkpoint_relative)
+    checkpoint = run_dir / checkpoint_relative
+    if (
+        not isinstance(recorded, dict)
+        or recorded.get("sha256") != _sha256(checkpoint)
+        or not checkpoint.is_file()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fixed epoch-5 checkpoint differs from the completed fit receipt")
+    return fit_receipt, command, groups

+"""Validate fixed-epoch trainer provenance and checkpoint artifacts."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from adapter_common import _CODE_DIR, _json, _sha256
+
+
+def extract_fit_receipt(
+    run_dir: Path,
+    output_dir: Path,
+    *,
+    run_name: str,
+    arm: str,
+    fold: int,
+    seed: int,
+    input_receipt: dict[str, Any],
+    adapter_bundle_identity: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify and hash the fixed six-epoch outputs and their training ancestry."""
+    provenance_path = output_dir / "provenance.json"
+    history_path = output_dir / "history.json"
+    provenance = _json(provenance_path)
+    history = json.loads(history_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(history, list) or len(history) != 6:
+        raise ValueError("fit did not produce six epoch records")
+    args = provenance.get("args")
+    expected_shape = {"wide": (512, 1), "deep": (384, 2)}[arm]
+    if not isinstance(args, dict) or any(
+        args.get(key) != value
+        for key, value in {
+            "name": run_name,
+            "valid_fold": fold,
+            "seed": seed,
+            "epochs": 6,
+            "checkpoint_policy": "fixed",
+            "checkpoint_epoch": 5,
+            "no_eval_during_fit": True,
+            "precision": "fp32",
+            "hidden": expected_shape[0],
+            "layers": expected_shape[1],
+            "batch": 8,
+            "chunk": 2000,
+            "loss": "wmse",
+            "loss_norm": "chunk",
+            "batch_order": "seeded",
+            "sched": "onecycle",
+            "lr": 0.0001,
+            "beta2": 0.999,
+            "wd": 0.01,
+            "head_lr_mult": 1.0,
+            "clip": 1.0,
+            "sync_free": True,
+            "fused_adam": True,
+            "deterministic": True,
+        }.items()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("saved training provenance disagrees with the frozen recipe")
+    if args.get("init") or args.get("propensity") or args.get("prop_input"):
+        raise ValueError("labels-only arm unexpectedly acquired a model or propensity ancestor")
+    if args.get("distill_cache_root") or args.get("distill"):
+        raise ValueError("labels-only arm unexpectedly enabled distillation")
+    if provenance.get("split_manifest_sha256") != input_receipt["split_manifest_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("saved training provenance names a different split manifest")
+    if provenance.get("selected_epoch") != 5:
+        raise ValueError("trainer did not select the preregistered fixed epoch 5")
+    trainer_identity = provenance.get("trainer_implementation")
+    expected_identity = input_receipt.get("trainer_source_identity", {})
+    if (
+        not isinstance(trainer_identity, dict)
+        or trainer_identity.get("sha256") != expected_identity.get("source_identity_sha256")
+        or trainer_identity.get("files") != expected_identity.get("files")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("saved trainer provenance differs from the portable a266 source manifest")
+    fit = provenance.get("fit_row_groups")
+    if not isinstance(fit, dict):
+        raise ValueError("saved training provenance lacks fit membership")
+    if set(fit.get("train", ())) != set(input_receipt.get("fit_train_groups", ())):
+        raise ValueError("trainer fit train membership differs from the frozen split")
+    if set(fit.get("valid", ())) != set(input_receipt.get("fit_valid_groups", ())):
+        raise ValueError("trainer fit validation membership differs from the frozen split")
+    checkpoints = [f"model_ep{epoch}.pt" for epoch in range(6)] + ["model.pt"]
+    required = checkpoints + ["history.json", "provenance.json", "training_state.pt"]
+    files: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for name in required:
+        path = output_dir / name
+        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size <= 0:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"required trainer output missing or empty: {path}")
+        files[path.relative_to(run_dir).as_posix()] = {
+            "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
+            "sha256": _sha256(path),
+        }
+    epoch_updates = []
+    for record in history:
+        diagnostics = record.get("update_diagnostics", {})
+        epoch_updates.append(diagnostics.get("epoch", {}))
+        if record.get("evaluation") != "withheld":
+            raise ValueError("fit history contains an evaluation result")
+    return {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-fit-producer.v1",
+        "status": "completed_fixed_epoch5",
+        "run_name": run_name,
+        "arm": arm,
+        "fold": fold,
+        "seed": seed,
+        "selected_epoch": provenance.get("selected_epoch"),
+        "checkpoint_count": len(checkpoints),
+        "checkpoint_files": checkpoints,
+        "fit_group_counts": {key: len(value) for key, value in fit.items()},
+        "epoch_update_counts": epoch_updates,
+        "trainer_source_identity": provenance.get("trainer_implementation"),
+        "adapter_sha256": _sha256(_CODE_DIR / "train_cell.py"),
+        "adapter_bundle_identity": adapter_bundle_identity,
+        "input_ancestry": input_receipt,
+        "outputs": files,
+    }
