+"""Prepare an isolated run root with links to frozen input datasets/cache."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from adapter_common import _CACHE_INPUTS, _json, _link, _sha256
+
+
+def prepare_workspace(
+    run_dir: Path, data_root: Path, split_manifest: Path, fold: int
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Create a local output root with read-only input links and a writable cache overlay."""
+    run_dir = run_dir.resolve(strict=True)
+    data_root = data_root.resolve(strict=True)
+    if (
+        run_dir == data_root
+        or run_dir.is_relative_to(data_root)
+        or data_root.is_relative_to(run_dir)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("WNN_RUN_DIR and shared data root must be separate trees")
+    for name in ("train.parquet", "valid.parquet"):
+        if not (data_root / "datasets" / name).is_file():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(data_root / "datasets" / name)
+    split_manifest = split_manifest.resolve(strict=True)
+    split = _json(split_manifest)
+    if split.get("fold") != fold or split.get("n_folds") != 4:
+        raise ValueError("split manifest fold does not match the requested four-fold cell")
+    cache_source = data_root / "cache"
+    for name in _CACHE_INPUTS:
+        path = cache_source / name
+        if not path.is_file():
+            raise FileNotFoundError(path)
+    _link(run_dir / "datasets", data_root / "datasets", directory=True)
+
+    # Keep predictions and grader outputs local; only frozen inputs are symlinked.
+    cache_overlay = run_dir / "cache"
+    if cache_overlay.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError(
+            "cache must be a local workspace directory, not a shared-directory symlink"
+        )
+    cache_overlay.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    for name in _CACHE_INPUTS:
+        _link(cache_overlay / name, cache_source / name, directory=False)
+    source_identities = split.get("sources")
+    if not isinstance(source_identities, dict):
+        raise ValueError("split manifest lacks source identities")
+    return {
+        "schema": "tabdata-l4-inputs.v1",
+        "data_root": str(data_root),
+        "split_manifest": str(split_manifest),
+        "split_manifest_sha256": _sha256(split_manifest),
+        "fold": fold,
+        "n_folds": 4,
+        "fit_train_groups": split.get("fit", {}).get("train"),
+        "fit_valid_groups": split.get("fit", {}).get("valid"),
+        "evaluation_groups": split.get("evaluation", {}).get("valid"),
+        "source_identities": source_identities,
+        "cache_inputs": {
+            name: {
+                "path": str(cache_source / name),
+                "bytes": (cache_source / name).stat().st_size,
+                "mtime_ns": (cache_source / name).stat().st_mtime_ns,
+                "sha256": _sha256(cache_source / name)
+                if name in {"chains.npz", "chain_folds.npz"}
+                else None,
+            }
+            for name in _CACHE_INPUTS
+        },
+        "workspace_links": {
+            "datasets": str((run_dir / "datasets").resolve(strict=True)),
+            "cache_is_local_overlay": True,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def prepare_export_workspace(export_dir: Path, fit_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Create a fresh output root linked to immutable fit artifacts and frozen inputs."""
+    fit_dir = fit_dir.resolve(strict=True)
+    export_dir = export_dir.parent.resolve(strict=True) / export_dir.name
+    if not export_dir.parent.is_dir():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"export workspace parent must exist: {export_dir.parent}")
+    data_root = (fit_dir / "datasets").resolve(strict=True).parent.resolve(strict=True)
+    if (
+        export_dir in (fit_dir, data_root)
+        or export_dir.is_relative_to(fit_dir)
+        or fit_dir.is_relative_to(export_dir)
+        or export_dir.is_relative_to(data_root)
+        or data_root.is_relative_to(export_dir)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("export workspace must be separate from fit and shared data trees")
+    if export_dir.exists():
+        if not export_dir.is_dir() or any(export_dir.iterdir()):
+            raise FileExistsError(f"export workspace must be fresh and empty: {export_dir}")
+    else:
+        export_dir.mkdir()
+    _link(export_dir / "artifacts", fit_dir / "artifacts", directory=True)
+    _link(export_dir / "datasets", fit_dir / "datasets", directory=True)
+    cache = export_dir / "cache"
+    cache.mkdir()
+    for name in _CACHE_INPUTS:
+        _link(cache / name, fit_dir / "cache" / name, directory=False)
+    return {
+        "schema": "tabdata-l4-export-workspace.v1",
+        "export_dir": str(export_dir.resolve(strict=True)),
+        "fit_dir": str(fit_dir),
+        "artifacts_link": str((export_dir / "artifacts").resolve(strict=True)),
+        "datasets_link": str((export_dir / "datasets").resolve(strict=True)),
+        "cache_is_local_overlay": not cache.is_symlink(),
+    }
+
+
+def require_fresh_export_outputs(output_root: Path, run_name: str) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path]:
+    """Return output paths only when this export workspace has no prior attempt."""
+    if not output_root.is_dir():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"export workspace is missing: {output_root}")
+    prediction = output_root / "cache" / f"pred_{run_name}_valid.npy"
+    sidecar = prediction.with_suffix(".json")
+    receipt = output_root / "export_receipt.json"
+    command = output_root / "export_command.json"
+    if any(path.exists() for path in (prediction, sidecar, receipt, command)):
+        raise FileExistsError(
+            "export workspace already has output; use a fresh export workspace linked to this fit"
+        )
+    if (output_root / "cache").is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("prediction output cache must be local to the export workspace")
+    if not (output_root / "cache").is_dir():
+        raise FileNotFoundError("export workspace has no local writable cache directory")
+    return prediction, receipt, command

+"""Apply the controller's L4 process envelope before importing a fit/export actor."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import runpy
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Execute one actor in-process so the CUDA allocator limit remains effective."""
+    script = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
+    if script.parent != Path(__file__).resolve().parent or script.name not in {
+        "train_cell.py",
+        "export_cell.py",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("only the bundled fit and export entrypoints may run")
+    run_root = Path(os.environ["WNN_RUN_DIR"]).absolute()
+    run_root.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    run_root = run_root.parent.resolve(strict=True) / run_root.name
+    if run_root.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("process output root must not be a symlink")
+    if run_root.exists():
+        if not run_root.is_dir() or any(run_root.iterdir()):
+            raise FileExistsError(
+                f"process output root must be fresh and empty: {run_root}"
+            )
+    else:
+        run_root.mkdir(parents=True)
+    run_dir = run_root.resolve(strict=True)
+    for name in (
+        "WNN_THREADS",
+        "OMP_NUM_THREADS",
+        "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+        "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS",
+    ):
+        os.environ[name] = "2"
+    os.environ["NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS"] = "2"
+    os.environ["NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE"] = "0"
+    os.environ["TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE"] = "0"
+    os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
+    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+
+    # Numba caches are not controlled by PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE.
+    # Keep compiled kernels outside the exact-membership frozen source tree.
+    numba_cache = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "scratch/numba/a266-f4ef9ca8"
+    numba_cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.environ["NUMBA_CACHE_DIR"] = str(numba_cache)
+
+    import torch
+
+    if torch.cuda.device_count() != 1:
+        raise ValueError("each cell must see exactly one assigned CUDA device")
+    device = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0)
+    if "B300" not in device.name:
+        raise ValueError("this campaign entrypoint is bound to NVIDIA B300")
+    budget = 6 * 1024**3
+    os.environ["WNN_GPU_MEMORY_BYTES"] = str(budget)
+    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(budget / device.total_memory, 0)
+    torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float32)
+    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.set_num_threads(2)
+    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-process-envelope.v1",
+        "pid": os.getpid(),
+        "script": script.name,
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
+        "gpu": device.name,
+        "visible_devices": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
+        "cpu_affinity": sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
+        "torch_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
+        "allocator_budget_bytes": budget,
+        "allocator_limit_is_not_a_device_memory_reservation": True,
+        "numba_cache_dir": str(numba_cache),
+    }
+    print("PROCESS_ENVELOPE " + json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(script.parent))
+    sys.argv = [str(script), *sys.argv[2:]]
+    try:
+        runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name="__main__")
+        receipt["status"] = "actor_returned"
+    except BaseException as error:
+        receipt.update(status="actor_failed", error_type=type(error).__name__)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        receipt.update(
+            elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
+            cuda_peak_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(0),
+            cuda_peak_reserved_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(0),
+        )
+        path = run_dir / f"{script.stem}_resource_receipt.json"
+        with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2)
+            stream.write("\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Pin graph-regeneration source files and verify the raw-input preflight receipt."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+GRAPH_SOURCE_REVISION = "a266b036b02e8e012c6eb31072291dad618a169d"
+GRAPH_SOURCE_FILES = {
+    "scripts/sequence_chains.py": "09bf23adc40d948bf5459ceca1e6da9825eea35f6172918ff68e4f3cb2ddbfb1",
+    "src/wnn/data.py": "a93da840137adbd7afdb79a22687fb73150e77107f91ca2adc5211b854bc7e00",
+}
+RAW_PARQUET_IDENTITIES = {
+    "train": (29_240_219_011, "4a7756449a4bcf272cf715bb405a2152987041605f6c1cce650243ab2abf4e81"),
+    "valid": (5_615_509_128, "2861ee30914065702626a3ac033d80d0563cdacaea50c667fc828c2eeb418782"),
+}
+
+
+def validate_graph_source(source_root: Path, executed_script: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Check the exact a266 graph generator and feature-column source before derivation."""
+    files = {}
+    paths = {
+        "pinned_script": source_root / "scripts/sequence_chains.py",
+        "executed_script": executed_script,
+        "feature_source": source_root / "src/wnn/data.py",
+    }
+    for name, path in paths.items():
+        relative = "src/wnn/data.py" if name == "feature_source" else "scripts/sequence_chains.py"
+        expected = GRAPH_SOURCE_FILES[relative]
+        payload = path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+        if digest != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"pinned graph source mismatch: {name} ({path})")
+        files[name] = {
+            "path": str(path.resolve()),
+            "sha256_lf_normalized": digest,
+            "bytes": len(payload),
+        }
+    return {"revision": GRAPH_SOURCE_REVISION, "files": files}
+
+
+def validate_input_preflight(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Require exact whole-file input hashes and the valid-mask hash before fold derivation."""
+    payload = path.read_bytes()
+    receipt = json.loads(payload)
+    if receipt.get("preflight_status") != "verified_r4_raw_parquets":
+        raise ValueError("input preflight does not verify the frozen R4 raw Parquets")
+    if receipt.get("manifest_generation_allowed") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("input preflight does not authorize manifest generation")
+    for split in ("train", "valid"):
+        source = receipt.get(split, {}).get("parquet", {})
+        expected_bytes, expected_sha = RAW_PARQUET_IDENTITIES[split]
+        if (
+            source.get("bytes") != expected_bytes
+            or source.get("sha256") != expected_sha
+            or source.get("expected_r4_sha256") != expected_sha
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"input preflight {split} raw Parquet hash mismatch")
+    mask_source = receipt.get("valid", {}).get("valid_mask_parquet")
+    if not isinstance(mask_source, dict) or len(mask_source.get("sha256", "")) != 64:
+        raise ValueError("input preflight lacks the whole-file valid-mask Parquet identity")
+    return {
+        "path": str(path.resolve()),
+        "bytes": len(payload),
+        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
+    }

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+
+
+def verify_source_package(
+    source_root: Path, manifest: dict, *, manifest_sha256: str
+) -> dict:
+    """Verify every deployed LF source byte, including extra-file rejection."""
+    if manifest.get("schema") != "tabdata-deployed-subset-manifest.v1":
+        raise ValueError("unsupported source package")
+    expected = {k: v["deployed_sha256"] for k, v in manifest["files"].items()}
+    if manifest["file_count"] != len(expected):
+        raise ValueError("source package file count mismatch")
+    for name in expected:
+        path = PurePosixPath(name)
+        if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
+            raise ValueError("unsafe source package path")
+    actual = {}
+    for path in source_root.rglob("*"):
+        if path.is_symlink():
+            raise ValueError("source package symlink")
+        if path.is_file():
+            actual[path.relative_to(source_root).as_posix()] = hashlib.sha256(
+                path.read_bytes()
+            ).hexdigest()
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise ValueError("deployed source package bytes or membership differ")
+    identity = hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(actual, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+    if identity != manifest["deployed_subset_identity_sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("source package aggregate mismatch")
+    return {
+        "schema": manifest["schema"],
+        "source_revision": manifest["source_revision"],
+        "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha256,
+        "archive_sha256": manifest["archive_sha256"],
+        "deployed_tree_identity_sha256": identity,
+        "file_count": len(actual),
+        "whole_upstream_tree": False,
+        "normalization": manifest["normalization"],
+    }

+def test_source_package_rejects_mutation_and_extra_dependency(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    copy = tmp_path / "source"
+    shutil.copytree(SOURCE, copy)
+    manifest = json.loads((CODE / "source_package_manifest.json").read_text())
+    check = lambda: verify_source_package(copy, manifest, manifest_sha256="test")
+    assert check()["file_count"] == 147
+    extra = copy / "src/extra.py"
+    extra.write_text("raise RuntimeError('extra')")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="membership differ"):
+        check()
+    extra.unlink()
+    target = copy / "src/wnn/training/runner.py"
+    original = target.read_bytes()
+    target.write_bytes(original + b"\n# mutation\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="membership differ"):

+    target.write_bytes(original)

+    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--data-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--split-manifest", type=Path, required=True)

+    parser.add_argument("--run-name")
+    parser.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--resume-state", type=Path)
+    return parser.parse_args()

+def main() -> None:
+    """Bind workspace inputs, record argv, then invoke the canonical trainer."""

+    os.environ["WNN_LOADER_RAM_GB"] = "1"
+    os.environ["WNN_LOADER_WORKERS"] = "0"
+    os.environ["NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE"] = "0"
+    os.environ["TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE"] = "0"

+    recipe = _json(_RECIPE)

+    tree_manifest_sha256 = _sha256(_TREE_MANIFEST)

+    "train": (
+        1_909_335_790,
+        "ead1a05e7aa5ac3d1c10cde65986be9f48fd342cadb95330611e58c3a8f817e9",

+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a file incrementally."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def index_digest(row_groups: np.ndarray, sequence_ids: np.ndarray) -> str:
+    """Match the campaign manifest's source-qualified target-index digest."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    for values in (row_groups, sequence_ids):
+        digest.update(np.asarray(values, dtype="<i8").tobytes())
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+

+def validate_group_order(split: str, row_groups: np.ndarray, n_row_groups: int) -> list[int]:
+    """Require target row groups to follow source Parquet order."""
+    if split not in {"train", "valid"}:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported source split: {split}")
+    expected = [group for group in range(n_row_groups) if split != "train" or group != 528]
+    if np.asarray(row_groups).tolist() != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"{split} target row_group array differs from canonical parquet order")
+    return expected

+
+def validate_target_index(
+    split: str,

+        "valid_mask_parquet_mask_rows_checked": mask_checked,
+        "fresh_source_bound_manifest_required_if_reencoded": True,
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Validate both target caches and write their verified identities."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    for split in ("train", "valid"):

+        parser.add_argument(f"--{split}-parquet", type=Path, required=True)

+    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True)

+"""Small fsynced controller journal and atomic receipt helpers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+class Journal:
+    """Append durable phase events without rewriting prior controller state."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path):
+        self.path = path
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    def record(self, event: str, **fields: Any) -> None:
+        payload = {"time_unix": time.time(), "event": event, **fields}
+        line = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+        fd = os.open(self.path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
+        try:
+            os.write(fd, line.encode("utf-8"))
+            os.fsync(fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(fd)
+
+    def heartbeat(self, **fields: Any) -> None:
+        self.record("heartbeat", **fields)
+
+
+def write_json_fsync(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    """Publish a JSON receipt atomically and sync both file and containing directory."""
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+            stream.write("\n")
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(directory_fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(directory_fd)
+    except BaseException:
+        with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
+            os.unlink(temporary)
+        raise

+from typing import Any

+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one file without loading its contents into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+def control_bundle_digest(control_dir: Path) -> tuple[str, dict[str, str]]:
+    """Hash every flat Python module in the frozen controller bundle."""
+    files: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for path in sorted(control_dir.glob("*.py"), key=lambda item: item.name):
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise ValueError(f"control bundle entry is not a regular file: {path.name}")
+        files[path.name] = sha256_file(path)
+    if not files:
+        raise ValueError("control bundle has no top-level Python modules")
+    canonical = json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    return hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest(), files

+    if path.is_symlink() or control_dir.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("control manifest and module directory cannot be symlinks")
+    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if manifest.get("schema") != "tabdata-control-bundle.v1":
+        raise ValueError("control bundle manifest schema is not recognized")
+    digest, actual_files = control_bundle_digest(control_dir)
+    declared_files = manifest.get("files")
+    if not isinstance(declared_files, dict) or declared_files != actual_files:
+        raise ValueError("control bundle manifest files differ from local controller modules")
+    canonical = json.dumps(declared_files, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    declared_digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()
+    if manifest.get("sha256") != declared_digest or declared_digest != digest:
+        raise ValueError("control bundle manifest digest does not match local controller modules")

+"""Export completed fixed-epoch fits and grade only exact paired folds."""

+from __future__ import annotations

+    from .postprocess_fit import _fit_binding
+    from .postprocess_grade import _grade_pair
+except ImportError:  # Supports direct execution with control/ on sys.path.
+    from postprocess_common import (
+        _check_disk,
+        _remaining,
+        _runtime_paths,
+    )
+    from postprocess_export_run import _export_one
+    from postprocess_fit import _fit_binding

+def finish_cells(root: Path, jobs: list[dict[str, Any]], deadline: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Export completed fixed-epoch fits and grade only exact paired exported folds.
+
+    `jobs` contains the frozen heterogeneous JSON records from WAVE_PLAN. This function
+    never launches or retries a fit; existing failed export or grade attempts are retained.
+    """
+    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    if not math.isfinite(deadline):
+        raise ValueError("deadline must be a finite Unix epoch timestamp")
+    _check_disk(root)
+    if not jobs:
+        return {
+            "schema": "tabdata-b300-postprocess.v1",
+            "root": str(root),
+            "deadline_unix": deadline,
+            "status": "partial",
+            "exports": [],
+            "grades": [],
+            "resource_admission": False,
+            "stopped_reason": "no jobs supplied",
+        }
+    _remaining(deadline)
+    paths = _runtime_paths(root, jobs)
+    _remaining(deadline)
+    results: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-postprocess.v1",
+        "root": str(root),
+        "deadline_unix": deadline,
+        "status": "partial",
+        "exports": [],
+        "grades": [],
+        "resource_admission": False,
+        "stopped_reason": None,
+    }
+    fits: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    exports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for job in jobs:
+        try:
+            _remaining(deadline)
+            _check_disk(root)
+        except (OSError, TimeoutError) as error:
+            results["stopped_reason"] = str(error)

+        try:

+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:

+            )

+        admitted = bool(entry.pop("resource_admitted", False))
+        if admitted:
+            exports[run_name] = entry
+            results["resource_admission"] = True

+        )

+            )

+            )

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+try:
+    from .policy import ACTOR_SHA256, DISK_FREE_MIN
+except ImportError:  # Supports direct execution with control/ on sys.path.
+    from policy import ACTOR_SHA256, DISK_FREE_MIN
+
+GRADER_SHA256 = "56ffc693da52668726bab1f7008e31753a76aed3ff5d79089167785079d9eb31"
+SOURCE_TREE_SHA256 = "f4ef9ca8450a3e76d6b6f8295259e70aec5024d3a4f3296558bb0323add74130"
+SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "6f2d3188ae3c547976d6948044bfd97fe9036b12092ce675c5c779ea033791bd"
+GPU_BUDGET_BYTES = 6 * 1024**3
+EVAL_SHAPE_TAIL = [20_000, 2]
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected a JSON object at {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _write_new_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+
+
+def _remaining(deadline: float) -> float:
+    value = deadline - time.time()
+    if not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0:
+        raise TimeoutError("postprocess wall deadline has expired")
+    return value
+
+
+def _check_disk(root: Path) -> None:
+    if shutil.disk_usage(root).free < DISK_FREE_MIN:
+        raise OSError("owned physical disk is below the 8 GiB postprocess reserve")
+
+
+def _runtime_paths(root: Path, jobs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Path]:
+    runtime = root / "runtime"
+    actor_paths = []
+    for job in jobs:
+        argv = job.get("argv", [])
+        if isinstance(argv, list) and len(argv) > 1:
+            actor_paths.append(Path(str(argv[1])))
+    if actor_paths:
+        resolved_actors = {path.resolve(strict=True) for path in actor_paths}
+        if len(resolved_actors) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("wave jobs point to different frozen GPU actor bundles")
+        actor_path = resolved_actors.pop()
+        code = actor_path.parent
+        packet = code.parent
+        if actor_path.name != "gpu_entrypoint.py" or packet.parent.resolve(
+            strict=True
+        ) != runtime.resolve(strict=True):
+            raise ValueError("wave actor command is outside the deployed runtime packet")
+    else:
+        packet = runtime / "packet-r2"
+        code = packet / "code"
+    source = runtime / "source-a266-lf-subset-v1"
+    python = root / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"
+    paths = {
+        "packet": packet,
+        "code": code,
+        "source": source,
+        "python": python,
+        "grader": packet / "grader" / "grade_endpoint.py",
+    }
+    missing = [str(path) for path in paths.values() if not path.exists()]
+    if missing:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"postprocess runtime is incomplete: {missing}")
+    if _sha256(paths["grader"]) != GRADER_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("deployed R4 grader bytes differ from the frozen grader pin")
+    builder = _read_json(code / "command_builder.json")
+    manifest_path = code / str(builder.get("source_tree_manifest"))
+    if (
+        _sha256(manifest_path) != SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+        or builder.get("source_tree_manifest_sha256") != SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+        or builder.get("expected_source_tree_identity_sha256") != SOURCE_TREE_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("deployed source-tree manifest differs from its frozen pin")
+    files = {name: _sha256(code / name) for name in sorted(builder.get("adapter_bundle_files", []))}
+    bundle_sha = hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    ).hexdigest()
+    if bundle_sha != ACTOR_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("deployed actor bundle differs from the controller pin")
+    paths["builder"] = code / "command_builder.json"
+    paths["manifest"] = manifest_path
+    return paths
+
+
+def _child_environment(root: Path, gpu_uuid: str, output: Path, *, grading: bool) -> dict[str, str]:
+    keys = ("PATH", "HOME", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "CUDA_HOME")
+    env = {key: os.environ[key] for key in keys if key in os.environ}
+    env["PATH"] = str(root / ".venv" / "bin") + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
+    env.update(
+        {
+            "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "" if grading else gpu_uuid,
+            "WNN_RUN_DIR": str(output),
+            "WNN_THREADS": "2",
+            "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+            "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+            "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+            "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+            "WNN_LOADER_WORKERS": "0",
+            "WNN_LOADER_RAM_GB": "1",
+            "NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE": "0",
+            "TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE": "0",
+            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
+            "TMPDIR": str(output / "tmp"),
+        }
+    )
+    return env
+
+
+def _terminate_owned_process(process: subprocess.Popen[Any]) -> None:
+    """Terminate and reap only this child's process group (or process on Windows)."""
+    if os.name != "posix":
+        if process.poll() is None:
+            process.terminate()
+        try:
+            process.wait(timeout=5)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            process.kill()
+            process.wait()
+        return
+
+    with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
+        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+    grace_end = time.monotonic() + 5
+    while time.monotonic() < grace_end:
+        with contextlib.suppress(subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
+            process.wait(timeout=0.05)
+        try:
+            os.killpg(process.pid, 0)
+        except ProcessLookupError:
+            return
+        time.sleep(0.05)
+    with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
+        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+    process.wait()
+
+
+def _execute(
+    argv: list[str],
+    env: dict[str, str],
+    cwd: Path,
+    stdout_path: Path,
+    stderr_path: Path,
+    deadline: float,
+    cpus: list[int],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run one isolated actor with durable logs, a hard deadline and Wave CPU affinity."""
+    start = time.time()
+    _remaining(deadline)
+    stdout_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with stdout_path.open("xb") as stdout, stderr_path.open("xb") as stderr:
+        remaining = _remaining(deadline)
+        try:
+            process = subprocess.Popen(
+                argv,
+                cwd=cwd,
+                env=env,
+                stdout=stdout,
+                stderr=stderr,
+                start_new_session=(os.name == "posix"),
+                preexec_fn=(lambda: os.sched_setaffinity(0, set(cpus)))
+                if os.name == "posix"
+                else None,
+            )
+        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
+            status, exit_code, launch_error = "launch_failed", None, str(error)
+        else:
+            launch_error = None
+            try:
+                try:
+                    exit_code = process.wait(timeout=remaining)
+                    status = "exited"
+                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                    _terminate_owned_process(process)
+                    exit_code, status = None, "deadline_exceeded"
+                stdout.flush()
+                stderr.flush()
+                os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
+                os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
+            except BaseException:
+                _terminate_owned_process(process)
+                raise
+        if launch_error is not None:
+            stdout.flush()
+            stderr.flush()
+            os.fsync(stdout.fileno())
+            os.fsync(stderr.fileno())
+    if launch_error is not None:
+        return {"status": status, "exit_code": exit_code, "error": launch_error}
+    return {
+        "status": status,
+        "exit_code": exit_code,
+        "elapsed_seconds": time.time() - start,
+        "stdout": {
+            "path": str(stdout_path),
+            "bytes": stdout_path.stat().st_size,
+            "sha256": _sha256(stdout_path),
+        },
+        "stderr": {
+            "path": str(stderr_path),
+            "bytes": stderr_path.stat().st_size,
+            "sha256": _sha256(stderr_path),
+        },
+    }

+def _write_failure_receipt(
+    attempt_root: Path, fit: dict[str, Any], error: Exception, execution: dict[str, Any] | None

+    """Persist failed admission evidence so this export path is never retried."""
+    command = attempt_root / "postprocess_command.json"
+    stdout, stderr = (

+        "grader_sha256": GRADER_SHA256,

+    if command.is_file():

+    if stdout.is_file():
+        evidence["stdout_sha256"] = _sha256(stdout)
+    if stderr.is_file():

+def _export_one(

+                        "OMP_",

+                        "OPENBLAS_",
+                        "NUMEXPR_",
+                        "CUDA_",
+                        "NVIDIA_",
+                        "TORCH_",
+                        "PYTHON",
+                    )
+                )

+            "source_tree_identity_sha256": SOURCE_TREE_SHA256,
+            "fit_receipt_sha256": fit["fit_receipt_sha256"],
+            "checkpoint_sha256": fit["checkpoint_sha256"],
+            "split_manifest_sha256": fit["split_sha256"],

+        _check_disk(root)
+        execution = _execute(

+            "schema": "tabdata-b300-export-controller-receipt.v1",

+"""Receipt-bound admission of completed fixed-epoch fit cells."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+try:
+    from .postprocess_common import (
+        ACTOR_SHA256,
+        SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        SOURCE_TREE_SHA256,
+        _read_json,
+        _sha256,
+    )
+except ImportError:
+    from postprocess_common import (
+        ACTOR_SHA256,
+        SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        SOURCE_TREE_SHA256,
+        _read_json,
+        _sha256,
+    )
+
+_RUN_NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\Z")
+
+
+def _fit_binding(root: Path, job: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return only a completed fixed-epoch fit whose command, split and checkpoint bind."""
+    run_name = str(job.get("id", ""))
+    if not _RUN_NAME.fullmatch(run_name):
+        raise ValueError("invalid wave run id")
+    fold, seed, arm = job.get("fold"), job.get("seed"), job.get("arm")
+    if (
+        type(fold) is not int
+        or not 0 <= fold < 4
+        or type(seed) is not int
+        or arm
+        not in {
+            "wide",
+            "deep",
+        }
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid fold/seed/arm in job {run_name}")
+    supplied_run_dir = Path(str(job["run_dir"]))
+    if supplied_run_dir.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError(f"fit run directory cannot be a symlink: {supplied_run_dir}")
+    run_dir = supplied_run_dir.resolve(strict=True)
+    expected_run = (root / "runs" / run_name).resolve(strict=True)
+    if run_dir != expected_run:
+        raise ValueError(f"fit run directory is not the wave-owned path: {run_dir}")
+    fit_receipt = _read_json(run_dir / "producer_receipt.json")
+    if fit_receipt.get("status") != "completed_fixed_epoch5":
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} is not a completed fixed-epoch-5 cell")
+    expected_identity = {"run_name": run_name, "arm": arm, "fold": fold, "seed": seed}
+    if any(fit_receipt.get(key) != value for key, value in expected_identity.items()):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit receipt identity differs from wave job {run_name}")
+    if fit_receipt.get("selected_epoch") != 5:
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} does not bind the fixed epoch-5 endpoint")
+    bundle = fit_receipt.get("adapter_bundle_identity")
+    if not isinstance(bundle, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} has no adapter bundle identity")
+    if (
+        bundle.get("sha256") != ACTOR_SHA256
+        or bundle.get("source_tree_identity_sha256") != SOURCE_TREE_SHA256
+        or bundle.get("source_tree_manifest_sha256") != SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} does not bind the deployed actor and source tree")
+    command_path = run_dir / "command.json"
+    command = _read_json(command_path)
+    ancestry = fit_receipt.get("input_ancestry", {})
+    deployed_tree = command.get("deployed_source_tree", {})
+    if not isinstance(ancestry, dict) or not isinstance(deployed_tree, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} has malformed source ancestry")
+    if (
+        fit_receipt.get("command_sha256") != _sha256(command_path)
+        or command.get("mode") != "fit"
+        or command.get("run_name") != run_name
+        or command.get("adapter_bundle_identity") != bundle
+        or deployed_tree.get("deployed_tree_identity_sha256") != SOURCE_TREE_SHA256
+        or deployed_tree.get("manifest_sha256") != SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256
+        or ancestry.get("deployed_source_tree") != deployed_tree
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} command receipt does not match its producer receipt")
+    expected_shape = {"wide": (512, 1), "deep": (384, 2)}[arm]
+    provenance_path = run_dir / "artifacts" / "runs" / run_name / "provenance.json"
+    provenance = _read_json(provenance_path)
+    args = provenance.get("args", {})
+    expected_args = {
+        "name": run_name,
+        "seed": seed,
+        "valid_fold": fold,
+        "hidden": expected_shape[0],
+        "layers": expected_shape[1],
+        "epochs": 6,
+        "checkpoint_policy": "fixed",
+        "checkpoint_epoch": 5,
+        "no_eval_during_fit": True,
+        "precision": "fp32",
+        "batch": 8,
+        "chunk": 2000,
+    }
+    if any(args.get(key) != value for key, value in expected_args.items()):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} provenance does not match its frozen shape and recipe")
+    split_path = root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"
+    split_sha = _sha256(split_path)
+    split = _read_json(split_path)
+    groups = split.get("evaluation", {}).get("valid")
+    if (
+        split.get("fold") != fold
+        or split.get("n_folds") != 4
+        or ancestry.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha
+        or ancestry.get("fold") != fold
+        or groups != ancestry.get("evaluation_groups")
+        or not isinstance(groups, list)
+        or not groups
+        or len(set(groups)) != len(groups)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} split membership differs from its frozen ancestry")
+    checkpoint_relative = f"artifacts/runs/{run_name}/model_ep5.pt"
+    checkpoint = run_dir / checkpoint_relative
+    recorded = fit_receipt.get("outputs", {}).get(checkpoint_relative, {})
+    if not checkpoint.is_file() or _sha256(checkpoint) != recorded.get("sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit {run_name} epoch-5 checkpoint differs from its receipt")
+    return {
+        "job": job,
+        "run_dir": run_dir,
+        "fit_receipt": fit_receipt,
+        "fit_receipt_sha256": _sha256(run_dir / "producer_receipt.json"),
+        "split_path": split_path,
+        "split_sha256": split_sha,
+        "groups": groups,
+        "checkpoint_sha256": recorded["sha256"],
+        "provenance_sha256": _sha256(provenance_path),
+    }

+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path

+
+try:
+    from .postprocess_common import (

+    from postprocess_common import (

+        GRADER_SHA256,
+        SOURCE_TREE_SHA256,
+        _check_disk,

+        _execute,

+        _remaining,
+        _sha256,
+        _write_new_json,

+_CACHE_FILES = (
+    "chains.npz",
+    "chain_folds.npz",
+    "valid_targets.npz",
+    "train_targets.npz",
+)

+
+def _link(source: Path, destination: Path, *, directory: bool) -> None:
+    """Create an immutable-view symlink without replacing any prior input."""
+    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to replace grade-view input {destination}")
+    destination.symlink_to(source.resolve(strict=True), target_is_directory=directory)
+
+
+def _grade_view(
+    root: Path,
+    fold: int,
+    fits: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    exports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, str]]:
+    """Make the grader's expected tree from read-only links to frozen inputs."""
+    fold_root = root / "grades" / f"seed{fits['wide']['job']['seed']}" / f"fold{fold}"
+    view = fold_root / "view"
+    if fold_root.exists() and any(fold_root.iterdir()):
+        raise FileExistsError(f"grade attempt already exists; refusing to overwrite {fold_root}")
+    _check_disk(root)
+    fold_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    view.mkdir()
+    _link(root / "data" / "datasets", view / "datasets", directory=True)
+    cache = view / "cache"
+    cache.mkdir()
+    link_map: dict[str, str] = {"datasets": str(root / "data" / "datasets")}
+    for name in _CACHE_FILES:
+        source = root / "data" / "cache" / name
+        _link(source, cache / name, directory=False)
+        link_map[f"cache/{name}"] = str(source)
+    artifact_runs = view / "artifacts" / "runs"
+    artifact_runs.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for arm in ("wide", "deep"):
+        fit, export = fits[arm], exports[arm]
+        run_name = str(fit["job"]["id"])
+        artifact = fit["run_dir"] / "artifacts" / "runs" / run_name
+        _link(artifact, artifact_runs / run_name, directory=True)
+        for suffix in ("npy", "json"):
+            source = export["output_root"] / "cache" / f"pred_{run_name}_valid.{suffix}"
+            _link(source, cache / source.name, directory=False)
+        link_map[f"artifacts/runs/{run_name}"] = str(artifact)
+    for path in (view, cache, view / "artifacts", artifact_runs):
+        path.chmod(0o555)
+    return view, link_map
+
+
+def _grade_argv(
+    paths: dict[str, Path],
+    view: Path,
+    candidate: str,
+    reference: str,
+    split: Path,
+    output: Path,
+    scratch: Path,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Build the unchanged official R4 grader command for one fixed pair."""
+    return [
+        str(paths["python"]),
+        str(paths["grader"]),
+        "--root",
+        str(view),
+        "--run",
+        candidate,
+        "--split",
+        str(split),
+        "--epoch",
+        "5",
+        "--reference",
+        f"{reference}@5",
+        "--output",
+        str(output),
+        "--bootstrap",
+        "2000",
+        "--scratch-dir",
+        str(scratch),
+    ]
+
+
+def _existing_grade(fold_root: Path, fold: int, candidate: str, reference: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Reconcile only a fully receipt-bound successful earlier grade attempt."""
+    receipt_path = fold_root / "grade_receipt.json"
+    grade_path = fold_root / "grade.json"
+    command_path = fold_root / "grade_command.json"
+    try:
+        receipt, grade = _read_json(receipt_path), _read_json(grade_path)
+        execution = receipt.get("execution")
+        grade_output = receipt.get("grade_output")
+        stdout, stderr = receipt.get("stdout"), receipt.get("stderr")
+        if not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in (execution, grade_output, stdout, stderr)):
+            raise ValueError("grade receipt is missing execution, output, or log bindings")
+        if (
+            receipt.get("status") == "graded"
+            and receipt.get("fold") == fold
+            and receipt.get("candidate") == candidate
+            and receipt.get("reference") == reference
+            and receipt.get("grader_sha256") == GRADER_SHA256
+            and grade_output.get("sha256") == _sha256(grade_path)
+            and receipt.get("command_sha256") == _sha256(command_path)
+            and execution.get("exit_code") == 0
+            and stdout.get("sha256") == _sha256(fold_root / "grade.stdout.txt")
+            and stderr.get("sha256") == _sha256(fold_root / "grade.stderr.txt")
+            and grade.get("fold") == fold
+            and grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("run") == candidate
+            and grade.get("reference", {}).get("run") == reference
+            and grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("epoch") == 5
+            and grade.get("reference", {}).get("epoch") == 5
+            and grade.get("metric_id") == receipt.get("official_metric_id")
+            and grade.get("paired_component_bootstrap", {}).get("resamples") == 2000
+        ):
+            return receipt
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        pass

+
+
+def _grade_pair(

+    paths: dict[str, Path],
+    fold: int,
+    fits: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    exports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],

+    if wide["split_sha256"] != deep["split_sha256"] or wide["groups"] != deep["groups"]:

+    fold_root = root / "grades" / f"seed{fits['wide']['job']['seed']}" / f"fold{fold}"
+    candidate, reference = str(deep["job"]["id"]), str(wide["job"]["id"])

+        return _existing_grade(fold_root, fold, candidate, reference)
+    _remaining(deadline)

+    _remaining(deadline)
+    _check_disk(root)
+    cpus = sorted(deep["job"]["cpu_ids_initial"])
+    execution = _execute(argv, env, root, stdout, stderr, deadline, cpus)
+    grade: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+    status = "failed"
+    if execution.get("exit_code") == 0 and grade_path.is_file():
+        grade = _read_json(grade_path)
+        endpoint, scored_reference = grade.get("endpoint", {}), grade.get("reference", {})
+        if (
+            not grade.get("metric_id")
+            or grade.get("fold") != fold
+            or grade.get("split_manifest_sha256") != deep["split_sha256"]
+            or endpoint.get("run") != candidate
+            or endpoint.get("epoch") != 5
+            or scored_reference.get("run") != reference
+            or scored_reference.get("epoch") != 5
+            or grade.get("paired_component_bootstrap", {}).get("resamples") != 2000
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"official grade output does not bind the requested pair at fold {fold}"
+            )
+        status = "graded"
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-grade-receipt.v1",
+        "status": status,
+        "fold": fold,
+        "candidate": candidate,
+        "reference": reference,
+        "epoch": 5,
+        "grader_sha256": GRADER_SHA256,
+        "actor_bundle_sha256": ACTOR_SHA256,
+        "source_tree_identity_sha256": SOURCE_TREE_SHA256,
+        "command_sha256": _sha256(command_path),
+        "execution": execution,
+        "stdout": {"path": str(stdout), "bytes": stdout.stat().st_size, "sha256": _sha256(stdout)},
+        "stderr": {"path": str(stderr), "bytes": stderr.stat().st_size, "sha256": _sha256(stderr)},
+        "grade_output": (

+                "bytes": grade_path.stat().st_size,

+        "candidate_score": grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("score") if grade else None,

+PARTIAL_SUFFIXES = (".partial", ".part", ".tmp", ".incomplete")
+
+
+def _heartbeat_wait(journal: Journal, data_dir: Path, deadline: float) -> None:
+    """Wait in finite heartbeat intervals for all final parquet files to settle."""
+    previous: tuple[tuple[str, int, int], ...] | None = None
+    stable_since = 0.0
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        partials = [path for path in data_dir.glob("*") if path.name.endswith(PARTIAL_SUFFIXES)]
+        files = [data_dir / name for name in DATASETS]
+        if all(
+            path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == DATASET_BYTES[path.name] for path in files
+        ):
+            current = tuple(
+                (path.name, path.stat().st_size, path.stat().st_mtime_ns) for path in files
+            )
+            if current == previous:
+                if time.monotonic() - stable_since >= 30:
+                    journal.record("datasets_stable", files=current)
+                    return
+            else:
+                previous = current
+                stable_since = time.monotonic()
+        else:
+            previous = None
+            stable_since = time.monotonic()
+        journal.heartbeat(
+            phase="wait_for_final_datasets",
+            present=[path.name for path in files if path.is_file()],
+            partials=[path.name for path in partials],
+        )
+        time.sleep(30)
+    raise TimeoutError("final train/valid/valid_mask parquets did not settle within 24 hours")
+
+
+def wait_for_datasets(root: Path, journal: Journal) -> None:
+    """Wait for non-partial, stable dataset files without opening or hashing them."""
+    data_dir = root / "data" / "datasets"
+    if not data_dir.is_dir():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"expected staged datasets directory: {data_dir}")
+    _heartbeat_wait(journal, data_dir, time.monotonic() + WAIT_SECONDS)
+
+
+def _copy_pinned_script(source: Path, destination: Path) -> str:
+    source_hash = sha256_file(source)
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if destination.exists():
+        if not destination.is_file() or sha256_file(destination) != source_hash:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"staged preparation script differs from frozen source: {destination}"
+            )
+    else:
+        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
+        if sha256_file(destination) != source_hash:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"copied preparation script hash changed: {destination}")
+    return source_hash
+
+
+def _run_checked(
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    argv: list[str],
+    cwd: Path,
+    env: dict[str, str],
+    cpus: tuple[int, ...],
+    log: Path,
+    journal: Journal,
+    root: Path,
+    deadline: float,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    environment = {**os.environ, **env, "WNN_CWD": str(cwd)}
+    result = run_single(
+        name=name,
+        argv=argv,
+        environment=environment,
+        cpus=cpus,
+        log_path=log,
+        timeout_seconds=PREP_SECONDS,
+        journal=journal,
+        root=root,
+        global_deadline=deadline,
+    )
+    if result["returncode"] != 0 or result["status"] != "completed":
+        raise RuntimeError(f"preparation step {name} failed; inspect {log}: {result}")
+    return result
+
+
+def _atomic_copy(source: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
+    """Create a new split manifest by same-filesystem temporary write and fsync."""
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if destination.exists():
+        if not destination.is_file() or destination.read_bytes() != source.read_bytes():
+            raise FileExistsError(
+                f"existing split differs from regenerated membership: {destination}"
+            )
+        return
+    temporary = destination.with_name(f".{destination.name}.controller-tmp")
+    if temporary.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(temporary)
+    with source.open("rb") as reader, temporary.open("xb") as writer:
+        shutil.copyfileobj(reader, writer, length=1 << 20)
+        writer.flush()
+        os.fsync(writer.fileno())
+    os.replace(temporary, destination)
+    directory_fd = os.open(destination.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+    try:
+        os.fsync(directory_fd)
+    finally:
+        os.close(directory_fd)

+"""Owned process-group creation and cleanup for the finite controller."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import os
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def terminate_owned(process: subprocess.Popen[bytes], grace_seconds: float = 10) -> None:
+    """Stop only the process group created by this controller."""
+    if process.poll() is not None:
+        return
+    try:
+        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+    except ProcessLookupError:
+        return
+    try:
+        process.wait(timeout=grace_seconds)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
+            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        process.wait()
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Running:
+    name: str
+    process: subprocess.Popen[bytes]
+    log: Any
+    started: float
+    deadline: float
+    rss_peak: int = 0
+    gpu_uuid: str | None = None
+    gpu_peak_mib: int | None = None
+    status: str = "running"
+
+
+def _set_affinity(cpus: tuple[int, ...]) -> Callable[[], None]:
+    def apply() -> None:
+        os.sched_setaffinity(0, set(cpus))
+
+    return apply
+
+
+def start_owned(
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    argv: list[str],
+    environment: dict[str, str],
+    cpus: tuple[int, ...],
+    log_path: Path,
+    timeout_seconds: float,
+) -> Running:
+    """Start one actor in a fresh session with only its assigned CPU affinity."""
+    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if log_path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(log_path)
+    stream = log_path.open("xb")
+    try:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(
+            argv,
+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=stream,
+            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+            cwd=environment.get("WNN_CWD") or None,
+            env={key: value for key, value in environment.items() if key != "WNN_CWD"},
+            start_new_session=True,
+            preexec_fn=_set_affinity(cpus),
+        )
+    except BaseException:
+        stream.close()
+        raise
+    return Running(
+        name,
+        process,
+        stream,
+        time.monotonic(),
+        time.monotonic() + timeout_seconds,
+        gpu_uuid=environment.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
+    )

+"""Packet identity verification and bounded actual-shape profile admission."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from journal import Journal, write_json_fsync
+from policy import (
+    ALLOCATOR_BYTES,
+    DISK_FREE_MIN,
+    PROFILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+    sha256_file,
+    validate_profile_log,
+)
+from runtime import run_single
+from runtime_gates import cgroup_snapshot, parse_process_envelope, require_gpus

+FAILURE_MARKERS = (
+    "Traceback (most recent call last)",
+    "CUDA out of memory",
+    "OutOfMemoryError",
+    "CUDA error:",
+)
+
+
+def verify_packet(packet: Path, wave: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Check every frozen packet file hash before interpreting or executing it."""
+    verified = {}
+    for relative, expected in wave["file_hashes"].items():
+        path = (packet / relative).resolve(strict=True)
+        if not path.is_relative_to(packet.resolve(strict=True)):
+            raise ValueError(f"wave packet path escapes its root: {relative}")
+        digest = sha256_file(path)
+        if digest != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"frozen packet file hash mismatch: {relative}")
+        verified[relative] = digest
+    return verified
+
+
+def actor_environment(root: Path, run_dir: Path, uuid: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Build the per-process thread, temp, GPU, and actor workspace envelope."""
+    temporary = root / "tmp" / run_dir.name
+    temporary.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return {
+        **os.environ,
+        "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": uuid,
+        "WNN_RUN_DIR": str(run_dir),
+        "WNN_GPU_MEMORY_BYTES": str(ALLOCATOR_BYTES),
+        "WNN_THREADS": "2",
+        "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+        "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+        "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+        "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS": "2",
+        "NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE": "0",
+        "TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE": "0",
+        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
+        "TMPDIR": str(temporary),
+    }
+
+
+def _validate_profile(
+    job: dict[str, Any], result: dict[str, Any], run_dir: Path, log: Path
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check profile process, producer, controller-log and exact-shape evidence."""
+    if result["status"] != "completed" or result["returncode"] != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{job['arm']} profile process failed: {result}")
+    text = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    if any(marker in text for marker in FAILURE_MARKERS):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{job['arm']} profile log contains a CUDA/OOM/runtime failure marker")
+    timings, evidence = validate_profile_log(text)
+    producer = json.loads((run_dir / "producer_receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if (
+        producer.get("schema") != "tabdata-b300-profile-producer.v1"
+        or producer.get("status") != "profile_completed_check_controller_log"
+        or producer.get("arm") != job["arm"]
+        or producer.get("fold") != job["fold"]
+        or producer.get("seed") != job["seed"]
+        or producer.get("expected_log_records") != ["PROFILE", "PROFILE_UPDATE_EVIDENCE"]
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("profile producer receipt does not bind the admitted shape")
+    resource = parse_process_envelope(
+        run_dir / "train_cell_resource_receipt.json", job["gpu_uuid"], job["cpu_ids_initial"]
+    )
+    elapsed = producer.get("elapsed_seconds")
+    if (
+        isinstance(elapsed, bool)
+        or not isinstance(elapsed, (int, float))
+        or not math.isfinite(elapsed)
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("profile producer elapsed time is missing or nonfinite")
+    if result["peak_rss_bytes"] <= 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("profile process RSS measurement is missing")
+    return {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-shape-profile-gate.v1",
+        "status": "passed",
+        "job_id": job["id"],
+        "arm": job["arm"],
+        "fold": job["fold"],
+        "seed": job["seed"],
+        "gpu_uuid": job["gpu_uuid"],
+        "cpu_ids": job["cpu_ids_initial"],
+        "timings": timings,
+        "update_evidence": evidence,
+        "process_result": result,
+        "producer_receipt_sha256": sha256_file(run_dir / "producer_receipt.json"),
+        "resource_receipt": resource,
+        "log_sha256": sha256_file(log),
+    }
+
+
+def run_profile(
+    *,
+    job: dict[str, Any],
+    root: Path,
+    state: Path,
+    journal: Journal,
+    wave_deadline: float,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], int]:
+    """Run one fresh actual-shape profile with exact L4, affinity, and timeout gates."""
+    require_gpus([job], job["gpu_uuid"])
+    run_dir = state / "profiles" / job["arm"]
+    log = state / "logs" / f"profile-{job['arm']}.log"
+    if run_dir.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(run_dir)
+    run_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    run_dir.mkdir()
+    argv = list(job["argv"])
+    if argv[-1] != "fit":
+        raise ValueError(f"wave command for {job['id']} is not a fit invocation")
+    argv[-1] = "profile"
+    env = actor_environment(root, run_dir, job["gpu_uuid"])
+    before = cgroup_snapshot()
+    result = run_single(
+        name=f"profile-{job['arm']}",
+        argv=argv,
+        environment={**env, "WNN_CWD": str(root)},
+        cpus=tuple(job["cpu_ids_initial"]),
+        log_path=log,
+        timeout_seconds=PROFILE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        journal=journal,
+        root=root,
+        global_deadline=wave_deadline,
+        owned_paths=[state],

+    gated = _validate_profile(job, result, run_dir, log)
+    gated["cgroup_before"] = before
+    gated["cgroup_after"] = cgroup_snapshot()
+    gated["disk_free_bytes"] = shutil.disk_usage(root).free
+    if gated["disk_free_bytes"] < DISK_FREE_MIN:
+        raise RuntimeError("disk free-space floor fell below 8 GiB after profile")
+    journal.record(
+        "profile_pass",
+        arm=job["arm"],
+        receipt=str(state / "receipts" / f"profile-{job['arm']}.json"),
+    )
+    write_json_fsync(state / "receipts" / f"profile-{job['arm']}.json", gated)
+    return gated, int(result["peak_rss_bytes"])

+"""One admission authority for fixed GPU lanes, export, and paired grading."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from fit_stage import _validate_fit_receipt
+from journal import Journal, write_json_fsync
+from policy import sha256_file
+from postprocess_common import _runtime_paths
+from postprocess_export_run import _export_one
+from postprocess_fit import _fit_binding
+from postprocess_grade import _grade_pair
+from process_start import Running, start_owned, terminate_owned
+from profiles import actor_environment
+from runtime_gates import cgroup_snapshot, require_gpus
+
+from runtime import MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT, _monitor
+
+
+def run_rolling(
+    panel: dict, root: Path, state: Path, journal: Journal, deadline: float
+) -> dict:
+    """Keep at most one actor per frozen GPU, retaining all source-bound endpoints."""
+    jobs = panel["jobs"]
+    by_id = {j["id"]: j for j in jobs}
+    paths = _runtime_paths(root, jobs)
+    # Heterogeneous controller receipts are JSON dictionaries from fixed adapters.
+    progress: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "pending": list(jobs),
+        "handled": set(),
+        "records": {},
+        "fits": {},
+        "exports": {},
+        "grades": {},
+        "stop": False,
+        "first_export_passed": False,
+    }
+    running: list[Running] = []
+    baseline = cgroup_snapshot()["memory_events"]
+
+    def save_progress() -> None:
+        write_json_fsync(
+            state / "PROGRESS.json",
+            {
+                "fits": list(progress["records"].values()),
+                "pending": len(progress["pending"]),
+                "grades": list(progress["grades"].values()),
+                "new_admissions_stopped": progress["stop"],
+            },
+        )
+
+    def finish_one(name: str, result: dict) -> None:
+        job = by_id[name]
+        record = {"job_id": name, "process": result, "status": result["status"]}
+        progress["records"][name] = record
+        if result["status"] != "completed" or result["returncode"] != 0:
+            progress["stop"] = True
+            journal.record("fit_failed", job_id=name, process=result)
+            return
+        _validate_fit_receipt(job)
+        record.update(
+            status="fixed_epoch5_receipt_verified",
+            fit_receipt_sha256=sha256_file(
+                Path(job["run_dir"]) / "producer_receipt.json"
+            ),
+        )
+        fit = _fit_binding(root, job)
+        progress["fits"][name] = fit
+        journal.record("fit_receipt_verified", job_id=name)
+        if progress["stop"] and not progress["first_export_passed"]:
+            record["export_status"] = "awaiting_first_export_resource_repair"
+            return
+        journal.record("export_start", job_id=name)
+        limit = time.time() + min(1800, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+        exported = _export_one(root, paths, fit, limit)
+        admitted = bool(exported.pop("resource_admitted", False))
+        record["export_status"] = exported.get("status")
+        if not admitted:
+            progress["stop"] = True
+            journal.record(
+                "export_not_admitted", job_id=name, status=exported.get("status")
+            )
+            return
+        progress["first_export_passed"] = True
+        progress["exports"][name] = exported
+        journal.record("export_verified", job_id=name)
+        key = (job["fold"], job["seed"])
+        pair_jobs = [j for j in jobs if (j["fold"], j["seed"]) == key]
+        if key in progress["grades"] or not all(
+            j["id"] in progress["exports"] for j in pair_jobs
+        ):
+            return
+        fits = {j["arm"]: progress["fits"][j["id"]] for j in pair_jobs}
+        exports = {j["arm"]: progress["exports"][j["id"]] for j in pair_jobs}
+        journal.record("grade_start", fold=key[0], seed=key[1])
+        limit = time.time() + min(1800, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+        grade = _grade_pair(root, paths, key[0], fits, exports, limit)
+        progress["grades"][key] = grade
+        if grade["status"] != "graded":
+            progress["stop"] = True
+        journal.record(
+            "grade_finished", fold=key[0], seed=key[1], status=grade["status"]
+        )
+
+    def advance(active: list[Running], results: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
+        for name, result in results.items():
+            if name in progress["handled"]:
+                continue
+            progress["handled"].add(name)
+            try:
+                finish_one(name, result)
+            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, RuntimeError) as error:
+                progress["stop"] = True
+                progress["records"].setdefault(name, {"job_id": name}).update(
+                    delivery_error_type=type(error).__name__, delivery_error=str(error)
+                )
+                journal.record(
+                    "delivery_failed",
+                    job_id=name,
+                    error_type=type(error).__name__,
+                    error=str(error),
+                )
+            save_progress()
+        if progress["stop"]:
+            return
+        busy = {task.gpu_uuid for task in active if task.status == "running"}
+        for job in list(progress["pending"]):
+            if job["gpu_uuid"] in busy:
+                continue
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                raise TimeoutError("Campaign admission deadline expired")
+            if cgroup_snapshot()["memory_current"] >= MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT:
+                raise RuntimeError("Unit memory admission ceiling reached")
+            require_gpus([job], job["gpu_uuid"])
+            run = Path(job["run_dir"])
+            if run.exists() or run.is_symlink():
+                raise FileExistsError(run)
+            run.mkdir(parents=True)
+            env = actor_environment(root, run, job["gpu_uuid"])
+            active.append(
+                start_owned(
+                    name=job["id"],
+                    argv=job["argv"],
+                    environment={**env, "WNN_CWD": str(root)},
+                    cpus=tuple(job["cpu_ids_initial"]),
+                    log_path=state / "logs" / f"{job['id']}.log",
+                    timeout_seconds=min(
+                        panel["max_fit_seconds"], max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())
+                    ),
+                )
+            )
+            progress["pending"].remove(job)
+            busy.add(job["gpu_uuid"])
+            journal.record(
+                "fit_started",
+                job_id=job["id"],
+                gpu_uuid=job["gpu_uuid"],
+                fold=job["fold"],
+                seed=job["seed"],
+                arm=job["arm"],
+                pid=active[-1].process.pid,
+            )
+        save_progress()
+
+    try:
+        advance(running, {})
+        _monitor(
+            running,
+            journal,
+            root,
+            deadline,
+            baseline,
+            [root / "runs", root / "exports", root / "grades", root / "scratch", state],
+            advance=advance,
+        )
+    except BaseException:
+        for task in running:
+            if task.status == "running":
+                terminate_owned(task.process)
+            if not task.log.closed:
+                task.log.close()
+        raise
+    records = [
+        progress["records"].get(j["id"], {"job_id": j["id"], "status": "not_admitted"})
+        for j in jobs
+    ]
+    grades = list(progress["grades"].values())
+    complete = (
+        len(grades) == 30
+        and all(g["status"] == "graded" for g in grades)
+        and all(
+            r["status"] == "fixed_epoch5_receipt_verified" and "delivery_error" not in r
+            for r in records
+        )
+    )
+    return {
+        "status": "complete" if complete else "partial",
+        "fits": records,
+        "grades": grades,
+        "remaining_not_admitted": len(progress["pending"]),
+        "no_implicit_refits": True,
+    }
