New code in this PR: none; reuse linked existing implementation, preserving original source.\n\n2. **Why it should work**\n\n   Distinct field staleness may matter beyond a shared group clock. Expect gains concentrated in independently changing fields; compare F versus G with equal-width controls. The strongest general alternative is extra capacity, changed optimization or target calibration rather than the proposed mechanism; freeze the indicated matched controls. For student mechanisms use a single card per fit when it fits, and compare downstream official student/blend quality rather than teacher score alone. Large Transformer teachers can use multiple cards and207M/682M starting branches, with1.65B/long-context extensions conditional on evidence and memory. All use FP32 parameters, activations, states, gradients and optimizer state; autocast and TF32 off, no quantization. Proposed peak LR is 0.001, with parameter-group decay exclusions for biases/norms/gates to be recorded. Exact batch/accumulation/context, source-matched targets, inner checkpoint policy and successful-update count must be bound before fits. Changing the historical FP16/two-epoch recipe to this route is an explicit successor, not a faithful rerun. Scale/context/horizon sweeps are separate frozen arms, not post-result tuning hidden within these30 cells.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs**\n\n   Each scientific arm uses F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007:30 fits per arm. Primary statistic: one quarter times each fold's mean paired endpoint WP delta, then summed; compute scores per fit, not from seed-averaged predictions. Use the [workflow's seed/component procedures](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/field-age/research/unified/methods/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_WORKFLOW_20261017_R1.md),10000 resamples, RNG17017. Specify primary contrasts/multiplicity (Holm within frozen primary contrast family) before results. Thirty cells do not ensure power; do not treat rows, overlapping fits or four folds as many independent markets. All existing folds are exposed.\n\n7. **Future leakage and representative validation**\n\n   Inputs/feature transforms must be causal with sequence reset and fitting-only scaling. Audit source-qualified component overlap, aliases and teacher/initializer/preprocessing ancestry. True competition labels may reference future horizons; AR feedback accepts only own predictions. Check prefix invariance, reset/reload and intended chunk semantics before expensive runs. Report by source, fold, target, sequence position and activity/target-magnitude regimes; unknown anonymous clocks limit forward-market claims. No clean-validation claim is made for reused fitted groups.\n\n8. **Decision-changing outcome**\n\n   **Useful-effect threshold is deliberately pending**, to be justified from baseline variance, student transfer and GPU cost before fits. Success: a practically useful paired endpoint gain with acceptable fold/seed behavior and relevant downstream transfer. Uncertainty: an unresolved effect or heterogeneous regimes can justify a bounded targeted follow-up. Negative result: no useful gain or a concrete failure mode narrows this recipe; an interval crossing0 does not close the whole direction. Record whether the result changes teacher, student or target-link allocation. No retrospective threshold selection.\n\n9. **How to run and remaining integration**\n\n   **Not a ready-to-launch full-data B300 trainer.** FP32 successor of F/G; regenerate fold-clean teacher/cache and parent bindings; retain rank/optimizer-geometry confound controls.\n\n   From the repository root, install the repository's pinned Python/Torch environment on the receiving host and record the actual CUDA/driver/Torch/container identities. +  "body": "# [Experiment] causal-smoothing: Past-only smoothing while retaining raw inputs\n\n1. **Status, lineage and ownership**\n\n   Implementation handoff / proposed comparison, not a fitted result. Lineage: **teacher/student**. IDs: `H-DRAFT-CAUSAL-SMOOTHING-20261017`, `E-DRAFT-CAUSAL-SMOOTHING-20261017-R1`. Author/source: team repository plus this October17 draft, based on main/research-team `18407ecfa3b02d4db70cfb3c34abbacd6653e79d`. Receiving researcher owns device adaptation, source-clean bindings, profiling and complete run/evaluation return. New code in this PR: src/wnn/causal_research_features.py Shared primitive files have identical contents across related draft PRs, so they should merge once; they are not independent replications. Circle arithmetic is strictFP32, adapted from the source actor commit bc0ead82; cancellation and geometric validity remain untested.\n\n2. **Why it should work**\n\n   Raw noisy inputs may obscure persistent state. Append causal EWMA/residual features versus raw and equal-width dummy controls; expect improvement without erasing jump signal. The strongest general alternative is extra capacity, changed optimization or target calibration rather than the proposed mechanism; freeze the indicated matched controls. Current source evidence: User proposal; causal helper only, no fit.\n\n3. **Where more compute buys quality**\n\n   More compute buys complete fitting horizons, the30 paired cells, clean teacher cohorts and explicit capacity/context ladders; there is no measured scaling law. For student mechanisms use a single card per fit when it fits, and compare downstream official student/blend quality rather than teacher score alone. Large Transformer teachers can use multiple cards and207M/682M starting branches, with1.65B/long-context extensions conditional on evidence and memory. Do not assume all8 cards accelerate a small GRU. No leaderboard impact is measured or numerically predicted.\n\n4. **Frozen comparison and training proposal**\n\n   Arms: `raw-plus-control`, `raw-plus-causal-ewma`. All use FP32 parameters, activations, states, gradients and optimizer state; autocast and TF32 off, no quantization. The adjacent recipe records **starting proposals**, not a final frozen training command: AdamW, preclip norm1,12-epoch WSD with2% warmup and20% cooldown to0.1\u00d7LR. Proposed peak LR is 0.001, with parameter-group decay exclusions for biases/norms/gates to be recorded. Exact batch/accumulation/context, source-matched targets, inner checkpoint policy and successful-update count must be bound before fits. Changing the historical FP16/two-epoch recipe to this route is an explicit successor, not a faithful rerun. Scale/context/horizon sweeps are separate frozen arms, not post-result tuning hidden within these30 cells.\n\n5. **Thirty paired runs**\n\n   Each scientific arm uses F0/F1 seeds1001\u20131008 and F2/F3 seeds1001\u20131007:30 fits per arm. Candidate/control share cells and membership. Source-clean ancestors, normalizers and cache hashes must be bound independently for every fold; old F0 parents cannot simply be reused across folds. No runs in this matrix have started. `60` fits are required for all named arms; this is a plan, not a compute allocation.\n\n6. **Validation and statistical significance**\n\n   Official `global_wp_clip2_v1`, unchanged \u00b12 evaluation clipping and original clipped-label magnitude weights. Primary statistic: one quarter times each fold's mean paired endpoint WP delta, then summed; compute scores per fit, not from seed-averaged predictions. Use the [workflow's seed/component procedures](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-smoothing/research/unified/methods/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_WORKFLOW_20261017_R1.md),10000 resamples, RNG17017. Separate conditional component uncertainty, fitting-seed variability, observed-fold sensitivity and unknown public transfer. Specify primary contrasts/multiplicity (Holm within frozen primary contrast family) before results. Thirty cells do not ensure power; do not treat rows, overlapping fits or four folds as many independent markets. All existing folds are exposed.\n\n7. **Future leakage and representative validation**\n\n   Inputs/feature transforms must be causal with sequence reset and fitting-only scaling. Audit source-qualified component overlap, aliases and teacher/initializer/preprocessing ancestry. True competition labels may reference future horizons; AR feedback accepts only own predictions. Check prefix invariance, reset/reload and intended chunk semantics before expensive runs. Report by source, fold, target, sequence position and activity/target-magnitude regimes; unknown anonymous clocks limit forward-market claims. No clean-validation claim is made for reused fitted groups.\n\n8. **Decision-changing outcome**\n\n   **Useful-effect threshold is deliberately pending**, to be justified from baseline variance, student transfer and GPU cost before fits. Success: a practically useful paired endpoint gain with acceptable fold/seed behavior and relevant downstream transfer. Uncertainty: an unresolved effect or heterogeneous regimes can justify a bounded targeted follow-up. Negative result: no useful gain or a concrete failure mode narrows this recipe; an interval crossing0 does not close the whole direction. Record whether the result changes teacher, student or target-link allocation. No retrospective threshold selection.\n\n9. **How to run and remaining integration**\n\n   **Not a ready-to-launch full-data B300 trainer.** Wire feature/cache/streaming path; freeze smoothing coefficient using fitting-only development; no centered smoothing or whole-sequence fitted statistics.\n\n   From the repository root, install the repository's pinned Python/Torch environment on the receiving host and record the actual CUDA/driver/Torch/container identities. Mount only permitted supplied data and source-qualified split/teacher/cache assets on physical storage. Inspect actual B300 topology and FP32 kernel support; no claimed throughput or wall time. Run the implemented **plan command**:\n\n   ```bash\n   python research/experiment_drafts/causal-smoothing/run_plan.py\n   ```\n\n   This prints the30-cell matrix and missing bindings; it does **not** train. Existing implementation entry points are linked below.  The feature helper is wnn.causal_research_features; wire it into the real fitting/streaming path before claiming a train command.\n\n   A receiving-host multi-GPU teacher launch will use `torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=<measured_count> <completed_teacher_trainer> ...`; this is a **shape of command, not an existing executable trainer**. Existing `scripts/train_rnn.py` handles GRU fitting and exposes `--precision fp32`, `--seed`, `--valid-fold`, `--split-manifest`, `--grad-stats`, `--save-training-state`; keep its cache/provenance validation. No automatic launch or queue is provided. For initializer work reuse the linked phase runner rather than pretending it accepts generic trainer flags. Resume only from matching source/config and complete optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/state, otherwise restart a declared boundary.\n\n10. **Evidence and archives to return**\n\n   Explicitly hook `wnn.research_reporting.RunRecorder`; it does not instrument trainers automatically. Save source/config/ancestry/environment; attempted/completed steps, losses/components, param-group LR, preclip gradient norm, clipping/nonfinite counts, scores/masks/unit counts, timing/throughput and peak memory. Outer validation reports cannot choose checkpoints. Save all cells, failures, checkpoints/prediction manifests and an English terminal result note.\n\n   ```bash\n   python scripts/research_result_bundle.py --root <run_dir> --output-dir <archive_dir> \\\n     --evidence run_metadata.json --evidence metrics.jsonl \\\n     --evidence terminal_result.json --weight checkpoints/final.pt\n   ```\n\n   The explicit-file bundler writes separate evidence.tar and weights.tar plus SHA256 manifest; add prediction/grade/provenance files explicitly as more --evidence arguments. Keep datasets out. Return private archive locations/hashes separately from this PR, and keep the provenance manifests/narrative notes indexed in Git.\n\n11. **Results, provenance and merge trace**\n\n   No new fits or hardware checks; score/LB impact unknown. Source: [canonical prior record](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-smoothing/research/unified/ideas/CAUSAL_AR_TRANSFORMER_GRU_DISTILLATION_B300_20261017_R1.md). [Inventory](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-smoothing/research/unified/ideas/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_INVENTORY_20261017_R1.md), [workflow](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-smoothing/research/unified/methods/EXPERIMENT_DRAFT_WORKFLOW_20261017_R1.md). Add actual PR URL, run source SHA, run manifests, archives, result notes, critic findings, research-team merge SHA and later main promotion SHA. Merge useful negative/inconclusive evidence too; never overwrite frozen recipes or append-only history.\n\n## Implementation sources\n\n- [src/wnn/causal_research_features.py](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-smoothing/src/wnn/causal_research_features.py)\n- [scripts/train_rnn.py](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/experiment/causal-smoothing/scripts/train_rnn.py)\n",

+PATTERN = re.compile(r"ep (\d+) batch (\d+)/(\d+).*?seq/s ([0-9.]+)")

+
+def save(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
+    """Retain this bounded profile's current observation atomically."""
+    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n")
+    temporary.replace(path)
+
+
+def progress() -> dict:
+    """Read existing training logs without signals or GPU initialization."""
+    rows = {}
+    for state in ("r01-execution-v4", "r01-density4-v1", "pr15-execution-v2"):
+        for path in (ROOT / "state" / state / "logs").glob("*.log"):
+            with path.open("rb") as stream:
+                stream.seek(max(0, path.stat().st_size - 8000))
+                matches = PATTERN.findall(stream.read().decode(errors="replace"))
+            if matches:
+                ep, batch, total, _ = matches[-1]
+                rows[path.stem] = dict(
+                    batch_index=int(ep) * int(total) + int(batch), log_mtime=path.stat().st_mtime
+                )
+    return rows
+

+    """Recheck existing phase receipts; never run a fit, export, grade or publisher."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    config = _load_config(args.config, args.config_sha256)
+    verify_runtime_envelope(config["gpu_uuid"])
+    root, helper = config["root_path"], config["helper_path"]
+    packet_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    manifest_path = packet_dir / "MANIFEST.json"
+    manifest = read_object(manifest_path)
+    if manifest.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-packet.v1":
+        raise ValueError("unexpected acceptance packet manifest schema")
+    for relative, expected in manifest["files"].items():
+        if Path(relative).name != relative or sha256_file(packet_dir / relative) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"acceptance packet member changed: {relative}")
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(helper))
+    import r01_recovery_delivery as delivery

+        cli_checks.append({"phase": phase, "argv": argv, "returncode": checked.returncode})
+    validated, exports = [], []
+    for job in config["jobs"]:
+        job_id = job["id"]
+        if not (recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.json").exists():
+            continue
+        fit = verify_fit_receipt(
+            delivery, recovery, config["packet_path"], root, job, verify_placement
+        )
+        validated.append(
+            {"job_id": job_id, "checkpoint_sha256": fit["checkpoint_identity"]["fixed_file_sha256"]}
+        )
+        if not (recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.export.json").exists():
+            continue
+        exported = verify_export_receipt(recovery, root, job_id, fit, config["gpu_uuid"])
+        exports.append({"job_id": job_id, "prediction_sha256": exported["prediction_sha256"]})
+    if len(validated) < 4 or not exports:
+        raise ValueError("expected previously completed real R01 fit/export evidence is absent")

+    import publish_recovery
+
+    publisher_config = publish_recovery.verify_config(
+        Path(config["publisher_config_path"]), config["publisher_config_sha256"]
+    )
+    _, publisher_source, publisher_placement = publish_recovery._verify_runtime(
+        root, publisher_config
+    )
+    grader = publish_recovery._load_grader(root, publisher_source)
+    prediction_checks = []
+    for exported in exports:
+        job = next(job for job in config["jobs"] if job["id"] == exported["job_id"])
+        endpoint = publish_recovery._fit_export(root, recovery, job, publisher_placement)
+        split = grader.load_campaign_split(
+            root / "splits" / f"fold{job['fold']}.json", endpoint["output"]
+        )
+        prediction, binding = grader.validate_prediction(
+            endpoint["output"], job["id"], 5, list(split.evaluation_groups), split
+        )
+        if tuple(prediction.shape) != (len(split.evaluation_groups), 20000, 2) or str(
+            prediction.dtype
+        ) != "float32":
+            raise ValueError("officially checked endpoint has unexpected shape or dtype")
+        if any(
+            binding.get(key) != endpoint["export_receipt"].get(key)
+            for key in ("checkpoint_sha256", "prediction_sha256", "sidecar_sha256")
+        ):

+        raise ValueError(
+            f"read-only recovery publisher rejects real evidence: {snapshot['errors']}"
+        )

+
+    if torch.cuda.is_initialized():
+        raise RuntimeError("read-only delivery acceptance unexpectedly initialized CUDA")
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-acceptance.v1",
+        "status": "passed_read_only",
+        "time_unix": time.time(),

+        "packet_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(manifest_path),
+        "helper_manifest_sha256": config["helper_manifest_sha256"],

+"""Bounded receipts, manifest, and process helpers for the R01 delivery watcher."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+PANEL_SHA256 = "471f465cc1d13fc6e5153a4c998390bb14e06823fed4c6721f929ce95fee47fb"
+HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "d5ac193fc3241b7e54d985e71077167f1170fb0c2300967631226937ab22ae8f"
+HELPER_SCHEMA = "tabdata-r01-delivery-recovery-manifest.v2.4"
+EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX = 1792648272
+MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES = 16 * 1024**3
+POLL_SECONDS = 10
+VALIDATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 1800
+EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 600
+GRADE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 3600
+PUBLISH_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 600
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one regular nonsymlink file in bounded memory."""
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"expected a regular nonsymlink file: {path}")
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(4 * 1024**2), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a nonsymlink UTF-8 JSON object."""
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"expected a regular nonsymlink JSON file: {path}")
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise TypeError(f"expected a JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def write_atomic(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Atomically replace watcher-owned status without touching fit artifacts."""
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".delivery-watch-", dir=path.parent)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+            stream.write("\n")
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+        if os.name == "posix":
+            directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+            try:
+                os.fsync(directory_fd)
+            finally:
+                os.close(directory_fd)
+    finally:
+        if os.path.exists(temporary):
+            os.unlink(temporary)
+
+
+def append_event(path: Path, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Append one durable event record."""
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+
+
+def verify_helper_bundle(helper_dir: Path, expected_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify the exact v2.3 manifest and each listed helper file."""
+    manifest_path = helper_dir / "MANIFEST.json"
+    if sha256_file(manifest_path) != expected_sha256 or expected_sha256 != HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("R01 recovery helper manifest differs from the configured v2.3 pin")
+    manifest = read_object(manifest_path)
+    files = manifest.get("files")
+    if manifest.get("schema") != HELPER_SCHEMA or not isinstance(files, dict):
+        raise ValueError("R01 recovery helper manifest schema/files are malformed")
+    for relative, expected in files.items():
+        rel = Path(relative)
+        if rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts or not isinstance(expected, str):
+            raise ValueError(f"unsafe helper manifest entry: {relative!r}")
+        path = (helper_dir / rel).resolve(strict=True)
+        if (
+            not path.is_relative_to(helper_dir.resolve(strict=True))
+            or sha256_file(path) != expected
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"R01 recovery helper file differs from manifest: {relative}")
+    return manifest
+
+
+def verify_watcher_files(script_dir: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
+    """Check watcher files pinned by config; defer only the optional publisher."""
+    required = {
+        "r01_delivery_watch.py",
+        "delivery_watch_core.py",
+        "delivery_watch_state.py",
+        "delivery_watch_phases.py",
+        "delivery_watch_grades.py",
+        "delivery_watch_receipts.py",
+        "publish_recovery.py",
+    }
+    if not isinstance(files, dict) or not required.issubset(files):
+        raise ValueError("watcher config must pin every executable watcher and publisher module")
+    for relative, expected in files.items():
+        rel = Path(relative)
+        if rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts or not isinstance(expected, str):
+            raise ValueError(f"unsafe watcher file entry: {relative!r}")
+        path = script_dir / rel
+        if not path.exists() and relative == "publish_recovery.py":
+            continue
+        if sha256_file(path) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"watcher file differs from the configured hash: {relative}")
+
+
+def verify_runtime_envelope(gpu_uuid: str) -> None:
+    """Require the dedicated watcher unit's exact device, CPU, and RAM envelope."""
+    if os.name != "posix" or not hasattr(os, "sched_getaffinity"):
+        raise RuntimeError("R01 delivery watcher requires Linux CPU-affinity support")
+    if set(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) != {172, 174}:
+        raise RuntimeError("R01 delivery watcher must be pinned to CPUs 172 and 174")
+    if os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES") != gpu_uuid or "," in gpu_uuid:
+        raise RuntimeError("R01 exports require the single configured GPU1 UUID")
+    cgroup = Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+    v2 = next((line.split("::", 1)[1] for line in cgroup if line.startswith("0::")), None)
+    if v2 is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("R01 delivery watcher requires a cgroup v2 memory limit")
+    cgroup_path = (Path("/sys/fs/cgroup") / v2.lstrip("/")).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not cgroup_path.is_relative_to(Path("/sys/fs/cgroup").resolve(strict=True)):
+        raise RuntimeError("watcher cgroup path escapes the cgroup v2 mount")
+    memory_max = (cgroup_path / "memory.max").read_text(encoding="ascii").strip()
+    if memory_max != str(MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES):
+        raise RuntimeError("R01 delivery watcher cgroup must have an exact 16 GiB memory cap")
+
+
+def actor_still_running(resource: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    """Detect the exact frozen train actor after its finalizer wrote a receipt."""
+    pid = resource.get("pid")
+    if type(pid) is not int or pid <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("train actor resource receipt has no valid PID")
+    proc = Path("/proc") / str(pid)
+    if not proc.exists():
+        return False
+    stat = (proc / "stat").read_text(encoding="ascii")
+    state = stat.rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()[0]
+    if state == "Z":
+        return False
+    cmdline = (proc / "cmdline").read_bytes().replace(b"\0", b" ")
+    return b"gpu_entrypoint.py" in cmdline and b"train_cell.py" in cmdline
+
+
+def remaining(deadline_unix: int) -> int:
+    """Return positive integer seconds until the frozen delivery deadline."""
+    left = deadline_unix - time.time()
+    if left <= 0:
+        raise TimeoutError("the frozen R01 delivery deadline has expired")
+    return max(1, int(left))
+
+
+def fresh_attempt_allowed(
+    verified_receipt_exists: bool, attempt_path_exists: bool, prior_status: str
+) -> bool:
+    """Admit a phase only when it has no receipt, path, or durable prior claim."""
+    return (
+        verified_receipt_exists is False
+        and attempt_path_exists is False
+        and prior_status == "pending"
+    )

+"""One-shot official grading and optional separate publisher invocation."""

+import os

+
+from delivery_watch_core import (
+    EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,

+FIT_TERMINAL = {"validated", "rejected", "preserved_partial"}
+EXPORT_TERMINAL = {"exported", "rejected", "preserved_partial", "not_applicable"}
+GRADE_TERMINAL = {"graded", "preserved_partial", "not_applicable"}
+
+
+def _publish(config: dict[str, Any], state: Path, *, force: bool, last_time: float) -> float:
+    """Call the separately hash-pinned CPU publisher CLI, never import it."""
+    now = time.time()
+    if not force and now - last_time < PUBLISH_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
+        return last_time
+    script = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "publish_recovery.py"
+    digest = config["watcher_files"].get("publish_recovery.py")
+    configured_path = config.get("publisher_config_path")
+    configured_sha = config.get("publisher_config_sha256")
+    if not isinstance(configured_path, str) or not isinstance(configured_sha, str):
+        append_event(
+            state / "events.jsonl",
+            {"time_unix": now, "phase": "publisher_wait", "reason": "publisher config pending"},
+        )
+        return now
+    publisher_config = Path(configured_path)
+    publisher_sha = configured_sha
+    if (
+        digest is None
+        or not script.is_file()
+        or not publisher_config.is_file()
+        or sha256_file(script) != digest
+        or sha256_file(publisher_config) != publisher_sha
+    ):
+        append_event(
+            state / "events.jsonl",
+            {
+                "time_unix": now,
+                "phase": "publisher_wait",
+                "reason": "pinned publisher/config not present",
+            },
+        )
+        return now
+    env = dict(os.environ, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="", WNN_PROJECT_ROOT=str(config["root_path"]))
+    argv = [
+        sys.executable,
+        "-B",
+        str(script),
+        "--config",
+        str(publisher_config),
+        "--config-sha256",
+        publisher_sha,
+    ]
+    log = state / "logs" / f"publisher-{int(now)}.log"
+    try:
+        result = _run_child(argv, env, log, 120)
+        append_event(
+            state / "events.jsonl",
+            {"time_unix": time.time(), "phase": "publisher_finished", **result},
+        )
+    except (OSError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
+        append_event(
+            state / "events.jsonl",
+            {"time_unix": time.time(), "phase": "publisher_failed", "error": str(error)},
+        )
+    return now
+
+
+def _grade_pair(
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    state: Path,
+    recovery: Path,
+    wide: dict[str, Any],
+    deep: dict[str, Any],
+    cells: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    grader: Any,
+    last_publish: float,
+) -> float:

+    fold, seed = int(wide["fold"]), int(wide["seed"])
+    wide_cell, deep_cell = cells[str(wide["id"])], cells[str(deep["id"])]
+    grade_status = deep_cell.get("grade", {}).get("status", "pending")
+    if grade_status in GRADE_TERMINAL:

+    if not all(c.get("export", {}).get("status") == "exported" for c in (wide_cell, deep_cell)):
+        fit_terminal = all(
+            c.get("fit", {}).get("status") in FIT_TERMINAL for c in (wide_cell, deep_cell)
+        )
+        export_terminal = all(
+            c.get("export", {}).get("status") in EXPORT_TERMINAL for c in (wide_cell, deep_cell)
+        )
+        if grade_status in {"pending", "grade_started"} and fit_terminal and export_terminal:

+            _cell_write(

+                    if grade_status == "pending"
+                    else "prior grade attempt cannot be resumed after endpoint failure"
+                ),
+                quality_status="not_scored",

+    grade_dir = recovery / "grades" / f"seed{seed}" / f"fold{fold}"
+    grade_receipt_path = grade_dir / "grade_receipt.json"
+    if grade_receipt_path.exists():

+            _cell_write(
+                state,
+                deep_cell,
+                "grade",
+                status="graded",
+                receipt_sha256=sha256_file(grade_receipt_path),
+                score=receipt.get("score"),

+            return _publish(config, state, force=True, last_time=last_publish)
+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, AttributeError) as error:
+            _cell_write(
+                state,
+                deep_cell,
+                "grade",
+                status="preserved_partial",
+                error=str(error),
+                quality_status="not_scored",
+            )
+            return last_publish
+    if not fresh_attempt_allowed(
+        grade_receipt_path.exists(),
+        grade_dir.exists(),
+        deep_cell.get("grade", {}).get("status", "pending"),
+    ):
+        _cell_write(
+            state,
+            deep_cell,
+            "grade",
+            status="preserved_partial",

+            config["packet_path"],
+            config["root_path"] / "runtime/source-a266-lf-subset-v1",
+            recovery,
+            str(wide["id"]),
+            str(deep["id"]),
+            timeout_seconds=min(GRADE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, remaining(EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX)),
+        )
+        receipt = verify_grade_receipt(
+            recovery,
+            config["root_path"],
+            str(wide["id"]),
+            str(deep["id"]),
+            fold,
+            seed,

+            deep_cell,

+            status="graded",

+        ValueError,
+        KeyError,
+        TypeError,
+        IndexError,
+        AttributeError,
+        RuntimeError,
+        TimeoutError,
+        subprocess.TimeoutExpired,

+            deep_cell,
+            "grade",
+            status="preserved_partial",

+"""One-shot fit validation and fixed-epoch export phases."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from delivery_watch_core import (
+    EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+    EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+    POLL_SECONDS,
+    VALIDATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+    actor_still_running,
+    append_event,
+    fresh_attempt_allowed,
+    read_object,
+    remaining,
+    sha256_file,
+)
+from delivery_watch_receipts import verify_export_receipt, verify_fit_receipt
+from delivery_watch_state import _base_cli, _cell_write, _run_child
+
+
+def _fit_one(
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    state: Path,
+    recovery: Path,
+    job: dict[str, Any],
+    cell: dict[str, Any],
+    stable: dict[str, tuple[str, float]],
+    delivery: Any,
+    placement_verifier: Any,
+) -> None:
+    """Wait for a final train receipt, then validate the existing fit once."""
+    job_id = str(job["id"])
+    run_dir = Path(job["run_dir"])
+    fit_receipt_path = recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.json"
+    view = recovery / "fit_views" / job_id
+    if fit_receipt_path.exists():
+        try:
+            receipt = verify_fit_receipt(
+                delivery,
+                recovery,
+                config["packet_path"],
+                config["root_path"],
+                job,
+                placement_verifier,
+            )
+            _cell_write(
+                state,
+                cell,
+                "fit",
+                status="validated",
+                receipt_sha256=sha256_file(fit_receipt_path),
+                actor_phase=receipt.get("original_actor_phase"),
+            )
+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, AttributeError) as error:
+            quality_status = "not_scored"
+            producer_path = run_dir / "producer_receipt.json"
+            if producer_path.is_file() and not producer_path.is_symlink():
+                try:
+                    producer_status = read_object(producer_path).get("status")
+                except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+                    producer_status = None
+                if producer_status == "trainer_failed":
+                    quality_status = "not_evaluable_training_failure"
+            _cell_write(
+                state,
+                cell,
+                "fit",
+                status="rejected",
+                error_type=type(error).__name__,
+                error=str(error),
+                quality_status=quality_status,
+            )
+        return
+    if not fresh_attempt_allowed(
+        fit_receipt_path.exists(), view.exists(), cell.get("fit", {}).get("status", "pending")
+    ):
+        _cell_write(
+            state,
+            cell,
+            "fit",
+            status="preserved_partial",
+            reason="prior validation attempt has no verified receipt; no retry",
+        )
+        return
+    resource_path = run_dir / "train_cell_resource_receipt.json"
+    if not resource_path.is_file() or resource_path.is_symlink():
+        return
+    try:
+        resource = read_object(resource_path)
+        digest = sha256_file(resource_path)
+        previous, since = stable.get(job_id, ("", time.time()))
+        if digest != previous:
+            stable[job_id] = (digest, time.time())
+            return
+        if time.time() - since < POLL_SECONDS or actor_still_running(resource):
+            return
+    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+        append_event(
+            state / "events.jsonl",
+            {
+                "time_unix": time.time(),
+                "job_id": job_id,
+                "phase": "fit_wait",
+                "error_type": type(error).__name__,
+                "error": str(error),
+            },
+        )
+        return
+    _cell_write(state, cell, "fit", status="validation_started", resource_sha256=digest)
+    env = dict(
+        os.environ,
+        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
+        WNN_PROJECT_ROOT=str(config["root_path"]),
+        PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",
+        OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
+        MKL_NUM_THREADS="2",
+        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="2",
+        NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS="2",
+    )
+    argv = _base_cli(config, recovery, "validate") + ["--job-id", job_id]
+    try:
+        result = _run_child(
+            argv,
+            env,
+            state / "logs" / f"validate-{job_id}.log",
+            min(VALIDATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, remaining(EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX)),
+        )
+        if result["returncode"] != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"fit validation exited {result['returncode']}")
+        receipt = verify_fit_receipt(
+            delivery,
+            recovery,
+            config["packet_path"],
+            config["root_path"],
+            job,
+            placement_verifier,
+        )
+        _cell_write(
+            state,
+            cell,
+            "fit",
+            status="validated",
+            receipt_sha256=sha256_file(fit_receipt_path),
+            actor_phase=receipt.get("original_actor_phase"),
+            validator_log_sha256=result["log_sha256"],
+        )
+    except (
+        OSError,
+        ValueError,
+        KeyError,
+        TypeError,
+        IndexError,
+        AttributeError,
+        RuntimeError,
+        TimeoutError,
+    ) as error:
+        quality_status = "not_scored"
+        producer_path = run_dir / "producer_receipt.json"
+        if producer_path.is_file() and not producer_path.is_symlink():
+            try:
+                producer_status = read_object(producer_path).get("status")
+            except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
+                producer_status = None
+            if producer_status == "trainer_failed":
+                quality_status = "not_evaluable_training_failure"
+        _cell_write(
+            state,
+            cell,
+            "fit",
+            status="rejected",
+            error_type=type(error).__name__,
+            error=str(error),
+            quality_status=quality_status,
+        )
+
+
+def _export_one(
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    state: Path,
+    recovery: Path,
+    job: dict[str, Any],
+    cell: dict[str, Any],
+    delivery: Any,
+    placement_verifier: Any,
+) -> None:
+    """Export one verified fixed-epoch checkpoint; never retry an existing attempt."""
+    job_id = str(job["id"])
+    fit_path = recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.json"
+    export_path = recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.export.json"
+    output = recovery / "exports" / job_id
+    if cell.get("fit", {}).get("status") != "validated":
+        if cell.get("fit", {}).get("status") in {"rejected", "preserved_partial"}:
+            _cell_write(
+                state, cell, "export", status="not_applicable", reason="fit did not validate"
+            )
+        return
+    if export_path.exists():
+        try:
+            fit = verify_fit_receipt(
+                delivery,
+                recovery,
+                config["packet_path"],
+                config["root_path"],
+                job,
+                placement_verifier,
+            )
+            verify_export_receipt(
+                recovery, config["root_path"], job_id, fit, str(config["gpu_uuid"])
+            )
+            _cell_write(
+                state, cell, "export", status="exported", receipt_sha256=sha256_file(export_path)
+            )
+        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, AttributeError) as error:
+            _cell_write(
+                state,
+                cell,
+                "export",
+                status="rejected",
+                error_type=type(error).__name__,
+                error=str(error),

+"""Durable watcher state and bounded helper subprocess utilities."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from delivery_watch_core import append_event, read_object, sha256_file, write_atomic
+
+
+def _cell_write(state: Path, cell: dict[str, Any], phase: str, **details: Any) -> None:
+    """Persist a watcher-owned phase transition before and after work."""
+    now = time.time()
+    record = {**cell, phase: {"updated_unix": now, **details}}
+    write_atomic(state / "cells" / f"{cell['job_id']}.json", record)
+    append_event(
+        state / "events.jsonl",
+        {"time_unix": now, "job_id": cell["job_id"], "phase": phase, **details},
+    )
+    cell.update(record)
+
+
+def _cell_load(state: Path, job: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load one cell's durable state or return a fresh pending record."""
+    path = state / "cells" / f"{job['id']}.json"
+    if path.exists():
+        cell = read_object(path)
+        if cell.get("job_id") != job["id"] or cell.get("job") != job:
+            raise ValueError(f"watcher state has a different panel binding: {job['id']}")
+        return cell
+    return {
+        "job_id": job["id"],
+        "job": job,
+        "fit": {"status": "pending"},
+        "export": {"status": "pending"},
+    }
+
+
+def _run_child(
+    argv: list[str], env: dict[str, str], log_path: Path, timeout: int
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run a bounded child process and terminate only its new process group."""
+    if log_path.exists() or log_path.is_symlink():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"attempt log already exists: {log_path}")
+    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with log_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as log:
+        child = subprocess.Popen(
+            argv,
+            cwd=env["WNN_PROJECT_ROOT"],
+            env=env,
+            stdout=log,
+            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+            start_new_session=True,
+        )
+        try:
+            code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+            try:
+                child.wait(timeout=5)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                child.wait()
+            code = 124
+        log.flush()
+        os.fsync(log.fileno())
+    return {"returncode": code, "log_sha256": sha256_file(log_path), "argv": argv}
+
+
+def _base_cli(config: dict[str, Any], recovery: Path, phase: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Build helper arguments for only the three permitted delivery phases."""
+    return [
+        sys.executable,
+        "-B",
+        str(config["helper_path"] / "r01_delivery_recovery_v2.py"),
+        phase,
+        "--root",
+        str(config["root_path"]),
+        "--packet",
+        str(config["packet_path"]),
+        "--source-root",
+        str(config["root_path"] / "runtime/source-a266-lf-subset-v1"),
+        "--recovery-root",
+        str(recovery),
+    ]

+        or fold not in range(4)
+        or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", expected_sha256)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("split evidence identity is malformed")
+    source = root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"
+    if source.is_symlink() or sha256_file(source) != expected_sha256:
+        raise ValueError(f"canonical fold {fold} split differs from the verified grade")
+    payload = source.read_bytes()
+    target_dir = root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2/publisher-v1/split_manifests"
+    if any(
+        parent.is_symlink()
+        for parent in (
+            root / "state",
+            root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2",
+            target_dir.parent,
+            target_dir,
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("split evidence destination contains a symbolic link")
+    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    target = target_dir / f"fold{fold}-{expected_sha256}.json"
+    if target.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("preserved split evidence cannot be a symbolic link")
+    if not target.exists():
+        descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".split-", dir=target_dir)
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+                stream.write(payload)
+                stream.flush()
+                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+            try:
+                os.link(temporary, target)
+            except FileExistsError:
+                if target.is_symlink() or sha256_file(target) != expected_sha256:
+                    raise ValueError("competing preserved split bytes differ") from None
+            else:
+                if os.name != "nt":
+                    directory_fd = os.open(target_dir, os.O_RDONLY)
+                    try:
+                        os.fsync(directory_fd)
+                    finally:
+                        os.close(directory_fd)
+        finally:
+            if os.path.exists(temporary):
+                os.unlink(temporary)
+    if (
+        target.is_symlink()
+        or not target.resolve(strict=True).is_relative_to(root.resolve(strict=True))
+        or sha256_file(target) != expected_sha256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("preserved split evidence failed exact-byte verification")
+    return target
+
+
+def _archive_evidence_paths(
+    root: Path, fold: int, expected_sha256: str, evidence_paths: list[str]
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Replace the canonical split path with its exact state-local archive copy."""
+    source = str((root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json").resolve(strict=True))
+    if source not in evidence_paths:
+        raise ValueError("verified endpoint evidence omits its canonical split manifest")
+    preserved = _preserve_split_manifest(root, fold, expected_sha256)
+    return sorted({path for path in evidence_paths if path != source} | {str(preserved)})
+

+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read one object-valued receipt without following a symlink."""
+    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError(f"expected a regular nonsymlink JSON receipt: {path}")
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected a regular object-valued JSON receipt: {path}")
+    return value
+

+def _verify_manifest(path: Path, expected_sha: str, expected_schema: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify one pinned helper manifest and every safe member before use."""
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected_sha:
+        raise ValueError("runtime helper manifest differs from its literal pin")
+    manifest = read_json(path)
+    members = manifest.get("files")
+    if manifest.get("schema") != expected_schema or not isinstance(members, dict) or not members:
+        raise ValueError("runtime helper manifest has an unexpected schema or empty file map")
+    base = path.parent.resolve(strict=True)
+    for relative, digest in members.items():
+        member = Path(relative)
+        target = path.parent / member
+        if (
+            not isinstance(relative, str)
+            or member.is_absolute()
+            or ".." in member.parts
+            or not isinstance(digest, str)
+            or target.is_symlink()
+            or not target.resolve(strict=True).is_relative_to(base)
+            or sha256_file(target) != digest
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"runtime helper member failed its manifest: {relative}")
+    return manifest
+
+
+def _load_placement_verifier(root: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+    """Verify historical and active helper pins, then load only the pinned placement gate."""
+    historical_path = root / "runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_3/MANIFEST.json"
+    active_path = root / "runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_4/MANIFEST.json"
+    if (
+        Path(config["helper_manifest_path"]).resolve(strict=True)
+        != active_path.resolve(strict=True)
+        or config.get("helper_manifest_sha256") != ACTIVE_HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("active R01 helper path or literal v2.4 hash differs")
+    _verify_manifest(
+        historical_path, HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256, "tabdata-r01-delivery-recovery-manifest.v2.3"
+    )
+    active = _verify_manifest(
+        active_path,
+        ACTIVE_HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "tabdata-r01-delivery-recovery-manifest.v2.4",
+    )
+    if active.get("previous_helper_manifest_sha256") != HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("active helper does not preserve the exact v2.3 historical pin")
+    files = active.get("files", {})
+    if "r01_recovery_placement.py" not in files or "r01_recovery_common.py" not in files:
+        raise ValueError("active helper omits its pinned placement verifier dependencies")
+    helper_dir = active_path.parent
+    path_string = str(helper_dir)
+    sys.path[:] = [entry for entry in sys.path if entry != path_string]
+    sys.path.insert(0, path_string)
+    for name in ("r01_recovery_common", "r01_recovery_placement"):
+        sys.modules.pop(name, None)
+    import importlib
+
+    module = importlib.import_module("r01_recovery_placement")
+    module_path = Path(module.__file__).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not callable(getattr(module, "verify_placement", None)) or not module_path.is_relative_to(
+        helper_dir.resolve(strict=True)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("placement verifier resolved outside the pinned active helper")
+    return module.verify_placement
+
+
+def _verify_runtime(root: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Path, Any]:
+    """Check the active placement helper and original R01 packet/source pins."""
+    placement_verifier = _load_placement_verifier(root, config)
+
+    packet = root / "runtime/b300-r01-v1"
+    execution_path = packet / "EXECUTION_MANIFEST.json"
+    _verify_manifest(
+        execution_path, EXECUTION_MANIFEST_SHA256, "tabdata-b300-execution-manifest.v4"
+    )
+    panel_path = packet / "PANEL.json"
+    if sha256_file(panel_path) != PANEL_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("original R01 panel differs from the frozen source-qualified panel")
+    panel = read_json(panel_path)
+    identity = panel.get("actor_bundle_identity", {})
+    if (
+        panel.get("experiment_id") != "E-B300-R01"
+        or panel.get("cells_per_arm") != 30
+        or identity.get("sha256") != ACTOR_SHA256
+        or identity.get("source_tree_identity_sha256") != SOURCE_TREE_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("original R01 panel does not bind the fixed source and CP30 recipe")
+    source_root = root / "runtime/source-a266-lf-subset-v1"
+    if source_root.is_symlink() or not source_root.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("pinned R01 source root is missing or symlinked")
+    actor_files = identity.get("files")
+    if not isinstance(actor_files, dict) or not actor_files:
+        raise ValueError("R01 panel has no actor-bundle file map")
+    for relative, digest in actor_files.items():
+        path = packet / "code" / relative
+        if (
+            Path(relative).is_absolute()
+            or ".." in Path(relative).parts
+            or sha256_file(path) != digest
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"R01 actor file differs from its panel pin: {relative}")
+    actor_digest = hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(actor_files, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+    if actor_digest != ACTOR_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("R01 actor bundle map differs from its frozen identity")
+    deployed_manifest = read_json(packet / "code/source_package_manifest.json")
+    deployed_files = deployed_manifest.get("files")
+    if (
+        deployed_manifest.get("schema") != "tabdata-deployed-subset-manifest.v1"
+        or deployed_manifest.get("deployed_tree_identity_sha256") != SOURCE_TREE_SHA256
+        or not isinstance(deployed_files, dict)
+        or deployed_manifest.get("file_count") != len(deployed_files)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("deployed R01 source package manifest differs from the frozen tree")
+    for relative, record in deployed_files.items():
+        path = source_root / relative
+        if (
+            Path(relative).is_absolute()
+            or ".." in Path(relative).parts
+            or not isinstance(record, dict)
+            or sha256_file(path) != record.get("deployed_sha256")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"deployed R01 source member changed: {relative}")
+    source_files = read_json(packet / "code/a266_source_manifest.json").get("files")
+    if not isinstance(source_files, dict) or len(source_files) != 61:
+        raise ValueError("R01 portable source manifest is not the pinned 61-file map")
+    for relative, digest in source_files.items():
+        path = source_root / relative
+        if (
+            Path(relative).is_absolute()
+            or ".." in Path(relative).parts
+            or sha256_file(path) != digest
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"pinned R01 source file changed: {relative}")
+    return panel, source_root, placement_verifier
+

+def _load_grader(root: Path, source_root: Path) -> Any:
+    """Load only the pinned official CPU-side checkpoint/prediction validators."""
+    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
+    source_path = str(source_root / "src")
+    if source_path not in sys.path:
+        sys.path.insert(0, source_path)
+    path = root / "runtime/b300-r01-v1/grader/grade_endpoint.py"
+    if sha256_file(path) != GRADER_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("official original R01 grader differs from its frozen source pin")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("r01_recovery_original_grader", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError("cannot load the pinned original R01 grader helper")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    torch = sys.modules.get("torch")
+    if torch is not None and torch.cuda.is_initialized():
+        raise RuntimeError("recovery reporter unexpectedly initialized CUDA")
+    wnn = sys.modules.get("wnn")
+    if wnn is not None and not Path(wnn.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(source_root / "src"):
+        raise ValueError("official grader imported a different trainer source tree")
+    return module
+

+def _job_map(panel: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
+    """Validate and index the original 30 same-fold/same-seed wide/deep cells."""
+    jobs = panel.get("jobs")
+    if not isinstance(jobs, list) or len(jobs) != 60:
+        raise ValueError("R01 panel must contain exactly 60 original fit jobs")
+    pairs: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for job in jobs:
+        if not isinstance(job, dict) or job.get("arm") not in {"wide", "deep"}:
+            raise ValueError("R01 panel contains a malformed endpoint")
+        if type(job.get("fold")) is not int or type(job.get("seed")) is not int:
+            raise ValueError("R01 panel fold/seed must be integer identities")
+        cell = (job["fold"], job["seed"])
+        arms = pairs.setdefault(cell, {})
+        if job["arm"] in arms:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate R01 arm in fold/seed {cell}")
+        arms[job["arm"]] = job
+    if len(pairs) != 30 or any(set(arms) != {"wide", "deep"} for arms in pairs.values()):
+        raise ValueError("R01 panel does not contain 30 complete wide/deep pairs")
+    return pairs
+

+def _fit_export(
+    root: Path,
+    recovery: Path,
+    job: dict[str, Any],
+    placement_verifier: Callable[[Path, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify one previously validated fit and export recovery chain, without side effects."""
+    job_id = job["id"]
+    fit_path = recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.json"
+    fit = read_json(fit_path)
+    view = recovery / "fit_views" / job_id
+    if (
+        fit.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-fit-recovery.v2"
+        or fit.get("status") != "existing_fit_validated_no_refit"
+        or fit.get("job") != job
+        or fit.get("fit_view") != str(view)
+        or fit.get("old_fit_outputs_modified") is not False
+        or Path(fit.get("fit_view", "")).is_symlink()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit recovery identity is invalid for {job_id}")
+    producer_path = view / "producer_receipt.json"
+    if sha256_file(producer_path) != fit.get("recovery_fit_receipt_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(f"isolated fit view receipt changed for {job_id}")
+    identity = fit.get("checkpoint_identity", {})
+    run_dir = Path(job["run_dir"])
+    expected_run = root / "runs" / job_id
+    if run_dir.resolve(strict=True) != expected_run.resolve(strict=True):
+        raise ValueError(f"original R01 fit path differs from its panel binding: {job_id}")
+    artifact = expected_run / "artifacts/runs" / job_id
+    fixed_path, selected_path = artifact / "model_ep5.pt", artifact / "model.pt"
+    if (
+        identity.get("epoch") != 5
+        or identity.get("input_width") != 211
+        or identity.get("fixed_path") != str(fixed_path.resolve(strict=True))
+        or identity.get("selected_path") != str(selected_path.resolve(strict=True))
+        or sha256_file(fixed_path) != identity.get("fixed_file_sha256")
+        or sha256_file(selected_path) != identity.get("selected_file_sha256")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fixed epoch-5 checkpoint identity changed for {job_id}")
+    fit_budget = fit.get("optimizer_budget", {})
+    if (
+        fit_budget.get("epochs") != 6
+        or type(fit_budget.get("total")) is not int
+        or fit_budget["total"] <= 0
+        or fit.get("original_actor_phase", {}).get("status")
+        not in {"actor_returned", "actor_failed"}
+        or not fit.get("original_actor_phase", {}).get("fit_completion_verified_from")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"original full-budget fit recovery evidence is incomplete for {job_id}")
+
+    actor_phase = fit["original_actor_phase"]
+    train_resource_path = expected_run / "train_cell_resource_receipt.json"
+    train_resource = read_json(train_resource_path)
+    if sha256_file(train_resource_path) != actor_phase.get("resource_receipt_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(f"fit resource receipt differs from actor evidence for {job_id}")
+    placement = placement_verifier(root, job, train_resource)
+    if not isinstance(placement, dict) or placement.get("authority") not in {
+        "frozen_panel_initial_placement",
+        "sealed_density4_launch_event",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError(f"fit placement authority is invalid for {job_id}")
+    recorded_placement = actor_phase.get("placement_authorization")
+    if placement["authority"] == "frozen_panel_initial_placement":
+        if recorded_placement not in (None, placement):
+            raise ValueError(f"initial fit placement receipt differs for {job_id}")
+    elif recorded_placement != placement:
+        raise ValueError(f"moved fit placement lacks exact sealed launch evidence for {job_id}")
+
+    export_path = recovery / "receipts" / f"{job_id}.export.json"
+    exported = read_json(export_path)
+    output = recovery / "exports" / job_id
+    receipt_path = output / "export_receipt.json"
+    command_path = output / "export_command.json"
+    resource_path = output / "export_cell_resource_receipt.json"
+    log_path = recovery / "logs" / f"{job_id}.export.log"
+    receipt = read_json(receipt_path)
+    if (
+        exported.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-export-recovery.v2"
+        or exported.get("status") != "exported_fixed_epoch5_no_refit"
+        or exported.get("job_id") != job_id
+        or exported.get("old_fit_outputs_modified") is not False
+        or exported.get("fit_recovery_receipt_sha256") != sha256_file(fit_path)
+        or exported.get("export_receipt_path") != str(receipt_path)
+        or exported.get("export_receipt_sha256") != sha256_file(receipt_path)
+        or exported.get("export_command_sha256") != sha256_file(command_path)
+        or exported.get("export_resource_sha256") != sha256_file(resource_path)
+        or exported.get("actor_log_sha256") != sha256_file(log_path)
+        or receipt.get("status") != "completed_fixed_epoch5_feature_only_fp32"
+        or receipt.get("run_name") != job_id
+        or receipt.get("fold") != job["fold"]
+        or receipt.get("seed") != job["seed"]
+        or receipt.get("epoch") != 5
+        or receipt.get("feature_only") is not True
+        or receipt.get("inference_precision") != "fp32"
+        or receipt.get("target_reads_during_export") is not False
+        or receipt.get("checkpoint_sha256") != identity.get("fixed_file_sha256")
+        or exported.get("checkpoint_sha256") != identity.get("fixed_file_sha256")
+        or receipt.get("prediction_sha256") != exported.get("prediction_sha256")
+        or receipt.get("sidecar_sha256") != exported.get("sidecar_sha256")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"fixed-endpoint export receipt chain is invalid for {job_id}")
+    resource = read_json(resource_path)
+    if (
+        resource.get("schema") != "tabdata-b300-process-envelope.v1"
+        or resource.get("status") != "actor_returned"
+        or resource.get("script") != "export_cell.py"
+        or resource.get("visible_devices") != exported.get("visible_gpu_uuid")
+        or "B300" not in str(resource.get("gpu", ""))
+        or resource.get("allocator_budget_bytes") != 6 * 1024**3
+        or resource.get("torch_threads") != 2
+        or type(resource.get("cuda_peak_allocated_bytes")) is not int
+        or type(resource.get("cuda_peak_reserved_bytes")) is not int
+        or not 0 <= resource["cuda_peak_allocated_bytes"] <= 6 * 1024**3
+        or not 0 <= resource["cuda_peak_reserved_bytes"] <= 6 * 1024**3
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"export resource receipt is invalid for {job_id}")
+    prediction_path = output / "cache" / f"pred_{job_id}_valid.npy"
+    sidecar_path = output / "cache" / f"pred_{job_id}_valid.json"
+    if sha256_file(prediction_path) != receipt.get("prediction_sha256") or sha256_file(
+        sidecar_path
+    ) != receipt.get("sidecar_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(f"exported prediction or sidecar bytes changed for {job_id}")
+    return {
+        "job": job,
+        "fit": fit,
+        "fit_path": fit_path,
+        "fit_sha256": sha256_file(fit_path),
+        "identity": identity,
+        "placement_authorization": placement,
+        "export": exported,
+        "export_path": export_path,
+        "export_sha256": sha256_file(export_path),
+        "export_receipt": receipt,

+        "sidecar_path": sidecar_path,
+    }

+def _flag(argv: list[str], flag: str) -> str:
+    """Return one unique value from a stored grader argv."""
+    positions = [index for index, value in enumerate(argv[:-1]) if value == flag]
+    if len(positions) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"stored grade command must contain exactly one {flag}")
+    return argv[positions[0] + 1]

+def _finite_wp(value: object, label: str) -> float:
+    """Require one finite official weighted-Pearson score."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
+        raise ValueError(f"official {label} WP is missing or nonfinite")
+    return float(value)

+def _verify_grade_bindings(
+    grade: dict[str, Any],
+    fold: int,
+    split_sha: str,
+    groups: list[int],
+    wide_job: dict[str, Any],
+    deep_job: dict[str, Any],
+    wide_binding: dict[str, Any],
+    deep_binding: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    """Require official score endpoints to match both fixed checkpoints and predictions."""
+    if (
+        grade.get("schema") != "priority25.endpoint_grade.v1"
+        or grade.get("metric_id") != METRIC_ID
+        or grade.get("fold") != fold
+        or grade.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha
+        or grade.get("evaluation_row_groups") != groups
+        or grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("run") != deep_job["id"]
+        or grade.get("endpoint", {}).get("epoch") != 5
+        or grade.get("reference", {}).get("run") != wide_job["id"]
+        or grade.get("reference", {}).get("epoch") != 5
+        or grade.get("paired_component_bootstrap", {}).get("resamples") != 2000
+        or grade.get("paired_component_bootstrap", {}).get("seed") != 271828
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("official grade JSON does not bind the original metric and endpoints")
+    for label, endpoint, binding in (
+        ("wide", grade["reference"], wide_binding),
+        ("deep", grade["endpoint"], deep_binding),
+    ):
+        if any(
+            endpoint.get(field) != binding.get(binding_field)
+            for field, binding_field in (
+                ("checkpoint_sha256", "checkpoint_sha256"),
+                ("prediction_sha256", "prediction_sha256"),
+                ("sidecar_sha256", "sidecar_sha256"),
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"official grade hashes do not match the {label} fit/export chain")
+    return (
+        _finite_wp(grade["endpoint"].get("score", {}).get("wp"), "deep"),
+        _finite_wp(grade["reference"].get("score", {}).get("wp"), "wide"),
+    )

+def _verify_pair(

+    seed: int,

+        read_json(receipt_path),
+        read_json(grade_path),
+        read_json(command_path),
+    )
+    split_path = root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json"

+    if (
+        receipt.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-delivery-grade.v2"
+        or receipt.get("status") != "graded"
+        or receipt.get("candidate") != jobs["deep"]["id"]
+        or receipt.get("reference") != jobs["wide"]["id"]
+        or receipt.get("fold") != fold
+        or receipt.get("seed") != seed
+        or receipt.get("metric_id") != METRIC_ID
+        or receipt.get("grade_path") != str(grade_path)

+        or receipt.get("stdout_sha256") != sha256_file(grade_root / "grade.stdout.txt")

+        or not isinstance(receipt.get("elapsed_seconds"), (int, float))
+        or not math.isfinite(receipt.get("elapsed_seconds"))

+"""Observe, validate, export, and grade frozen R01 fits without a fit path."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from delivery_watch_core import (
+    EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+    HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+    PANEL_SHA256,
+    POLL_SECONDS,
+    append_event,
+    read_object,
+    sha256_file,
+    verify_helper_bundle,
+    verify_runtime_envelope,
+    verify_watcher_files,
+    write_atomic,
+)
+from delivery_watch_grades import _grade_pair, _publish
+from delivery_watch_phases import _export_one, _fit_one
+from delivery_watch_state import _cell_load
+
+
+def _load_config(path: Path, expected_sha256: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check the root-supplied config, helper bundle, and frozen panel."""
+    if sha256_file(path) != expected_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("watcher config SHA-256 differs from the service pin")
+    config = read_object(path)
+    required = {
+        "root",
+        "helper_dir",
+        "helper_manifest_name",
+        "helper_manifest_sha256",
+        "absolute_deadline_unix",
+        "gpu_uuid",
+        "publisher_config_path",
+        "publisher_config_sha256",
+        "watcher_files",
+    }
+    if (
+        config.get("schema") != "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-config.v1"
+        or not required.issubset(config)
+        or config["helper_manifest_name"] != "MANIFEST.json"
+        or config["absolute_deadline_unix"] != EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX
+        or config["helper_manifest_sha256"] != HELPER_MANIFEST_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("watcher config schema, helper pin, or fixed deadline is invalid")
+    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    verify_watcher_files(script_dir, config["watcher_files"])
+    root = Path(config["root"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    helper = Path(config["helper_dir"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    expected_helper = (root / "runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_4").resolve(strict=True)
+    if helper != expected_helper:
+        raise ValueError("helper directory differs from runtime/r01-delivery-recovery-v2_4")
+    verify_helper_bundle(helper, config["helper_manifest_sha256"])
+    packet = root / "runtime/b300-r01-v1"
+    panel_path = packet / "PANEL.json"
+    if sha256_file(panel_path) != PANEL_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("frozen R01 panel hash differs from the reviewed panel")
+    jobs = read_object(panel_path).get("jobs")
+    if not isinstance(jobs, list) or len(jobs) != 60 or len({j.get("id") for j in jobs}) != 60:
+        raise ValueError("frozen R01 panel must contain exactly 60 unique cells")
+    return {
+        **config,
+        "root_path": root,
+        "helper_path": helper,
+        "packet_path": packet,
+        "jobs": jobs,
+    }
+
+
+def _summary(cells: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Summarize delivery outcomes without treating fit failures as scores."""
+    fits = [c.get("fit", {}).get("status", "pending") for c in cells.values()]
+    exports = [c.get("export", {}).get("status", "pending") for c in cells.values()]
+    grades = [c.get("grade", {}).get("status", "pending") for c in cells.values()]
+    return {
+        "fit_counts": {
+            s: fits.count(s)
+            for s in ("validated", "rejected", "preserved_partial", "pending", "validation_started")
+        },
+        "export_counts": {
+            s: exports.count(s)
+            for s in (
+                "exported",
+                "rejected",
+                "preserved_partial",
+                "not_applicable",
+                "pending",
+                "export_started",
+            )
+        },
+        "fit_terminal_count": sum(
+            s in {"validated", "rejected", "preserved_partial"} for s in fits
+        ),
+        "export_terminal_count": sum(
+            s in {"exported", "rejected", "preserved_partial", "not_applicable"} for s in exports
+        ),
+        "grade_count": grades.count("graded"),
+        "grade_terminal_count": sum(
+            s in {"graded", "preserved_partial", "not_applicable"} for s in grades
+        ),
+        "scores_claimed": grades.count("graded"),
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run the finite delivery monitor under its separately bounded service unit."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--config-sha256", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    config = _load_config(args.config, args.config_sha256)
+    verify_runtime_envelope(str(config["gpu_uuid"]))
+    root, helper = config["root_path"], config["helper_path"]
+    recovery = root / "state/r01-delivery-recovery-v2"
+    if recovery.is_symlink() or not recovery.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("recovery tree must be an existing nonsymlink directory")
+    state = root / "state/r01-delivery-watch-v2"
+    if state.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError("watcher state cannot be a symlink")
+    state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    import fcntl
+
+    lock = (state / "watcher.lock").open("a+")
+    try:
+        fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+    except OSError as error:
+        lock.close()
+        raise RuntimeError("another delivery watcher already owns this state") from error
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(helper))
+    from r01_recovery_delivery import grade_pair
+    from r01_recovery_placement import verify_placement
+
+    delivery = sys.modules["r01_recovery_delivery"]
+    jobs = config["jobs"]
+    cells = {str(job["id"]): _cell_load(state, job) for job in jobs}
+    stable: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {}
+    last_publish = 0.0
+    append_event(
+        state / "events.jsonl",
+        {
+            "time_unix": time.time(),
+            "phase": "watcher_started",
+            "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+            "deadline_unix": EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+        },
+    )
+    while time.time() < EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX:
+        for job in jobs:
+            cell = cells[str(job["id"])]
+            if cell.get("fit", {}).get("status") in {"pending", "validation_started"}:
+                _fit_one(config, state, recovery, job, cell, stable, delivery, verify_placement)
+            if cell.get("export", {}).get("status") in {"pending", "export_started"}:
+                _export_one(config, state, recovery, job, cell, delivery, verify_placement)
+            last_publish = _publish(config, state, force=False, last_time=last_publish)
+        pairs: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for job in jobs:
+            pairs.setdefault((int(job["fold"]), int(job["seed"])), {})[str(job["arm"])] = job
+        for (fold, seed), pair in sorted(pairs.items()):
+            if set(pair) != {"wide", "deep"}:
+                raise ValueError(f"frozen panel pair is malformed at fold {fold}, seed {seed}")
+            last_publish = _grade_pair(
+                config,
+                state,
+                recovery,
+                pair["wide"],
+                pair["deep"],
+                cells,
+                grade_pair,
+                last_publish,
+            )
+        last_publish = _publish(config, state, force=False, last_time=last_publish)
+        summary = _summary(cells)
+        write_atomic(
+            state / "STATUS.json",
+            {
+                "schema": "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-status.v1",
+                "heartbeat_unix": time.time(),
+                "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+                "deadline_unix": EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX,
+                **summary,
+            },
+        )
+        if (
+            summary["fit_terminal_count"] == 60
+            and summary["export_terminal_count"] == 60
+            and summary["grade_terminal_count"] == 30
+        ):
+            break
+        seconds_left = max(0, int(EXPECTED_DEADLINE_UNIX - time.time()))
+        if seconds_left <= 0:
+            break
+        time.sleep(min(POLL_SECONDS, seconds_left))
+    summary = _summary(cells)
+    complete = (
+        summary["fit_counts"]["validated"] == 60
+        and summary["export_counts"]["exported"] == 60
+        and summary["grade_count"] == 30
+    )
+    write_atomic(
+        state / "RESULT.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "tabdata-r01-delivery-watch-result.v1",
+            "status": "complete" if complete else "partial",
+            "finished_unix": time.time(),
+            "panel_sha256": PANEL_SHA256,
+            **summary,
+        },
+    )
+    append_event(
+        state / "events.jsonl", {"time_unix": time.time(), "phase": "watcher_finished", **summary}
+    )
+    lock.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
