+"""Content identity for PR15 checkpoints saved as separate Torch archives.
+
+The PR15 trainer saves one Python checkpoint object to ``model_ep2.pt`` and
+``model.pt`` in separate ``torch.save`` calls. Zip serialization bytes can
+differ while the loaded checkpoint payload is exactly the same. This module
+compares the full loaded payload and separately retains both raw file hashes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one checkpoint archive without loading it into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _tensor_node(value: Any, torch: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a canonical tensor descriptor including exact logical bytes."""
+    if value.layout != torch.strided or value.is_quantized:
+        raise TypeError("checkpoint identity supports dense, nonquantized tensors only")
+    if getattr(value, "is_conj", lambda: False)() or getattr(value, "is_neg", lambda: False)():
+        raise TypeError("checkpoint identity rejects unresolved tensor view flags")
+    tensor = value.detach().to(device="cpu").contiguous()
+    try:
+        raw = tensor.reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes()
+    except (RuntimeError, TypeError) as error:
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported checkpoint tensor dtype: {tensor.dtype}") from error
+    return {
+        "type": f"{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+        "dtype": str(tensor.dtype),
+        "shape": list(tensor.shape),
+        "stride": list(value.stride()),
+        "storage_offset": value.storage_offset(),
+        "layout": str(tensor.layout),
+        "requires_grad": bool(value.requires_grad),
+        "content_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
+    }
+
+
+def _canonical(value: Any, torch: Any) -> Any:
+    """Normalize supported checkpoint values while preserving type and content."""
+    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        return _tensor_node(value, torch)
+    if value is None:
+        return {"type": "NoneType"}
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return {"type": "bool", "value": value}
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return {"type": "int", "value": str(value)}
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        if not math.isfinite(value):
+            raise ValueError("checkpoint metadata contains a nonfinite float")
+        return {"type": "float", "hex": value.hex()}
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return {"type": "str", "value": value}
+    if isinstance(value, bytes):
+        return {"type": "bytes", "sha256": hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest(), "length": len(value)}
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        if any(not isinstance(key, str) for key in value):
+            raise TypeError("checkpoint mappings must use string keys")
+        attrs = vars(value) if hasattr(value, "__dict__") else {}
+        return {
+            "type": f"mapping:{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+            "items": [[key, _canonical(item, torch)] for key, item in value.items()],
+            "attributes": _canonical(attrs, torch) if attrs else {"type": "dict", "items": []},
+        }
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return {"type": "list", "items": [_canonical(item, torch) for item in value]}
+    if isinstance(value, tuple):
+        return {
+            "type": f"tuple:{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+            "items": [_canonical(item, torch) for item in value],
+        }
+
+    try:
+        import numpy as np
+    except ImportError:
+        np = None
+    if np is not None and isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
+        if value.dtype.hasobject:
+            raise TypeError("checkpoint identity rejects object-dtype NumPy arrays")
+        array = np.ascontiguousarray(value)
+        return {
+            "type": "numpy.ndarray",
+            "dtype": array.dtype.str,
+            "shape": list(array.shape),
+            "content_sha256": hashlib.sha256(array.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+        }
+    if np is not None and isinstance(value, np.generic):
+        if value.dtype.hasobject:
+            raise TypeError("checkpoint identity rejects object-dtype NumPy scalars")
+        if isinstance(value, np.floating) and not np.isfinite(value):
+            raise ValueError("checkpoint metadata contains a nonfinite NumPy scalar")
+        return {
+            "type": f"numpy.scalar:{value.dtype.str}",
+            "content_sha256": hashlib.sha256(value.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+        }
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported checkpoint value type: {type(value)!r}")
+
+
+def payload_identity_sha256(checkpoint: Any, torch: Any) -> str:
+    """Hash all checkpoint keys, metadata, tensor types/shapes and tensor bytes."""
+    normalized = _canonical(checkpoint, torch)
+    encoded = json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode(
+        "utf-8"
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CheckpointIdentity:
+    """Immutable identities for the fixed and selected checkpoint files."""
+
+    fixed_path: str
+    selected_path: str
+    fixed_file_sha256: str
+    selected_file_sha256: str
+    payload_sha256: str
+    model_state_sha256: str
+    epoch: int
+    input_width: int
+
+    def receipt(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Return a JSON-safe receipt preserving both byte and payload identities."""
+        return asdict(self)
+
+
+def verify_checkpoint_pair(
+    fixed_path: Path,
+    selected_path: Path,
+    *,
+    expected_epoch: int = 2,
+    expected_input_width: int = 271,
+) -> CheckpointIdentity:
+    """Require exact full-payload equality of fixed and selected Torch checkpoints.
+
+    This does not replace recipe, source, full-budget, or prediction validation.
+    Callers must keep those independent checks and bind predictions to the fixed
+    checkpoint's raw file hash returned here.
+    """
+    import torch
+
+    fixed_path = fixed_path.resolve(strict=True)
+    selected_path = selected_path.resolve(strict=True)
+    fixed = torch.load(fixed_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    selected = torch.load(selected_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    if not isinstance(fixed, dict) or not isinstance(selected, dict):
+        raise TypeError("PR15 checkpoint payloads must be dictionaries")
+    for label, payload in (("fixed", fixed), ("selected", selected)):
+        if payload.get("epoch") != expected_epoch:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} checkpoint is not fixed epoch {expected_epoch}")
+        if payload.get("n_in") != expected_input_width:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} checkpoint input width is not {expected_input_width}")
+        if not isinstance(payload.get("model"), Mapping):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} checkpoint has no model state mapping")
+    fixed_payload_sha = payload_identity_sha256(fixed, torch)
+    selected_payload_sha = payload_identity_sha256(selected, torch)
+    if fixed_payload_sha != selected_payload_sha:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "selected model.pt payload differs from model_ep2.pt "
+            f"(fixed={fixed_payload_sha}, selected={selected_payload_sha})"
+        )
+    return CheckpointIdentity(
+        fixed_path=str(fixed_path),
+        selected_path=str(selected_path),
+        fixed_file_sha256=sha256_file(fixed_path),
+        selected_file_sha256=sha256_file(selected_path),
+        payload_sha256=fixed_payload_sha,
+        model_state_sha256=payload_identity_sha256(fixed["model"], torch),
+        epoch=expected_epoch,
+        input_width=expected_input_width,
+    )
+
+
+def validate_provenance_file_hashes(
+    provenance: Mapping[str, Any], identity: CheckpointIdentity
+) -> None:
+    """Bind each saved archive byte hash to its own trainer provenance entry."""
+    checkpoint_hashes = provenance.get("checkpoint_sha256")
+    expected = {
+        "model_ep2.pt": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "model.pt": identity.selected_file_sha256,
+    }
+    if not isinstance(checkpoint_hashes, Mapping) or any(
+        checkpoint_hashes.get(filename) != digest for filename, digest in expected.items()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint bytes differ from the trainer's per-file provenance")
+
+
+def validate_prediction_pin(
+    sidecar: Mapping[str, Any],
+    prediction_path: Path,
+    identity: CheckpointIdentity,
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    split_manifest_sha256: str,
+    evaluation_groups: list[int],
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Keep the evaluation export pinned to exact epoch-2 bytes and row membership."""
+    prediction_sha256 = sha256_file(prediction_path)
+    expected = {
+        "run": name,
+        "epoch": identity.epoch,
+        "campaign_export_scope": "evaluation",
+        "campaign_split_manifest_sha256": split_manifest_sha256,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_manifest_sha256,
+        "checkpoint_sha256": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "row_groups": evaluation_groups,
+        "prediction_sha256": prediction_sha256,
+    }
+    if any(sidecar.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+        raise ValueError("prediction sidecar is not pinned to the fixed checkpoint/fold")
+    return {
+        "checkpoint_file_sha256": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "prediction_sha256": prediction_sha256,
+    }

+"""Delivery-only validation and command construction for completed PR15 fits.
+
+This adapter intentionally has no fit command. It validates existing checkpoints
+and produces only the pinned export and CPU score commands for an external
+root-owned runner. It writes no files and never edits the sealed PR15 packet.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import math
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from checkpoint_identity import (
+    validate_prediction_pin,
+    validate_provenance_file_hashes,
+    verify_checkpoint_pair,
+)
+
+PARENT_PROFILE_PACKET_SHA256 = "c18f1877b8579c03d2a0905534f5ecbd13ed56a54306ba66d63b47d892b66510"
+PARENT_FIT_CONTRACT_SHA256 = "05aa087af1fdd68ac97146e6f56750157d4a33ebd4fce2a5ec2f5eb30cc6bcb8"
+PINNED_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "873662aded939afd64c17c80b684011de023c04a31be5b2c74e0b9d97a18efc0"
+PINNED_SCORE_SUPPORT_SHA256 = "698ae26944b96ffb1b2b2ccb2de11cab427d3c822c2ca74cdacff1b1ef7d6368"
+PINNED_SCORE_HELPER_SHA256 = "fb7a85a5837f61fa6c65cd10a799768006067e87d4c18e92d4b813ba83b9d82e"
+NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\Z")
+
+
+def _load_module(path: Path, name: str) -> Any:
+    """Load one unchanged host-packet module by its exact local path."""
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"cannot load sealed host module: {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.modules[name] = module
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def verify_frozen_packet(packet_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify the v2 packet members and their original profile ancestry."""
+    packet_dir = packet_dir.resolve(strict=True)
+    frozen_path = packet_dir / "FROZEN.json"
+    contract_path = packet_dir / "FIT_CONTRACT.json"
+    frozen = json.loads(frozen_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if (
+        frozen.get("schema") != "tabdata-pr15-delivery-repair-freeze.v2"
+        or frozen.get("parent_profile_packet_sha256") != PARENT_PROFILE_PACKET_SHA256
+        or frozen.get("parent_fit_contract_sha256") != PARENT_FIT_CONTRACT_SHA256
+        or not isinstance(frozen.get("parent_execution_manifest_sha256"), str)
+        or not isinstance(frozen.get("files"), dict)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("v2 freeze does not bind the original PR15 profile packet")
+    expected_names = set(frozen["files"]) | {"FROZEN.json", "EXECUTION_MANIFEST.json"}
+    actual_names = {path.name for path in packet_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
+    if actual_names != expected_names:
+        raise ValueError("v2 packet contains missing or unmanifested files")
+    for relative, expected in frozen["files"].items():
+        if Path(relative).name != relative:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsafe v2 freeze member path: {relative}")
+        member = packet_dir / relative
+        if _sha256(member) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"v2 frozen PR15 packet member changed: {relative}")
+    parent_path = packet_dir / "PARENT_PACKET.json"
+    parent = json.loads(parent_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if (
+        parent.get("frozen_sha256") != PARENT_PROFILE_PACKET_SHA256
+        or parent.get("fit_contract_sha256") != PARENT_FIT_CONTRACT_SHA256
+        or parent.get("execution_manifest_sha256") != frozen.get("parent_execution_manifest_sha256")
+        or not isinstance(parent.get("files"), dict)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("v2 parent file map changed the original packet identities")
+    contract = json.loads(contract_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if (
+        contract.get("schema") != "tabdata-pr15-fit-contract.v2"
+        or contract.get("profile_packet_sha256") != PARENT_PROFILE_PACKET_SHA256
+        or contract.get("parent_fit_contract_sha256") != PARENT_FIT_CONTRACT_SHA256
+        or contract.get("files")
+        != {
+            "fit_validation.py": _sha256(packet_dir / "fit_validation.py"),
+            "checkpoint_identity.py": _sha256(packet_dir / "checkpoint_identity.py"),
+        }
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("v2 fit contract does not bind its original parent")
+    manifest_path = packet_dir / "EXECUTION_MANIFEST.json"
+    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    expected_hashes = {
+        "FROZEN.json": _sha256(frozen_path),
+        "FIT_CONTRACT.json": _sha256(contract_path),
+        "fit_validation.py": _sha256(packet_dir / "fit_validation.py"),
+        "checkpoint_identity.py": _sha256(packet_dir / "checkpoint_identity.py"),
+        "PARENT_PACKET.json": _sha256(parent_path),
+    }
+    if (
+        manifest.get("schema") != "tabdata-pr15-delivery-repair-manifest.v2"
+        or manifest.get("parent_profile_packet_sha256") != PARENT_PROFILE_PACKET_SHA256
+        or manifest.get("files") != expected_hashes
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("v2 execution manifest does not match frozen members")
+    return {
+        "frozen_manifest_sha256": _sha256(frozen_path),
+        "fit_contract_sha256": _sha256(contract_path),
+        "fit_validation_sha256": expected_hashes["fit_validation.py"],
+        "frozen_member_count": len(frozen["files"]),
+    }

+def _verify_scorer_copies(packet_dir: Path, source_root: Path, work: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Bind the workspace scorer copies to the pinned PR15 source and helper."""
+    source_manifest = json.loads((packet_dir / "source_manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if _sha256(packet_dir / "source_manifest.json") != PINNED_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("PR15 source manifest differs from the frozen source pin")
+    source_hashes = {row["path"]: row["sha256"] for row in source_manifest["files"]}
+    source_scorer_hash = source_hashes.get("scripts/score_run.py")
+    if source_scorer_hash is None:
+        raise ValueError("pinned source manifest omits the native scorer")
+    support_path = packet_dir / "score_support_manifest.json"
+    support = json.loads(support_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    helper_rows = support.get("files", [])
+    helper_hash = helper_rows[0].get("sha256") if len(helper_rows) == 1 else None
+    if (
+        _sha256(support_path) != PINNED_SCORE_SUPPORT_SHA256
+        or support.get("source_commit") != "e238fc5c82ac8c4591f3ca3ef87c37b2b73b929e"
+        or helper_hash != PINNED_SCORE_HELPER_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("source-native scorer support pin is invalid")
+    source_scorer = source_root / "scripts" / "score_run.py"
+    if _sha256(source_scorer) != source_scorer_hash:
+        raise ValueError("deployed native scorer differs from the source manifest")
+    copies = {
+        "score_run.py": _sha256(work / "scripts" / "score_run.py"),
+        "grade_prediction_bank.py": _sha256(work / "scripts" / "grade_prediction_bank.py"),
+    }
+    expected = {
+        "score_run.py": source_scorer_hash,
+        "grade_prediction_bank.py": PINNED_SCORE_HELPER_SHA256,
+    }
+    if copies != expected:
+        raise ValueError("workspace source-native scoring files differ from pinned bytes")

+    request_path = work / "worker_request.json"

+    if (
+        fit_validation.get("schema") != "pr15-delivery-repair-fit-validation.v1"
+        or fit_validation.get("status") != "existing_fit_validated_for_delivery"
+        or fit_validation.get("name") != name
+        or fit_validation.get("old_failure_preserved") is not True
+        or fit_validation.get("request_sha256") != _sha256(request_path)
+        or fit_validation.get("old_failed_worker_receipt_sha256") != _sha256(failed_path)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("delivery phase lacks the strict validation for this fit")

+        "log_sha256"

+        str(packet_dir / "gpu_entrypoint.py"),

+"""Content identity for PR15 checkpoints saved as separate Torch archives.
+
+The PR15 trainer saves one Python checkpoint object to ``model_ep2.pt`` and
+``model.pt`` in separate ``torch.save`` calls. Zip serialization bytes can
+differ while the loaded checkpoint payload is exactly the same. This module
+compares the full loaded payload and separately retains both raw file hashes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one checkpoint archive without loading it into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _tensor_node(value: Any, torch: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a canonical tensor descriptor including exact logical bytes."""
+    if value.layout != torch.strided or value.is_quantized:
+        raise TypeError("checkpoint identity supports dense, nonquantized tensors only")
+    if getattr(value, "is_conj", lambda: False)() or getattr(value, "is_neg", lambda: False)():
+        raise TypeError("checkpoint identity rejects unresolved tensor view flags")
+    tensor = value.detach().to(device="cpu").contiguous()
+    try:
+        raw = tensor.reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes()
+    except (RuntimeError, TypeError) as error:
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported checkpoint tensor dtype: {tensor.dtype}") from error
+    return {
+        "type": f"{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+        "dtype": str(tensor.dtype),
+        "shape": list(tensor.shape),
+        "stride": list(value.stride()),
+        "storage_offset": value.storage_offset(),
+        "layout": str(tensor.layout),
+        "requires_grad": bool(value.requires_grad),
+        "content_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
+    }
+
+
+def _canonical(value: Any, torch: Any) -> Any:
+    """Normalize supported checkpoint values while preserving type and content."""
+    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        return _tensor_node(value, torch)
+    if value is None:
+        return {"type": "NoneType"}
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return {"type": "bool", "value": value}
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return {"type": "int", "value": str(value)}
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        if not math.isfinite(value):
+            raise ValueError("checkpoint metadata contains a nonfinite float")
+        return {"type": "float", "hex": value.hex()}
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return {"type": "str", "value": value}
+    if isinstance(value, bytes):
+        return {"type": "bytes", "sha256": hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest(), "length": len(value)}
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        if any(not isinstance(key, str) for key in value):
+            raise TypeError("checkpoint mappings must use string keys")
+        attrs = vars(value) if hasattr(value, "__dict__") else {}
+        return {
+            "type": f"mapping:{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+            "items": [[key, _canonical(item, torch)] for key, item in value.items()],
+            "attributes": _canonical(attrs, torch) if attrs else {"type": "dict", "items": []},
+        }
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return {"type": "list", "items": [_canonical(item, torch) for item in value]}
+    if isinstance(value, tuple):
+        return {
+            "type": f"tuple:{type(value).__module__}.{type(value).__qualname__}",
+            "items": [_canonical(item, torch) for item in value],
+        }
+
+    try:
+        import numpy as np
+    except ImportError:
+        np = None
+    if np is not None and isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
+        if value.dtype.hasobject:
+            raise TypeError("checkpoint identity rejects object-dtype NumPy arrays")
+        array = np.ascontiguousarray(value)
+        return {
+            "type": "numpy.ndarray",
+            "dtype": array.dtype.str,
+            "shape": list(array.shape),
+            "content_sha256": hashlib.sha256(array.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+        }
+    if np is not None and isinstance(value, np.generic):
+        if value.dtype.hasobject:
+            raise TypeError("checkpoint identity rejects object-dtype NumPy scalars")
+        if isinstance(value, np.floating) and not np.isfinite(value):
+            raise ValueError("checkpoint metadata contains a nonfinite NumPy scalar")
+        return {
+            "type": f"numpy.scalar:{value.dtype.str}",
+            "content_sha256": hashlib.sha256(value.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
+        }
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported checkpoint value type: {type(value)!r}")
+
+
+def payload_identity_sha256(checkpoint: Any, torch: Any) -> str:
+    """Hash all checkpoint keys, metadata, tensor types/shapes and tensor bytes."""
+    normalized = _canonical(checkpoint, torch)
+    encoded = json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode(
+        "utf-8"
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CheckpointIdentity:
+    """Immutable identities for the fixed and selected checkpoint files."""
+
+    fixed_path: str
+    selected_path: str
+    fixed_file_sha256: str
+    selected_file_sha256: str
+    payload_sha256: str
+    model_state_sha256: str
+    epoch: int
+    input_width: int
+
+    def receipt(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Return a JSON-safe receipt preserving both byte and payload identities."""
+        return asdict(self)
+
+
+def verify_checkpoint_pair(
+    fixed_path: Path,
+    selected_path: Path,
+    *,
+    expected_epoch: int = 2,
+    expected_input_width: int = 271,
+) -> CheckpointIdentity:
+    """Require exact full-payload equality of fixed and selected Torch checkpoints.
+
+    This does not replace recipe, source, full-budget, or prediction validation.
+    Callers must keep those independent checks and bind predictions to the fixed
+    checkpoint's raw file hash returned here.
+    """
+    import torch
+
+    fixed_path = fixed_path.resolve(strict=True)
+    selected_path = selected_path.resolve(strict=True)
+    fixed = torch.load(fixed_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    selected = torch.load(selected_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+    if not isinstance(fixed, dict) or not isinstance(selected, dict):
+        raise TypeError("PR15 checkpoint payloads must be dictionaries")
+    for label, payload in (("fixed", fixed), ("selected", selected)):
+        if payload.get("epoch") != expected_epoch:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} checkpoint is not fixed epoch {expected_epoch}")
+        if payload.get("n_in") != expected_input_width:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} checkpoint input width is not {expected_input_width}")
+        if not isinstance(payload.get("model"), Mapping):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} checkpoint has no model state mapping")
+    fixed_payload_sha = payload_identity_sha256(fixed, torch)
+    selected_payload_sha = payload_identity_sha256(selected, torch)
+    if fixed_payload_sha != selected_payload_sha:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "selected model.pt payload differs from model_ep2.pt "
+            f"(fixed={fixed_payload_sha}, selected={selected_payload_sha})"
+        )
+    return CheckpointIdentity(
+        fixed_path=str(fixed_path),
+        selected_path=str(selected_path),
+        fixed_file_sha256=sha256_file(fixed_path),
+        selected_file_sha256=sha256_file(selected_path),
+        payload_sha256=fixed_payload_sha,
+        model_state_sha256=payload_identity_sha256(fixed["model"], torch),
+        epoch=expected_epoch,
+        input_width=expected_input_width,
+    )
+
+
+def validate_provenance_file_hashes(
+    provenance: Mapping[str, Any], identity: CheckpointIdentity
+) -> None:
+    """Bind each saved archive byte hash to its own trainer provenance entry."""
+    checkpoint_hashes = provenance.get("checkpoint_sha256")
+    expected = {
+        "model_ep2.pt": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "model.pt": identity.selected_file_sha256,
+    }
+    if not isinstance(checkpoint_hashes, Mapping) or any(
+        checkpoint_hashes.get(filename) != digest for filename, digest in expected.items()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint bytes differ from the trainer's per-file provenance")
+
+
+def validate_prediction_pin(
+    sidecar: Mapping[str, Any],
+    prediction_path: Path,
+    identity: CheckpointIdentity,
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    split_manifest_sha256: str,
+    evaluation_groups: list[int],
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Keep the evaluation export pinned to exact epoch-2 bytes and row membership."""
+    prediction_sha256 = sha256_file(prediction_path)
+    expected = {
+        "run": name,
+        "epoch": identity.epoch,
+        "campaign_export_scope": "evaluation",
+        "campaign_split_manifest_sha256": split_manifest_sha256,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_manifest_sha256,
+        "checkpoint_sha256": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "row_groups": evaluation_groups,
+        "prediction_sha256": prediction_sha256,
+    }
+    if any(sidecar.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+        raise ValueError("prediction sidecar is not pinned to the fixed checkpoint/fold")
+    return {
+        "checkpoint_file_sha256": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "prediction_sha256": prediction_sha256,
+    }

+"""Export evaluation-only epoch-2 predictions with the original PR15 predictor."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import runpy
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def _request(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load an object-valued worker request."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise TypeError("worker request must be a JSON object")
+    return value
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run the pinned predict_run.py with its exact held-out-fold command."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--request", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    request = _request(args.request.resolve(strict=True))
+    source_root = Path(request["source_root"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    script = source_root / "scripts" / "predict_run.py"
+    if not script.is_file() or request.get("mode") != "fit":
+        raise ValueError("PR15 predictor request or source is missing")
+    sys.path[:0] = [str(script.parent), str(source_root / "src")]
+    sys.argv = [str(script), *[str(value) for value in request["predict_argv"]]]
+    runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name="__main__")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+SCORE_SUPPORT_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "698ae26944b96ffb1b2b2ccb2de11cab427d3c822c2ca74cdacff1b1ef7d6368"
+EXPECTED_UPDATES = {0: 44760, 1: 44790, 2: 44850, 3: 44640}

+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash one artifact with bounded memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a JSON object from one immutable receipt."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise TypeError(f"expected JSON object at {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _bound_path(work: Path, text: str) -> Path:
+    """Resolve one receipt path and require it to remain inside the worker root."""
+    path = Path(text).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not path.is_relative_to(work.resolve(strict=True)):
+        raise ValueError(f"receipt path escaped the worker workspace: {path}")
+    return path
+
+
+def _check_contract() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Require the externally sealed fit-only contract and this exact validator."""
+    package = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    contract_path = package / "FIT_CONTRACT.json"
+    contract = _json(contract_path)
+    expected_files = {
+        "fit_validation.py": _sha256(Path(__file__).resolve()),
+        "checkpoint_identity.py": _sha256(package / "checkpoint_identity.py"),
+    }
+    if (
+        contract.get("schema") != "tabdata-pr15-fit-contract.v2"
+        or contract.get("files") != expected_files
+        or contract.get("profile_packet_sha256")
+        != "c18f1877b8579c03d2a0905534f5ecbd13ed56a54306ba66d63b47d892b66510"
+        or contract.get("parent_fit_contract_sha256")
+        != "05aa087af1fdd68ac97146e6f56750157d4a33ebd4fce2a5ec2f5eb30cc6bcb8"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("fit-only validator differs from externally sealed FIT_CONTRACT.json")
+    return contract
+
+
+def _canonical_argv(
+    source_root: Path,
+    name: str,
+    fold: int,
+    seed: int,
+    control: str,
+    split_path: Path,
+    phase: str = "train",
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Rebuild the exact frozen PR15 command, replacing only its split-file path."""
+    builder_path = source_root / "scripts" / "geometry_b300" / "common.py"
+    manifest = _json(Path(__file__).with_name("source_manifest.json"))
+    records = {row["path"]: row["sha256"] for row in manifest["files"]}
+    relative = "scripts/geometry_b300/common.py"
+    if relative not in records or _sha256(builder_path) != records[relative]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "PR15 canonical command builder is absent or differs from its source manifest"
+        )
+    builder_dir = str(builder_path.parent)
+    module_name = "_pr15_fit_validation_common"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, builder_path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError("cannot load the hash-pinned PR15 command builder")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.path.insert(0, builder_dir)
+    try:
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        command = (
+            module.prediction_command(name, fold)
+            if phase == "predict"
+            else module.train_command(name, fold, seed, control)
+        )
+    finally:
+        sys.path.remove(builder_dir)
+        sys.modules.pop("mounts", None)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(command, list)
+        or len(command) < 4
+        or command[2]
+        != ("scripts/predict_run.py" if phase == "predict" else "scripts/train_rnn.py")
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("PR15 command builder returned an unsupported trainer command")
+    argv = [str(value) for value in command[3:]]
+    try:
+        split_index = argv.index(
+            "--campaign-split-manifest" if phase == "predict" else "--split-manifest"
+        )
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError("PR15 canonical command omitted its campaign split manifest") from error
+    if split_index + 1 >= len(argv):
+        raise ValueError("PR15 canonical command has no split manifest value")
+    argv[split_index + 1] = str(split_path)
+    return argv
+
+
+def _check_request_and_split(
+    work: Path,
+    request: dict[str, Any],
+    worker: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    fold: int,
+    seed: int,
+    control: str,
+    split_sha256: str,
+) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Bind worker request and canonical fold file to the claimed cell identity."""
+    request_path = work / "worker_request.json"
+    workspace = worker.get("workspace", {})
+    source_root = Path(request.get("source_root", "")).resolve(strict=True)
+    project_root = source_root.parent.parent
+    split_path = (project_root / "splits" / f"fold{fold}.json").resolve(strict=True)
+    if (
+        request.get("schema") != "pr15-host-worker-request.v1"
+        or request.get("mode") != "fit"
+        or request.get("name") != name
+        or Path(request.get("work", "")).resolve(strict=True) != work
+        or source_root != (project_root / "runtime" / "pr15-source-e238-v1").resolve(strict=True)
+        or worker.get("request_sha256") != _sha256(request_path)
+        or worker.get("split_hash") != split_sha256
+        or workspace.get("fold") != fold
+        or workspace.get("split_manifest") != str(split_path)
+        or workspace.get("split_manifest_sha256") != split_sha256
+        or _sha256(split_path) != split_sha256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("worker request or fold manifest differs from the requested cell")
+    expected_predict = _canonical_argv(
+        source_root, name, fold, seed, control, split_path, "predict"
+    )
+    if request.get("predict_argv") != expected_predict:
+        raise ValueError("Prediction request differs from the exact canonical epoch-2 command")
+    train_argv = request.get("train_argv")
+    expected_argv = _canonical_argv(source_root, name, fold, seed, control, split_path)
+    if train_argv != expected_argv:
+        raise ValueError("worker trainer argv differs from the frozen PR15 builder")
+    split = _json(split_path)
+    if (
+        split.get("fold") != fold
+        or split.get("n_folds") != 4
+        or not isinstance(split.get("evaluation", {}).get("valid"), list)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("canonical split manifest has the wrong fold or evaluation membership")
+    return source_root, split
+
+
+def _phase_receipt(
+    work: Path, receipt: dict[str, Any], *, actor: str | None, gpu_uuid: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify successful phase log and optional GPU resource-envelope receipt hashes."""
+    if receipt.get("exit_code") != 0:
+        raise ValueError("phase did not exit successfully")
+    log_path = _bound_path(work, str(receipt.get("log", "")))
+    log_hash = _sha256(log_path)
+    if log_hash != receipt.get("log_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError(f"phase log hash mismatch: {log_path}")
+    result: dict[str, Any] = {"log": str(log_path), "log_sha256": log_hash}
+    if actor is not None:
+        resource_path = _bound_path(work, str(receipt.get("resource_receipt", "")))
+        resource_hash = _sha256(resource_path)
+        if resource_hash != receipt.get("resource_receipt_sha256"):
+            raise ValueError(f"phase resource receipt hash mismatch: {resource_path}")
+        resource = _json(resource_path)
+        if (
+            resource.get("script") != actor
+            or resource.get("status") != "actor_returned"
+            or resource.get("visible_devices") != gpu_uuid
+            or resource.get("allocator_budget_bytes") != 6 * 1024**3
+            or "B300" not in str(resource.get("gpu", ""))
+            or resource.get("allocator_limit_is_not_a_device_memory_reservation") is not True
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"phase process envelope does not match the assigned B300: {actor}")
+        for key in ("cuda_peak_allocated_bytes", "cuda_peak_reserved_bytes"):
+            value = resource.get(key)
+            if type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= 6 * 1024**3:
+                raise ValueError(f"GPU peak envelope evidence exceeds its budget: {key}={value}")
+        result.update(resource_receipt=str(resource_path), resource_receipt_sha256=resource_hash)
+    return result
+
+
+def _check_recipe(
+    args: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    fold: int,
+    seed: int,
+    control: str,

+        "WNN_THREADS",
+        "OMP_NUM_THREADS",
+        "MKL_NUM_THREADS",
+        "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS",
+    ):
+        os.environ[name] = "2"
+    os.environ["NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS"] = "2"
+    os.environ["NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE"] = "0"
+    os.environ["TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE"] = "0"
+    os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
+    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+
+    import torch
+
+    if torch.cuda.device_count() != 1:
+        raise ValueError("each cell must see exactly one assigned CUDA device")
+    device = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0)
+    if "B300" not in device.name:
+        raise ValueError("this campaign entrypoint is bound to NVIDIA B300")
+    budget = 6 * 1024**3
+    os.environ["WNN_GPU_MEMORY_BYTES"] = str(budget)
+    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(budget / device.total_memory, 0)
+    torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float32)
+    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.set_num_threads(2)
+    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "tabdata-b300-process-envelope.v1",
+        "pid": os.getpid(),
+        "script": script.name,
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
+        "gpu": device.name,
+        "visible_devices": os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"),
+        "cpu_affinity": sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),
+        "torch_threads": torch.get_num_threads(),
+        "allocator_budget_bytes": budget,
+        "allocator_limit_is_not_a_device_memory_reservation": True,
+    }
+    print("PROCESS_ENVELOPE " + json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(script.parent))
+    sys.argv = [str(script), *sys.argv[2:]]
+    try:
+        runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name="__main__")
+        receipt["status"] = "actor_returned"
+    except BaseException as error:
+        receipt.update(status="actor_failed", error_type=type(error).__name__)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        receipt.update(
+            elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
+            cuda_peak_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(0),
+            cuda_peak_reserved_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(0),
+        )
+        path = run_dir / f"{script.stem}_resource_receipt.json"
+        with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2)
+            stream.write("\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""CPU-only Torch tests for the isolated PR15 delivery validator repair."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+from checkpoint_identity import (
+    sha256_file,
+    validate_prediction_pin,
+    validate_provenance_file_hashes,
+    verify_checkpoint_pair,
+)
+
+
+def _torch():
+    return pytest.importorskip("torch", reason="run this validator test on CPU Torch")
+
+
+def _checkpoint(torch, *, seed: int = 1001, budget: int = 44_760):
+    state = OrderedDict(
+        (
+            ("mean", torch.zeros(271, dtype=torch.float32)),
+            ("std", torch.ones(271, dtype=torch.float32)),
+            ("gru.weight", torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(3, 4)),
+        )
+    )
+    state._metadata = OrderedDict((("", {"version": 1}),))
+    return {
+        "model": state,
+        "epoch": 2,
+        "n_in": 271,
+        "args": {
+            "name": "pr15_baseline_f0_s1001",
+            "seed": seed,
+            "valid_fold": 0,
+            "checkpoint_epoch": 2,
+            "research_feature_control": "all",
+            "precision": "fp32",
+            "split_manifest_sha256": "a" * 64,
+            "source_manifest_sha256": "b" * 64,
+        },
+        "research_feature_prior": {
+            "schema": "causal_geometry_discrete_v1",
+            "fit_rows": 42,
+            "atoms": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0],
+        },
+        "provenance": {
+            "split_manifest_sha256": "a" * 64,
+            "source_manifest_sha256": "b" * 64,
+            "cumulative_updates": {
+                "optimizer_attempts": budget,
+                "optimizer_completed_updates": budget,
+                "amp_skipped_updates": 0,
+            },
+            "trainer_implementation": {"sha256": "c" * 64},
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _save_pair(tmp_path: Path, torch, left, right=None):
+    fixed = tmp_path / "model_ep2.pt"
+    selected = tmp_path / "model.pt"
+    torch.save(left, fixed)
+    torch.save(left if right is None else right, selected)
+    return fixed, selected
+
+
+def test_separate_torch_archives_accept_exact_full_payload_and_keep_raw_hashes(tmp_path):
+    torch = _torch()
+    checkpoint = _checkpoint(torch)
+    fixed, selected = _save_pair(tmp_path, torch, checkpoint)
+
+    # The real trainer saves the same object in separate calls under two names.
+    # Torch archive container bytes can differ even when the loaded payload is exact.
+    identity = verify_checkpoint_pair(fixed, selected)
+    assert identity.fixed_file_sha256 == sha256_file(fixed)
+    assert identity.selected_file_sha256 == sha256_file(selected)
+    assert identity.payload_sha256
+    assert identity.model_state_sha256
+    assert identity.fixed_file_sha256 != identity.selected_file_sha256
+
+    provenance = {
+        "checkpoint_sha256": {
+            "model_ep2.pt": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+            "model.pt": identity.selected_file_sha256,
+        }
+    }
+    validate_provenance_file_hashes(provenance, identity)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("path", "mutate"),
+    [
+        ("model", lambda value: value["model"]["gru.weight"].add_(1.0)),
+        (
+            "tensor_stride",
+            lambda value: value["model"].__setitem__(
+                "gru.weight", value["model"]["gru.weight"].T.contiguous().T
+            ),
+        ),
+        ("seed", lambda value: value["args"].__setitem__("seed", 1002)),
+        (
+            "source_pin",
+            lambda value: value["args"].__setitem__("source_manifest_sha256", "d" * 64),
+        ),
+        (
+            "fit_budget",
+            lambda value: value["provenance"]["cumulative_updates"].__setitem__(
+                "optimizer_attempts", 44_759
+            ),
+        ),
+        (
+            "feature_prior",
+            lambda value: value["research_feature_prior"].__setitem__("fit_rows", 43),
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_any_tensor_or_full_metadata_drift_rejects_pair(tmp_path, path, mutate):
+    torch = _torch()
+    fixed_value = _checkpoint(torch)
+    selected_value = copy.deepcopy(fixed_value)
+    mutate(selected_value)
+    fixed, selected = _save_pair(tmp_path, torch, fixed_value, selected_value)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="payload differs"):
+        verify_checkpoint_pair(fixed, selected)
+
+
+def test_wrong_fixed_epoch_or_input_width_is_rejected(tmp_path):
+    torch = _torch()
+    checkpoint = _checkpoint(torch)
+    checkpoint["epoch"] = 1
+    fixed, selected = _save_pair(tmp_path, torch, checkpoint)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="fixed epoch 2"):
+        verify_checkpoint_pair(fixed, selected)
+
+    checkpoint = _checkpoint(torch)
+    checkpoint["n_in"] = 270
+    fixed, selected = _save_pair(tmp_path, torch, checkpoint)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="input width"):
+        verify_checkpoint_pair(fixed, selected)
+
+
+def test_each_archive_hash_is_independently_bound_in_trainer_provenance(tmp_path):
+    torch = _torch()
+    checkpoint = _checkpoint(torch)
+    fixed, selected = _save_pair(tmp_path, torch, checkpoint)
+    identity = verify_checkpoint_pair(fixed, selected)
+    provenance = {
+        "checkpoint_sha256": {
+            "model_ep2.pt": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+            "model.pt": "0" * 64,
+        }
+    }
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="per-file provenance"):
+        validate_provenance_file_hashes(provenance, identity)
+
+
+def test_prediction_pin_keeps_fixed_checkpoint_hash_and_evaluation_groups(tmp_path):
+    torch = _torch()
+    checkpoint = _checkpoint(torch)
+    fixed, selected = _save_pair(tmp_path, torch, checkpoint)
+    identity = verify_checkpoint_pair(fixed, selected)
+    prediction = tmp_path / "pred.npy"
+    prediction.write_bytes(b"finite prediction artifact fixture")
+    split_hash = "e" * 64
+    groups = [3, 7]
+    sidecar = {
+        "run": "pr15_baseline_f0_s1001",
+        "epoch": 2,
+        "campaign_export_scope": "evaluation",
+        "campaign_split_manifest_sha256": split_hash,
+        "split_manifest_sha256": split_hash,
+        "checkpoint_sha256": identity.fixed_file_sha256,
+        "row_groups": groups,
+        "prediction_sha256": sha256_file(prediction),
+    }
+    binding = validate_prediction_pin(
+        sidecar,
+        prediction,
+        identity,
+        name="pr15_baseline_f0_s1001",
+        split_manifest_sha256=split_hash,
+        evaluation_groups=groups,
+    )
+    assert binding["checkpoint_file_sha256"] == identity.fixed_file_sha256
+
+    bad = dict(sidecar, checkpoint_sha256=identity.selected_file_sha256)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="prediction sidecar"):
+        validate_prediction_pin(
+            bad,
+            prediction,
+            identity,
+            name="pr15_baseline_f0_s1001",
+            split_manifest_sha256=split_hash,
+            evaluation_groups=groups,
+        )

+"""Verify that the pinned predictor can import its sibling trainer module."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+
+import export_cell
+
+
+def test_export_entrypoint_adds_predictor_script_parent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    source_root = tmp_path / "source"
+    scripts = source_root / "scripts"
+    scripts.mkdir(parents=True)
+    (scripts / "predict_run.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
+    source_src = source_root / "src"
+    source_src.mkdir()
+    request = tmp_path / "worker_request.json"
+    request.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "source_root": str(source_root),
+                "mode": "fit",
+                "predict_argv": ["--run", "existing_fit"],
+            }
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    observed: dict[str, object] = {}
+    original_path = sys.path.copy()
+    original_argv = sys.argv.copy()
+
+    def fake_run_path(path: str, *, run_name: str) -> None:
+        observed["path"] = path
+        observed["run_name"] = run_name
+        observed["sys_path"] = sys.path.copy()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(export_cell.runpy, "run_path", fake_run_path)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["export_cell.py", "--request", str(request)])
+    try:
+        export_cell.main()
+    finally:
+        sys.path[:] = original_path
+        sys.argv[:] = original_argv
+
+    assert observed["path"] == str(scripts / "predict_run.py")
+    assert observed["run_name"] == "__main__"
+    assert observed["sys_path"][:2] == [str(scripts), str(source_src)]

+"""Small CPU-only gates for the immutable PR15 geometry feature package.
+
+Run with ``PR15_SOURCE_ROOT=<full checkout> pytest -q pr15_review_cpu_tests.py``.
+The downloaded PR contains changed files only. On such an archive, narrowly
+stub two unrelated base imports so the actual PR feature implementation can be
+tested without installing torch; a complete checkout uses its real imports.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import sys
+import types
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+AUDIT_SOURCE = Path(
+    r"C:\Users\admin\Documents\Codex\reviews\WunderFunder-audit-20261018"
+    r"\context-followup\github-prs\15\source"
+)
+SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("PR15_SOURCE_ROOT", str(AUDIT_SOURCE))).resolve()
+sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE / "src"))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE / "scripts" / "geometry_b300"))
+TORCH_AVAILABLE = importlib.util.find_spec("torch") is not None
+
+
+def _install_archive_only_import_stubs() -> None:
+    """Fill only absent base-tree imports omitted from the PR changed-file pack."""
+    if importlib.util.find_spec("torch") is None:
+        torch_stub = types.ModuleType("torch")
+        torch_stub.Tensor = object  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        sys.modules.setdefault("torch", torch_stub)
+    for name, attrs in (
+        (
+            "wnn.moment_geometry.analysis",
+            {"robust_arc": lambda *_args, **_kwargs: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
+                AssertionError("fit_prior is outside this feature-transform test")
+            )},
+        ),
+        ("wnn.moment_geometry.features", {"SELECTED": (0, 3, 52, 55)}),
+    ):
+        if importlib.util.find_spec(name) is None:
+            module = types.ModuleType(name)
+            for key, value in attrs.items():
+                setattr(module, key, value)
+            sys.modules[name] = module
+
+
+_install_archive_only_import_stubs()
+research_features = importlib.import_module("wnn.research_features")
+online = importlib.import_module("wnn.moment_geometry.online")
+common = importlib.import_module("common")
+
+
+def _fixture() -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, object]]:
+    raw = np.zeros((4, 112), dtype=np.float32)
+    raw[:, [0, 3, 52, 55]] = np.asarray(
+        [
+            [1, 10, 100, 1000],
+            [1, 20, 100, 2000],
+            [3, 20, 300, 3000],
+            [9, 40, 500, 4000],
+        ],
+        dtype=np.float32,
+    )
+    prior: dict[str, object] = {
+        "schema": "causal_geometry_discrete_v1",
+        "selected_raw_columns": [0, 3, 52, 55],
+        "feature_order": list(online.FEATURE_NAMES),
+        "beta": [0.5, -0.25, 0.1, 0.01],
+        "intercept": [0.25, 1.0, -2.0, 3.0],
+        "atoms": [3, 20, 300, 2000],
+        "vocabulary": [[1, 3, 5], [10, 20, 40], [100, 200, 300], [1000, 2000, 4000]],
+        "fit_sequences": 2,
+        "fit_rows": 8,
+        "frequency_tie_break": "test fixture",
+    }
+    return raw, prior
+
+
+def _independent_reference(raw: np.ndarray, prior: dict[str, object]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Direct row-by-row oracle; deliberately avoids production vectorized code."""
+    selected = np.asarray(raw[:, [0, 3, 52, 55]], dtype=np.float64)
+    beta = np.asarray(prior["beta"], dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
+    intercept = np.asarray(prior["intercept"], dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
+    atoms = np.asarray(prior["atoms"], dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
+    vocabulary = np.asarray(prior["vocabulary"], dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
+    output: list[np.ndarray] = []
+    seen = np.zeros((4, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+    event_totals = np.zeros(4, dtype=np.float64)
+    dominant = np.zeros(4, dtype=np.float64)
+    last_change = np.zeros(4, dtype=np.int64)
+    previous: np.ndarray | None = None
+    for row_index, row in enumerate(selected):
+        prefix = selected[: row_index + 1]
+        mean = prefix.sum(axis=0) / (row_index + 1)
+        second = np.square(prefix).sum(axis=0) / (row_index + 1)
+        std = np.sqrt(np.maximum(second - mean * mean, 0.0))
+        residual = second - beta * mean - intercept
+        atom_occupancy = np.asarray(
+            [(prefix[:, field] == atoms[field]).sum() / len(prefix) for field in range(4)]
+        )
+        normalized = np.clip((row - mean) / np.maximum(std, 0.05), -8.0, 8.0)
+        category = np.zeros((4, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+        changed = np.ones(4, dtype=bool) if previous is None else row != previous
+        for field in range(4):
+            matches = np.flatnonzero(vocabulary[field] == row[field])
+            category[field, int(matches[0]) if len(matches) else 3] = 1.0
+            seen[field] += category[field]
+            event_totals[field] += float(changed[field])
+            dominant[field] += float(changed[field] and category[field, 0] == 1.0)
+            if changed[field]:
+                last_change[field] = row_index
+        occupancy = seen / (row_index + 1)
+        dominant_events = dominant / np.maximum(event_totals, 1.0)
+        dwell = np.log1p(np.minimum(row_index - last_change, 10_000))
+        output.append(
+            np.concatenate(
+                (
+                    mean,
+                    std,
+                    residual,
+                    atom_occupancy,
+                    normalized,
+                    category.ravel(),
+                    occupancy.ravel(),
+                    dominant_events,
+                    dwell,
+                )
+            )
+        )
+        previous = row.copy()
+    return np.asarray(output, dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def test_numpy_feature_values_match_independent_row_oracle() -> None:
+    raw, prior = _fixture()
+    actual = research_features.research_features_numpy(
+        raw, "causal_geometry_discrete", prior
+    )
+    expected = _independent_reference(raw, prior)
+    assert actual.shape == (4, 60)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6)
+
+
+def test_suffix_mutation_cannot_change_prefix_and_sequences_reset() -> None:
+    raw, prior = _fixture()
+    baseline = online.features_numpy(raw, prior)
+    changed = raw.copy()
+    changed[2:, [0, 3, 52, 55]] += np.asarray([77, 88, 99, 111], dtype=np.float32)
+    mutated = online.features_numpy(changed, prior)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(mutated[:2], baseline[:2])
+    assert not np.array_equal(mutated[2], baseline[2])  # current row is available
+
+    batch = np.stack((raw, raw + 1234.0))
+    actual_batch = research_features.research_features_numpy(
+        batch, "causal_geometry_discrete", prior
+    )
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual_batch[0], baseline)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+        actual_batch[1], online.features_numpy(batch[1], prior)
+    )
+
+
+def test_matched_controls_keep_width_and_zero_exact_partition() -> None:
+    raw, prior = _fixture()
+    mode = "causal_geometry_discrete"
+    full = research_features.research_features_numpy(raw, mode, prior, "none")
+    baseline = research_features.research_features_numpy(raw, mode, prior, "all")
+    moments = research_features.research_features_numpy(raw, mode, prior, "moments_only")

+    assert {value.shape for value in (full, baseline, moments, dictionary)} == {(4, 60)}
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(baseline, np.zeros((4, 60), dtype=np.float32))
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(moments[:, 20:], np.zeros((4, 40), dtype=np.float32))
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(dictionary[:, :20], np.zeros((4, 20), dtype=np.float32))
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(moments[:, :20], full[:, :20])
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(dictionary[:, 20:], full[:, 20:])
+    assert research_features.research_feature_control_indices(mode, "all") == tuple(range(60))
+    assert research_features.research_feature_control_indices(mode, "moments_only") == tuple(
+        range(20, 60)
+    )
+    assert research_features.research_feature_control_indices(mode, "dictionary_only") == tuple(

+
+
+def test_torch_cpu_features_match_numpy_for_prefix_and_each_control() -> None:
+    if not TORCH_AVAILABLE:
+        pytest.skip("PyTorch is absent from the local review venv; run on the B300 host CPU")
+    import torch
+
+    raw, prior = _fixture()
+    batch = np.stack((raw, raw[::-1].copy()))

+
+def _flag(command: list[str], name: str) -> str:
+    return command[command.index(name) + 1]
+
+
+def test_frozen_command_builder_covers_30_paired_cells_and_fixed_recipe() -> None:

+            assert _flag(command, "--train-source") == "train+valid"

+"""Run the frozen PR15 trainer once inside the B300 process envelope."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def _request(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load an object-valued worker request."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise TypeError("worker request must be a JSON object")
+    return value
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Pass unchanged PR15 command arguments to its canonical modular trainer."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--request", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    request = _request(args.request.resolve(strict=True))
+    source_root = Path(request["source_root"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    work = Path(request["work"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    train_args = request["train_argv"]
+    if request.get("mode") not in {"profile", "fit"} or not isinstance(train_args, list):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported PR15 training request")
+    if os.environ.get("WNN_PROJECT_ROOT") != str(work):
+        raise ValueError("trainer project root differs from its isolated work directory")
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(source_root / "src"))
+    from wnn.training.environment import TrainingEnvironment
+    from wnn.training.runner import run_training
+
+    environment = TrainingEnvironment(
+        source_root=source_root,
+        root=work,
+        argv=[str(value) for value in train_args],
+    )
+    run_training(environment.argv, environment=environment)
+    print(
+        "PR15_TRAIN_RETURNED "
+        + json.dumps({"mode": request["mode"], "name": request["name"]}, sort_keys=True),
+        flush=True,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+from typing import Any
+
+from checkpoint_identity import (
+    validate_provenance_file_hashes,
+    verify_checkpoint_pair,
+)
+
+SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "873662aded939afd64c17c80b684011de023c04a31be5b2c74e0b9d97a18efc0"
+SOURCE_COMMIT = "e238fc5c82ac8c4591f3ca3ef87c37b2b73b929e"
+SCORE_SUPPORT_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "698ae26944b96ffb1b2b2ccb2de11cab427d3c822c2ca74cdacff1b1ef7d6368"
+SCORE_SUPPORT_BLOB_OID = "7c8450d40bdf3e355ced2cddeb2b846598ce1554"
+SCORE_SUPPORT_SHA256 = "fb7a85a5837f61fa6c65cd10a799768006067e87d4c18e92d4b813ba83b9d82e"

+}

+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a file without loading it all into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read an object-valued UTF-8 JSON file."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise TypeError(f"expected a JSON object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def verify_source_tree(source_root: Path, manifest_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify all 172 extracted source files against the exact PR15 manifest."""
+    if sha256_file(manifest_path) != SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("PR15 source manifest differs from the reviewed immutable manifest")
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)
+    if (
+        manifest.get("schema") != "b300-source-package.v1"
+        or manifest.get("source_commit") != SOURCE_COMMIT
+        or manifest.get("file_count") != 172
+        or not isinstance(manifest.get("files"), list)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported or mismatched PR15 source manifest")
+    expected: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for record in manifest["files"]:
+        relative = PurePosixPath(str(record.get("path", "")))
+        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts or not relative.parts:
+            raise ValueError("unsafe path in PR15 source manifest")
+        expected[relative.as_posix()] = record
+    if len(expected) != 172:
+        raise ValueError("PR15 source manifest has duplicate or missing file entries")
+    actual: set[str] = set()
+    for path in source_root.rglob("*"):
+        if path.is_symlink():
+            raise ValueError(f"PR15 source tree contains a symlink: {path}")
+        if path.is_file():
+            actual.add(path.relative_to(source_root).as_posix())
+    if actual != set(expected):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"PR15 extracted file set differs (missing={sorted(set(expected) - actual)[:8]}, "
+            f"extra={sorted(actual - set(expected))[:8]})"
+        )
+    for relative, record in expected.items():
+        path = source_root.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(relative).parts)
+        if path.stat().st_size != record["size_bytes"] or sha256_file(path) != record["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"PR15 frozen source file changed: {relative}")
+    return {
+        "source_commit": SOURCE_COMMIT,
+        "archive_sha256": manifest["archive_sha256"],
+        "source_tree_sha256": manifest["source_tree_sha256"],
+        "manifest_sha256": SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "file_count": len(expected),
+        "total_uncompressed_bytes": manifest["total_uncompressed_bytes"],
+    }
+
+
+def verify_score_support(package_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Verify the exact e238 base-tree scorer helper, kept outside the 172-file bundle."""
+    manifest_path = package_root / "score_support_manifest.json"
+    helper_path = package_root / "score_support" / "grade_prediction_bank.py"
+    if sha256_file(manifest_path) != SCORE_SUPPORT_MANIFEST_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError("PR15 scorer support manifest differs from its Git-object pin")
+    manifest = read_json(manifest_path)
+    files = manifest.get("files")
+    if (
+        manifest.get("schema") != "pr15-scorer-support.v1"
+        or manifest.get("source_commit") != SOURCE_COMMIT
+        or not isinstance(files, list)
+        or len(files) != 1
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported PR15 scorer support manifest")
+    record = files[0]
+    if (
+        record.get("git_blob_oid") != SCORE_SUPPORT_BLOB_OID
+        or record.get("sha256") != SCORE_SUPPORT_SHA256
+        or record.get("path") != "scripts/grade_prediction_bank.py"
+        or record.get("size_bytes") != 11114
+        or helper_path.stat().st_size != 11114
+        or sha256_file(helper_path) != SCORE_SUPPORT_SHA256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("PR15 scorer support helper is not the pinned e238 Git blob")
+    return {
+        "manifest_sha256": SCORE_SUPPORT_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+        "git_blob_oid": SCORE_SUPPORT_BLOB_OID,
+        "helper_sha256": SCORE_SUPPORT_SHA256,
+        "helper_bytes": 11114,
+        "recursive_dependencies": manifest["recursive_dependencies"],
+    }
+
+
+def parse_profile_events(log_text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Parse exactly one frozen profile, resource and update evidence event."""
+    events: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    for line in log_text.splitlines():
+        for prefix, key in PROFILE_PREFIXES.items():
+            if line.startswith(prefix):
+                if key in events:
+                    raise ValueError(f"profile log contains duplicate {key} evidence")
+                event = json.loads(line[len(prefix) :])
+                if not isinstance(event, dict):
+                    raise ValueError(f"profile {key} evidence is not a JSON object")
+                events[key] = event
+    expected = set(PROFILE_PREFIXES.values())
+    if set(events) != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"profile log is missing evidence: {sorted(expected - set(events))}")
+    return events
+
+
+def validate_profile_events(events: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Enforce PR15's 2-warmup/8-measured-batch profile and strict-FP32 gates."""
+    timing, resources, updates = (
+        events["timing"],
+        events["resources"],
+        events["updates"],
+    )
+    for key, value in timing.items():
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+            raise TypeError(f"profile timing {key} is not numeric")
+        if not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"profile timing {key} is negative or nonfinite")
+    for key in ("step_wall", "gpu_total", "seq_per_s"):
+        if timing.get(key, 0) <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"profile timing {key} must be positive")
+    if (
+        resources.get("precision") != "fp32"
+        or resources.get("matmul_tf32") is not False
+        or resources.get("cudnn_tf32") is not False
+        or resources.get("float32_matmul_precision") != "highest"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("profile did not prove strict FP32 with TF32 disabled")
+    exact = {
+        "optimizer_attempts": 100,
+        "optimizer_completed_updates": 100,
+        "amp_skipped_updates": 0,
+        "loss_checks": 100,
+        "gradient_stats_steps": 100,
+        "gradient_stats_nonfinite_steps": 0,
+    }
+    for key, expected in exact.items():
+        value = updates.get(key)
+        if type(value) is not int or value != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"profile {key} expected {expected}, observed {value!r}")
+    for key in (
+        "loss_finite",
+        "gradient_finite",
+        "counts_consistent",
+        "valid_for_throughput",
+    ):
+        if updates.get(key) is not True:
+            raise ValueError(f"profile update evidence failed {key}")
+    if updates.get("grad_scaler_enabled") is not False:
+        raise ValueError("strict FP32 profile unexpectedly enabled GradScaler")
+
+
+def validate_fit_artifacts(work: Path, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Require the exact fixed epoch-2 checkpoint and complete source-native logs."""
+    run_dir = work / "artifacts" / "runs" / name
+    required = {
+        "checkpoint_ep2": run_dir / "model_ep2.pt",
+        "selected_checkpoint": run_dir / "model.pt",
+        "history": run_dir / "history.json",
+        "provenance": run_dir / "provenance.json",
+        "training_state": run_dir / "training_state.pt",
+    }
+    for label, path in required.items():
+        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"fit did not produce required {label}: {path}")
+    checkpoint_identity = verify_checkpoint_pair(
+        required["checkpoint_ep2"], required["selected_checkpoint"]
+    )
+    checkpoint_hash = checkpoint_identity.fixed_file_sha256
+    history = json.loads(required["history"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(history, list) or len(history) != 3:
+        raise ValueError("PR15 fit must record exactly three completed training epochs")
+    if any(row.get("evaluation") != "withheld" for row in history):
+        raise ValueError("PR15 fit unexpectedly evaluated during training")
+    provenance = read_json(required["provenance"])
+    validate_provenance_file_hashes(provenance, checkpoint_identity)
+    if provenance.get("args", {}).get("checkpoint_epoch") != 2:
+        raise ValueError("trainer provenance does not bind the fixed epoch-2 endpoint")
+    return {
+        "run_dir": str(run_dir),
+        "checkpoint_path": str(required["checkpoint_ep2"]),
+        "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
+        "checkpoint_identity": checkpoint_identity.receipt(),
+        "provenance_path": str(required["provenance"]),
+        "provenance_sha256": sha256_file(required["provenance"]),
+        "history_path": str(required["history"]),
+        "history_sha256": sha256_file(required["history"]),
+        "training_state_path": str(required["training_state"]),
+        "training_state_sha256": sha256_file(required["training_state"]),
+        "epochs": len(history),
+    }
+
+
+def validate_prediction_and_score(
+    work: Path, name: str, split: dict[str, Any], split_hash: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check exported evaluation membership/shape and the official PR15 score."""
+    import numpy as np
+
+    prediction = work / "cache" / f"pred_{name}_valid.npy"
+    metadata_path = prediction.with_suffix(".json")
+    score_path = work / "artifacts" / "runs" / name / "score.json"
+    for path in (prediction, metadata_path, score_path):
+        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"prediction/scorer output is missing: {path}")
+    metadata = read_json(metadata_path)
+    groups = split.get("evaluation", {}).get("valid")
+    if (
+        metadata.get("run") != name
+        or metadata.get("epoch") != 2
+        or metadata.get("campaign_export_scope") != "evaluation"
+        or metadata.get("campaign_split_manifest_sha256") != split_hash
+        or metadata.get("row_groups") != groups
+    ):

+    array = np.load(prediction, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+    if array.shape != (len(groups), 20_000, 2) or array.dtype != np.float32:

+    if metadata.get("prediction_sha256") != sha256_file(prediction):

+        "metric_id": "global_wp_clip2_v1",

+"""Bounded host adapter for one exact PR15 geometry fit or profile."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from validation import (
+    SOURCE_COMMIT,
+    parse_profile_events,
+    read_json,
+    sha256_file,
+    validate_fit_artifacts,
+    validate_prediction_and_score,
+    validate_profile_events,
+    verify_score_support,
+    verify_source_tree,
+)
+from workspace import prepare_workspace
+
+CONTROL_VALUES = {"all", "moments_only", "dictionary_only", "none"}
+NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}\Z")
+
+
+def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    """Parse one cell request from the root-owned B300 controller."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--fold", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--control", required=True, choices=sorted(CONTROL_VALUES))
+    parser.add_argument("--gpu", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--cpus", required=True, help="comma-separated IDs or ranges")
+    parser.add_argument("--work", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--mode", required=True, choices=("profile", "fit"))
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def _cpu_ids(spec: str) -> set[int]:
+    """Parse a nonempty Linux CPU list such as ``0-1,8``."""
+    result: set[int] = set()
+    for item in spec.split(","):
+        parts = item.strip().split("-", 1)
+        if not parts[0].isdigit() or (len(parts) == 2 and not parts[1].isdigit()):
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid CPU affinity list: {spec}")
+        low, high = int(parts[0]), int(parts[-1])
+        if low < 0 or high < low:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid CPU range: {item}")
+        result.update(range(low, high + 1))
+    if not result:
+        raise ValueError("CPU affinity list is empty")
+    return result
+
+
+def _apply_affinity(cpus: set[int]) -> list[int]:
+    """Apply and report this worker's declared CPU affinity before child imports."""
+    if not hasattr(os, "sched_getaffinity") or not hasattr(os, "sched_setaffinity"):
+        raise OSError("PR15 host worker requires Linux CPU affinity controls")
+    allowed = set(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
+    if not cpus <= allowed:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"requested CPUs are outside controller affinity: {sorted(cpus - allowed)}"
+        )
+    os.sched_setaffinity(0, cpus)
+    observed = sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))
+    if observed != sorted(cpus):
+        raise OSError("kernel did not apply the requested PR15 CPU affinity")
+    return observed
+
+
+def _gpu_row(gpu_uuid: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Require the named host UUID to identify one NVIDIA B300 device."""
+    command = [
+        "nvidia-smi",
+        "--query-gpu=uuid,name,memory.free,memory.total",
+        "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
+    ]
+    output = subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    rows = list(csv.reader(output.splitlines(), skipinitialspace=True))
+    matches = [row for row in rows if len(row) >= 4 and row[0].strip() == gpu_uuid]
+    if len(matches) != 1 or "B300" not in matches[0][1]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"GPU UUID does not identify exactly one NVIDIA B300: {gpu_uuid}"
+        )
+    return {
+        "uuid": matches[0][0].strip(),
+        "name": matches[0][1].strip(),
+        "memory_free_mib": matches[0][2].strip(),
+        "memory_total_mib": matches[0][3].strip(),
+    }
+
+
+def _load_common(source_root: Path) -> Any:
+    """Import only PR15's frozen command builder, without running its host launcher."""
+    path = source_root / "scripts" / "geometry_b300" / "common.py"
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    module_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pr15_geometry_common", path)
+    if module_spec is None or module_spec.loader is None:
+        raise ImportError(f"cannot import frozen command builder: {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(module_spec)
+    sys.modules[module_spec.name] = module
+    module_spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _replace_flag(argv: list[str], flag: str, value: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Replace one exact flag value while preserving all other recipe arguments."""
+    result = list(argv)
+    positions = [index for index, token in enumerate(result) if token == flag]
+    if len(positions) != 1 or positions[0] + 1 >= len(result):
+        raise ValueError(f"frozen command has no unique {flag} value")
+    result[positions[0] + 1] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def _write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Atomically persist one receipt without replacing an existing attempt."""
+    if path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to replace receipt: {path}")
+    temporary = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.{os.getpid()}.partial")
+    with temporary.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    temporary.replace(path)
+
+
+def _tee_process(
+    command: list[str], env: dict[str, str], cwd: Path, log_path: Path
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run one phase in the inherited worker group and retain/stream its full log."""
+    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    started = time.time()
+    with log_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as log:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(
+            command,
+            cwd=cwd,
+            env=env,
+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+            text=True,
+            encoding="utf-8",
+            errors="replace",
+            bufsize=1,
+        )
+        assert process.stdout is not None
+        for line in process.stdout:
+            log.write(line)
+            log.flush()
+            print(line, end="", flush=True)
+        return_code = process.wait()
+        log.flush()
+        os.fsync(log.fileno())
+    return {
+        "command": command,
+        "exit_code": return_code,
+        "started_epoch": started,
+        "finished_epoch": time.time(),
+        "elapsed_seconds": time.time() - started,

+        sys.executable,

+        str(package / "gpu_entrypoint.py"),

+        raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(record["exit_code"], command)
